North Caucasian State Academy (NCSA), located in Cherkessk, Russia, is a renowned public institution known for providing high-quality education, especially in the field of medicine and healthcare sciences. Established in 1936, the academy has grown into a prominent destination for both Russian and international students pursuing MBBS and other medical programs.

Recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC), World Health Organisation (WHO), and other global bodies, the academy provides an internationally accepted MBBS degree in an affordable and student-friendly environment. With modern infrastructure, experienced faculty, and a multicultural campus, NCSA is a popular choice among Indian students.

Founded in 1936, North Caucasian State Medical Academy is one of the best medical colleges to study MBBS in Russia for Indian students. It is located in Arkhangelsk and has received recognition from WHO, NMC, FAIMER, et cetera.

North Caucasian State Medical Academy has fifty-five departments, and twenty-seven are clinical. More than 5000 students are getting their education and training from this university. So, we can say that North Caucasian State Medical Academy direct admission is a top Russia medical university for Indian students. The degree you get here has recognition in countries like the USA, Canada, and India, among others. It can boast of a world-class infrastructure consisting of modern-day computers, movies, video-supporting devices and many other devices needed for imparting proper medical education. Yes, it is possible to provide medical education using some basic devices, but this university uses a wide range of up-to-date devices to prepare a student for performing anywhere in the world.

Why should you choose North caucasian state medical university?

Every student first thinks why choose this university? Students, there are many interesting facts and figures. Some amazing things are mentioned below. Students can check it below.

Academic excellence

North caucasian state medical university is one of the oldest and most prestigious medical universities in the North Caucasus region. It is ranked among the top 10 medical universities in Russia and is accredited by the World Federation for Medical Education (WFME).

Affordable tuition fees

The tuition fees at NCSMU are relatively affordable, especially compared to universities in other developed countries.

Research opportunities

NCSMU has a strong research program and offers students the opportunity to get involved in research projects. The university has a number of research centers and laboratories, and its faculty members are actively involved in research projects.

Eligibility Criteria

North Caucasian State Academy has consistently been one of the top choices for international students seeking to pursue Medical Degree Courses. If you are interested in studying MBBS at North Caucasian State Academy, please check the eligibility criteria provided below.

Career Opportunities After MBBS

After completing the MBBS from NCSA:

  •  Eligible for FMGE (India), USMLE (USA), PLAB (UK), and more.
  •  Can pursue PG studies in India, USA, UK, Canada, etc.
  •  Work as a doctor globally or in reputed hospitals.
  •  Option to apply for internships or residency in Russia.

  • A valid passport for travel and a student visa.
  • 10th and 12th mark sheets.
  • Letter of acceptance from the medical college in Russia where you have been enrolled
  • A valid NEET scorecard.
  • Completed application form
  • Passport-size photographs

  • Fee receipts of tuition fees and visa fees.

North Caucasian State Medical Academy Offered Courses

North Caucasian State Medical Academy offers a broad selection of courses designed to meet diverse student interests. These include programs like general medicine, paediatrics, nursing, and surgery, providing students with various fields in the healthcare sector. The university also offers postgraduate education and pharmaceutical courses for students aiming for specialisation programmes. The academy ensures that every student finds a program according to their career ambitions and personal goals within the medical field.

North Caucasian State Medical Academy Syllabus

At North Caucasian State Medical Academy, the curriculum is designed to give students a solid foundation in medicine along with practical skills. The initial years focus on subjects like Biology, Anatomy, Physics, and language courses. After this, the course shifts to more specialised medical topics such as Physiology, Microbiology, Surgery, and Internal Medicine. In the final years, students are also taught subjects like paediatrics, Obstetrics, Neurology, Psychiatry, and Emergency Medicine. The program is designed to give both theoretical learning with practical clinical training, ensuring students are well-prepared for real-world medical practice.

Eligibility Criteria to Study MBBS in North Caucasian State Academy, Faculty of Medicine

  • North Caucasian State Academy offers a recognized program.
  • Students must complete their SSC and HSC i.e. 10+2 from a recognized state board.
  • HSC should be completed in Science subjects including – biology, physics, and chemistry.
  • The applicant should complete their age of 17 years on or before 31st December of the year of admission.
  • The candidate must have a score of at least 50% in their HSC boards from a recognized board of examination.
  • Applicant must clear NEET examination.

Conclusion

Choosing the right university for pursuing MBBS abroad is a crucial decision. North Caucasian State Medical Academy, with its affordable fee structure and high-quality education, is a great choice for Indian students. Start your journey towards becoming a successful doctor with NCSA!

In conclusion, the North Caucasian State Medical Academy offers an affordable, high-quality MBBS program that prepares students for a successful career in medicine. With its world-class education, practical learning approach, and global community, NCSA stands out as a top choice for Indian students looking to study MBBS abroad.

title: Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research
content:
Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research (SRIMSR) is a premier medical education institution located in Raipur, Chattisgarh. This institute was established in 2024. It has gained immense popularity for its commitment to provide high-quality medical education and to develop a research-driven atmosphere amid the students. With excellent facilities and a highly qualified teaching staff, SRIMSR aims to produce competitive and top-class healthcare professionals.

The institute offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various medical disciplines. It is affiliated with Pt. Deendayal Upadhyay Memorial Health Sciences and Ayush University of Chhattisgarh, Raipur and recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The campus of Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research is well provided with modern laboratories, a well-stocked library, and advanced research centers. Such facilities ensure that students receive a detailed and elaborative education.

All About Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research

SRIMSR has a team of highly qualified medical professionals engaged in constant research projects which makes the student body of the college competent to deal with any critical medical conditions. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research provides many services such as from Prevention, Diagnosis to Rehabilitation support. This institute was set up as a detailed treatment care center with well- trained professional staff and equipped with modern facilities and the most contemporary medical equipment. The Hospital has a capacity of 300 + beds and serves all sections of the Society. 80% of these beds are reserved for free treatment for the underprivileged sections.

Admission Process

Read the section given below to know all about the admission procedure of Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research MBBS in Chhattisgarh:

Eligibility Criteria

Refer to this section in order to know all the points about the eligibility criteria that has to be satisfied in order to get admission in the institute.

  • The candidates should have passed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as their core subjects.
  • The candidates should have obtained a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying examination (40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates).
  • The candidates should  have qualified the NEET-UG examination and attained a score that satisfies the cutoff of this institute.

Admission Procedure

The admission process for SRIMSR involves the following steps:

  1. The candidates should appear for the relevant entrance exams (NEET-UG for MBBS, NEET-PG for MD/MS).
  2. Fill out the application form available on the institute’s official website.
  3. Submit necessary documents such as mark sheets, entrance exam scores, and identity proof (all the necessary documents are mentioned below).
  4. Participate in the counseling sessions organized by the institute or affiliating university.
  5. Based on merit and availability, seats will be allotted to candidates.
  6. Pay the required admission fee to confirm your seat in the institute.
  7. Attend the orientation program to get acquainted with the institute’s rules, regulations, and facilities.

Following are some of the documents required for MBBS admission in Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research.

  • Recent passport size color photographs – 8 (Eight) copies
  • NRI Documents to verify NRI status (if applicable)
  • Gap Certificate (Affidavit) (if applicable)
  • Transfer certificate / College Leaving Certificate from the last Institute attended
  • Migration Certificate (if applicable)
  • Conduct and Character Certificate
  • Certificate of Medical Fitness by Registered Medical Practitioner on the letterhead
  • PwD certificate (if applicable)

Application Process in Steps

Following are the steps involved in the application process of Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research. Go through all the points to know the whole process.

  1. Go to the official website of SRIMSR (SRIMSR).
  2. Create an account by providing basic details.
  3. Enter academic and personal information.
  4. Upload scanned copies of required documents.
  5. Pay the non-refundable application fee online.
  6. Review the form and submit it.
  7. Print the application confirmation for future reference.

The cut-off marks for MBBS admissions at Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research (SRIMSR) will differ each year based on factors such as how many applicants applied for the NEET exam, difficulty level of the NEET exam, and seat availability etc.

The SRIMSR has been established to assist students in securing internships and job placements in reputed hospitals and healthcare organizations. 

The institute has been constructed with such facilities and teaching faculty that students who will graduate from this college will definitely get a good job at any reputed hospital after passing the interviews and document verification. Many talented students can get placed in top hospitals across the country. The college frequently organizes workshops, seminars, and guest lectures to upgrade the employability skills of students.

Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research (SRIMSR) is ranked among the top medical institutions in the country regardless of its recent establishment. With its establishment in 2024, the institute is expected to grow and maintain its position among the top 20 medical colleges in India.

The school of Medical Sciences has recently been established in the year 2024 to offer the course of MBBS to all aspiring medical students of India.

By the year 2012, thanks to the vision of its promoters, the Sehore Campus had expanded to include twelve colleges, offering twenty undergraduate courses, twenty postgraduate courses, one postgraduate diploma course, and one diploma course, with a total student intake of 3,054. 

The SSSUTMS attracts numerous students from distant places and states due to its high-quality education at an affordable cost, with a transparent no-hidden-fees policy. Over its fourteen-year history, the institutions under the Sri Satya Sai Group of Institutions have been the only ones in Sehore and six nearby districts to offer technical education at affordable fees to deserving and needy students from over six thousand villages across 34 Tehsils.

The majority of the local population depends on agriculture for their livelihood, with 80.6% living at a low standard of living. The region has recently recorded a growth rate of 21.5%.

title: Privolzhsky Research Medical University

The Privolzhsky Research Medical University is Russia’s leading university. This university came into existence in 1920 and is situated in Oblast City, Russia. It provides high-quality education by combining scientific research with advanced clinical practice. 

There are over 70 specialised departments with over 600 teaching staff and a 7,000-student community at PRMU. Every year, thousands of Indian or international students. There are more than 2100 international students from 67 countries. 

The university provides a world-recognised medical degree; the MBBS degree is recognised by the World Health Organisation (WHO), National Medical Commission (NMC), and Foundation for Advancement of International Medical Education and Research (FAIMER). 

The Privolzhsky Medical University offers undergraduate or postgraduate courses in different specialisations. The university has various medical specialisations, such as dentistry, pediatrics, general medicine, surgery, etc. 

The university is approved by NMC (India), WHO, FAIMER, and ECFMG, making its MBBS (General Medicine) degree globally accepted and suitable for medical licensing exams like NExT, USMLE, and PLAB.

With over a century of excellence in medical education and healthcare research, Privolzhsky Research Medical University is a preferred destination for Indian students who wish to pursue MBBS in Russia.

It is recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) Act and is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). The University has several recognized standards, like NAAC, AICTE, DCI, MCI, PCI, or RPC, that assess its academic programs. NIMS University has achieved an NIRF ranking of 150-200 band in 2024, which shows its steady academic excellence.

Established under NIMS University, and is recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) and NIMS is affiliated with Rajasthan. It offers students MBBS, postgraduate (MD/MS), and doctoral applications in diverse scientific disciplines. 

NIMS College is located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, and it is one of the most reputed universities in India. NIMS College offers a wide range of courses like MBBS, MD, MS and super-school courses in many specializations. The MBBS in Rajasthan program follows the NMC guidelines and emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical clinical training. NIMS  Medical College, located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, is an important medical institute in India. The institute was established to provide good clinical training and healthcare services, and it is a renowned medical institute in higher education. 

The University is offering admissions for 2025 based on both merit-based and entrance-based processes. During this period, for many UG and PG courses, it is mandatory for the students to appear in the university examination, which is called NIMSEE. The institutions of Bihar are equipped with modern facilities, experienced faculty, and extensive clinical exposure, making them an attractive choice for aspiring medical professionals. There are 20 or more top medical colleges in Bihar. Of them, one college is owned by the government and four are owned by the private sector. 

All India Institute of Medical Sciences Patna, Patna Medical College and Hospital, Gopal Narayan Singh University, Mata Gujri Memorial Medical College, Katihar Medical College and Hospital, and numerous other institutions are among the best MBBS colleges in Bihar.

With a mix of prestigious government medical colleges and reputed private institutions, Bihar offers excellent opportunities for both Undergraduate (MBBS) and Postgraduate (MD/MS) medical aspirants. Cultural Richness

Studying MBBS in Bihar provides students with a rich cultural experience, helping them develop a broader perspective on life and society.

Strategic Location

Bihar’s central location in India makes it accessible from various parts of the country, with good connectivity via rail, road, and air.

Admission Criteria

To gain admission into an MBBS in Bihar, candidates must meet the following criteria:

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English. They should have secured a minimum of 50% aggregate marks (40% for reserved categories).

Entrance Exam

Candidates must qualify for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG). The NEET score is crucial for securing a seat in both government and private medical colleges.

Age Limit

The candidate must be at least 17 years old as of December 31 of the admission year. The upper age limit is 25 years for the general category and 30 years for reserved categories.

Types of MBBS Seats in Bihar

Government Quota Seats

These seats are available in government medical colleges and are filled based on the NEET-UG scores and the state counselling process.

Private seat

This refers to a seat that is offered in a private medical/dental college in Bihar. Both domicile and non-domicile candidates can apply for these seats.

Management Quota Seats

These are available in private medical colleges and are also filled based on NEET-UG scores, but the fees are higher compared to government quota seats.

NRI Quota Seats

Certain private colleges offer seats for Non-Resident Indians (NRIs), which have different fee structures and eligibility criteria.

Central Quota Seats

 These include seats in centrally funded institutions like AIIMS, which have their own admission process but also consider NEET-UG scores. 

How to Register for Bihar NEET UG Counseling

Registration

Visit the official website of BCECE and register for the counseling process by providing the necessary details and creating a login ID and password.

Payment of Counseling Fee

Pay the required counseling fee online through the provided payment gateway.

Choice Filling and Locking

After registration, log in using the credentials and fill in the choices of colleges and courses as per preference. Lock the choices before the deadline.

Seat Allotment

Based on the NEET-UG score and choices filled, seats will be allotted. Candidates can check their allotment status for MBBS in Bihar on the official website. 

Reporting to the Allotted College

Candidates must report to the allotted college within the specified time frame with all the required documents for verification and admission. 

Second-Round Counseling

If a candidate is not satisfied with the first-round allotment, they can participate in the second round of counseling.  

Salient Features of Bihar NEET Counseling

  1. In Round 1, students can exit the counseling process without any charges.
  2. The application form can be filled in Round 1 and Mop-up rounds.
  3. In Round 2, there is no fresh registration.
  4. Physical document verification is conducted after the seat allotment.
  5. It is mandatory for students to lock their choices in every round to be considered for the seat allotment process.
  6. Students who wish to participate in the Mop-up round must carry a demand draft of Rs 12 lakhs for MBBS and Rs 50,000 for BDS.
  7. 33% of the seats are reserved for female candidates.

title: Patan Academy of Health Science
content:
In 2008, the Patan Academy of Health Sciences Nepal was established. It is one of the accredited medical schools in Nepal and is located in Patan, Lalitpur. The national health system and Patan Medical College Nepal want to work closely together. The main teaching facility for the school, Patan facility, is where PAHS Nepal is headquartered.

Apply Now

The Patan Academy of Health Sciences was established to address the underlying causes of the violence that has wreaked havoc on Nepal for the past ten years by meeting the needs of the rural poor. The goal of the Patan Academy of Health Sciences is to bridge the gap between urban and rural communities, which will lay the groundwork for long-term peace in Nepal.

At the moment, the majority of medical schools in Nepal are for-profit, and training in medicine is extremely conventional. The problems with Nepal’s healthcare system are not sufficiently emphasized in medical schools, nor are students given a sense of social duty to improve healthcare for underserved groups. The Patan Academy of Health Sciences, in contrast, encourages its graduates to work to improve the health status of the rural poor through the use of extremely inventive ways.

Patan Academy of Health Sciences Ranking

Patan Medical College Nepal has achieved a notable standing, securing the 7th position in the context of its home country. On a global scale, the institution holds the 8432nd position, indicating its presence and recognition in the international academic landscape.

Study MBBS in Nepal

The MBBS program in Nepal typically follows a structured curriculum, and I’ve simplified the information you provided for easier understanding:

Academics of Patan Academy of Health Sciences

  • Duration: Four and a half years, followed by a 1-year compulsory residential rotating internship.
  • Language of Instruction: English

Preclinical Curriculum (Semesters 1-4)

  • First and second years include subjects like Anatomy, Microbiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, and Physiology.
  • These subjects are integrated and taught alongside Community Medicine and Introduction to Clinical Medicine.
  • Medical Informatics is integrated to provide computer expertise relevant to medical education.
  • University examinations are held at the end of the first and second years.
  • Students must complete all preclinical subjects within specified timeframes.

Clinical Sciences (Semesters 5-9)

  • Clinical subjects include Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, Ophthalmology, Medicine & Allied Subjects, Psychiatry, Dermatology, Radiology, Emergency Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, and other specialties.
  • Third-year university examinations are held for Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, and Ophthalmology.
  • A student cannot progress to the ninth semester without passing these subjects.
  • Ninth semester includes final university examinations in Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Pediatrics.

Evaluation

  • Continuous evaluation is conducted through fortnightly tests, semester exams, end-posting evaluations, seminars, and problem-based learning sessions.
  • The continuous evaluation system contributes to excellent results in university examinations.

Teaching Methodology

  • Preclinical teaching includes didactic classroom lectures, practical sessions, problem-based learning (PBL) sessions, and community/hospital visits.
  • Seminars and PBLs are conducted every fortnight to provide clinical orientation.
  • Clinical teaching involves practical training in hospitals, community visits, symposia, seminars, clinical meetings, faculty talks, and guest lectures.
  • An emphasis is placed on clinical practical training.

Internship

  • A one-year rotating internship is compulsory.
  • Different internship schemes are approved for students from various countries.
  • Internships can be completed in Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Australia, USA, UK, and South Africa.
  • Internship rules are subject to change based on the regulations of the Medical Council of Nepal.

Admission Procedure For Patan Academy of Health Sciences

  • Application forms for admission into medical colleges in Nepal are typically available in September/October.
  • Applicants can collect these forms from authorized centers in India and abroad.
  • The filled application form should be accompanied by various documents, including a passport or Aadhar card, a recent passport-size photo, and attested copies of 10th and 12th-grade mark sheets.
  • An application fee of INR 5000 payable to the Medical Education Commission, Nepal, is required.
  • If applying for direct admission based on NEET scores, candidates need to include their NEET scorecard.

Notes:

  • The MEC entrance exam is conducted only in Nepal, so applicants from other countries need to travel there to take the exam.
  • If there are more applicants through the MEC entrance examination compared to direct NEET admission, priority will be given to candidates who have qualified through the entrance exam.

Eligibility Criteria For Patan Academy of Health Sciences

Admission to medical colleges MBBS in Nepal for Indian students follows two main pathways: one through an entrance examination conducted by the Medical Education Commission (MEC) and the other through direct admission based on NEET scores for Indian students. Here’s a simplified explanation:

title: NEET 2026 Syllabus PDF – Subject Wise Breakdown
content:
The NEET 2026 syllabus is based on NCERT Class 11 and 12 and includes updated topics released by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Get the official PDF, subject-wise syllabus, high-weight chapters, exam pattern, and preparation tips to plan well for the Physics, Chemistry, and Biology exams.

NEET 2026 syllabus: NEET is a national-level medical entrance exam for students who wish to pursue medical courses after completing Class 12. The NEET UG 2026 syllabus has been officially released by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

To score well, candidates should start their preparation with a clear understanding of the syllabus. This article provides the latest updates and a detailed subject-wise overview of the NEET 2026 syllabus for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, to help students plan their studies well.

Why Download Latest NEET Syllabus?

  • Covers updated topics by NTA

Downloading the latest NEET syllabus is important because NTA makes some changes every year. An updated syllabus lets you know exactly which topics are included and what pattern questions may follow. This helps you steer your preparation in the right direction.

  • Helps avoid studying deleted chapters

If you follow the old syllabus, you may waste time on unnecessary or deleted chapters. The latest syllabus ensures that you study only topics that are relevant to the exam, saving you valuable time.

  • Improves exam strategy

Having a clear syllabus allows you to create a smart study plan. You can identify your strong and weak topics and focus on them. This also makes revision and mock test planning easier, which improves overall exam strategy.

  • Essential for Toppers’ Preparation

Toppers always follow the updated syllabus. If you’re aiming for a top rank, preparing according to the latest syllabus is essential. This gives you a competitive edge and prevents unnecessary confusion.

NEET 2026 Syllabus (NTA Official Update)

The NEET 2026 syllabus is primarily based on the NCERT textbooks for Classes 11 and 12, covering Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released an updated version, removing some old topics and adding new ones.

These changes reflect the latest academic standards and syllabus changes in the NCERT framework. This updated syllabus is crucial for effective exam preparation.

NEET 2026 Subject-Wise Syllabus

The chapter-wise weightage of NEET 2026 helps students understand which chapters of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology are most important based on previous year papers. The National Medical Commission does not officially release the chapter-wise marks distribution, but trends from previous NEET exams clearly indicate that certain chapters are frequently asked and have higher scoring potential.

Focusing on the chapters with higher weightage can help you prepare smarter. This will improve your accuracy, time management, and can also increase your overall exam score.

Subject

High Weightage Chapters

Approx. Question Share (Trend-Based)

Biology

Human Physiology, Genetics & Evolution, Ecology, Cell Biology, Biotechnology, Plant Physiology

45–50% of Biology section

Chemistry

35–40% of Chemistry section

Physics

Modern Physics, Current Electricity, Optics, Electrostatics, Mechanics (Laws of Motion, Work-Energy)

40–45% of Physics section

High Weightage Chapters for NEET 2026

Based on an analysis of trends from previous years, certain chapters consistently receive higher weighting in the NEET exam. For NEET UG 2026, certain chapters in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology receive higher weighting and are frequently asked in the exam. Focusing on these topics can significantly improve your score and rank.

Physics 

  • Mechanics (Laws of Motion, Work, Energy & Power)
  • Current Electricity
  • Electrostatics
  • Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism
  • Optics (Ray & Wave Optics)
  • Modern Physics (Atoms, Nuclei, Semiconductors)
  • Thermodynamics & Heat

Chemistry

  • Mole Concept
  • Thermodynamics
  • Chemical Equilibrium
  • Electrochemistry
  • Solutions & Colligative Properties

Organic Chemistry

  • Hydrocarbons
  • Alcohols, Phenols & Ethers
  • Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids
  • Biomolecules
  • Organic Reaction Mechanisms

Inorganic Chemistry

  • Chemical Bonding
  • Coordination Compounds
  • Periodic Table & Periodicity
  • p-Block Elements
  • d- and f-Block Elements

Biology 

Class 11

  • Human Physiology (Digestion, Respiration, Circulation, Nervous System)
  • Cell Structure & Function
  • Plant Physiology
  • Biomolecules
  • Diversity in Living World

Class 12

  • Genetics & Evolution
  • Biotechnology (Principles & Applications)
  • Human Reproduction
  • Reproductive Health
  • Ecology & Environment
  • Biology in Human Welfare

Note: These chapters are frequently required in the NEET exam. However, candidates should not skip the entire syllabus, as NEET questions can be conceptual and interconnected.

NEET 2026 Deleted Syllabus: Physics

The National Medical Commission (NMC) has released the NEET UG 2026 syllabus, confirming that it follows the NCERT-based structure. Previous changes included removing several topics from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology to reduce overlap and simplify preparation. These removed topics will also apply to NEET 2026.

  • Physics & Measurement: Topics like scope of physics, nature of laws, and accuracy/precision basics have been removed.
  • Kinematics: Basic concepts of differentiation/integration and some vector-related portions are deleted.
  • Laws of Motion: Lubrication and equilibrium of concurrent forces are no longer included.
  • Rotational Motion: Conservation of momentum and center of mass of a uniform rod are removed.
  • Properties of Solids/Liquids: Shear, modulus of rigidity, Poisson’s ratio, Reynolds number, Black Body Radiation, and Newton’s law of cooling are deleted.
  • Thermodynamics: Heat engines and refrigerators are excluded.
  • Current Electricity: Potentiometer and carbon resistors (color coding) are removed.
  • Magnetism: Cyclotron and Earth’s magnetic field topics are deleted.
  • Optics: Optical instruments, eye defects, and wave-front-based reflection are removed.
  • Electronic Devices: Junction transistor, transistor action, and oscillators are no longer part of the syllabus.

Chemistry

  • Physical/Inorganic: Environmental Chemistry and Metallurgy are completely removed; parts of Solid State and States of Matter are reduced; Hydrogen chapter is also trimmed.
  • Organic: Polymers and Chemistry in Everyday Life are fully deleted; nitrogen compounds like cyanides/isocyanides are removed.
  • Practical Chemistry: Detection of functional groups is excluded.

Biology

  • Transport in Plants
  • Mineral Nutrition
  • Digestion and Absorption (some portions)
  • Certain Ecology-based descriptive topics
  • Selected reproduction-related subtopics

Total Chapters in NEET 2026: Subject-wise Breakdown

The total number of chapters for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in NEET 2026 is estimated to be approximately 87–97. This number is based on the updated syllabus and recent changes in NCERT. Understanding this breakdown helps students plan their study schedule for all NEET subjects. This overview of the NEET exam syllabus 2026 ensures balanced coverage.

NEET 2026 will be offline (pen-and-paper) and will consist of 180 compulsory MCQs from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. The total exam will carry 720 marks.

How to Prepare Using NEET 2026 Syllabus

Using the NEET 2026 syllabus correctly is the foundation of smart preparation. First, understand the syllabus thoroughly and create a study plan accordingly. You should know which topics are important and how much time to devote to each subject. Maintaining consistency is crucial, otherwise completing the syllabus becomes difficult. Without regular practice and revision, retention can diminish. Therefore, studying and revising a little bit every day is the best strategy. Focusing on the syllabus improves both your confidence and performance.

  • Focus on NCERT: NEET preparation is based on NCERT books, especially for Biology. You should read NCERT books line by line and highlight important points. Most questions come directly or indirectly from NCERT, so ignoring them can be risky.
  • Practice PYQs: Solving previous year questions (PYQs) is crucial. This helps you understand the exam pattern and understand which topics are most frequently asked. Regular practice improves both your speed and accuracy.
  • Revise Important Chapters: Studying alone is not enough; revision is equally important. To keep concepts clear and avoid confusion during the exam, revise your heavyweight and weak topics repeatedly. Making short notes is very helpful here.
  • Create a Timetable: Creating and following a proper study timetable builds discipline. Allocate equal time to each subject and set daily goals. The timetable should be realistic so that you can follow it regularly.

Conclusion

The NEET 2026 syllabus is the foundation of your exam preparation, helping you focus on the right topics and avoid unnecessary study. By following the official NTA syllabus, you can streamline your strategy, prioritize important chapters, and improve your overall performance. Make sure to download the latest subject-wise and chapter-wise PDF and align your study plan accordingly. Consistent revision, practice, and clarity of concepts will give you an edge in the competition. Stay dedicated and start early to maximize your chances of success. AR Group of Education is your trusted partner, guiding you at every step of your NEET journey.

The college’s reviews and reputation are closely tied to its ranking, making it a preferred choice for medical education.

Study MBBS in Nepal

The MBBS program in Nepal typically follows a structured curriculum, and I’ve simplified the information you provided for easier understanding:

Academics of Chitwan Medical College

  • Duration: Four and a half years, followed by a 1-year compulsory residential rotating internship.
  • Language of Instruction: English

Preclinical Curriculum (Semesters 1-4)

  • First and second years include subjects like Anatomy, Microbiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, and Physiology.
  • These subjects are integrated and taught alongside Community Medicine and Introduction to Clinical Medicine.
  • Medical Informatics is integrated to provide computer expertise relevant to medical education.
  • University examinations are held at the end of the first and second years.
  • Students must complete all preclinical subjects within specified timeframes.

Clinical Sciences (Semesters 5-9)

  • Clinical subjects include Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, Ophthalmology, Medicine & Allied Subjects, Psychiatry, Dermatology, Radiology, Emergency Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, and other specialties.
  • Third-year university examinations are held for Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, and Ophthalmology.
  • A student cannot progress to the ninth semester without passing these subjects.
  • Ninth semester includes final university examinations in Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Pediatrics.

Evaluation

  • Continuous evaluation is conducted through fortnightly tests, semester exams, end-posting evaluations, seminars, and problem-based learning sessions.
  • The continuous evaluation system contributes to excellent results in university examinations.

Teaching Methodology

  • Preclinical teaching includes didactic classroom lectures, practical sessions, problem-based learning (PBL) sessions, and community/hospital visits.
  • Seminars and PBLs are conducted every fortnight to provide clinical orientation.
  • Clinical teaching involves practical training in hospitals, community visits, symposia, seminars, clinical meetings, faculty talks, and guest lectures.
  • An emphasis is placed on clinical practical training.

Internship

  • A one-year rotating internship is compulsory.
  • Different internship schemes are approved for students from various countries.
  • Internships can be completed in Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Australia, USA, UK, and South Africa.
  • Internship rules are subject to change based on the regulations of the Medical Council of Nepal.

Admission Procedure For Chitwan Medical College

  • Application forms for admission into medical colleges in Nepal are typically available in September/October.
  • Applicants can collect these forms from authorized centers in India and abroad.
  • The filled application form should be accompanied by various documents, including a passport or Aadhar card, a recent passport-size photo, and attested copies of 10th and 12th-grade mark sheets.
  • An application fee of INR 5000 payable to the Medical Education Commission, Nepal, is required.
  • If applying for direct admission based on NEET scores, candidates need to include their NEET scorecard.

Notes:

  • The MEC entrance exam is conducted only in Nepal, so applicants from other countries need to travel there to take the exam.
  • If there are more applicants through the MEC entrance examination compared to direct NEET admission, priority will be given to candidates who have qualified through the entrance exam.

Eligibility Criteria For Chitwan Medical College

Admission to medical colleges MBBS in Nepal for Indian students follows two main pathways: one through an entrance examination conducted by the Medical Education Commission (MEC) and the other through direct admission based on NEET scores for Indian students. Here’s a simplified explanation:

Direct Admission Through NEET Scores for Indian Students:

  • Indian students seeking direct admission to private medical colleges in Nepal can do so based on their NEET scores.
  • The MBBS course duration is 4.5 years, followed by a 1-year internship.
  • Eligibility criteria include passing 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology with a 50% aggregate or equivalent grades from certificate-level programs.
  • Candidates should be at least 17 years old by the application deadline.

Admission Through MEC Entrance Examination:

  • Students interested in studying MBBS in specific Nepalese institutions like BP Koirala Institute of Health Science, Dharan Institute of Medical Science, Patan Academy of Health Science, Kamali Academy of Health Science, Nepalese Army Institute of Health Science, and Kathmandu University School of Medical Science need to take the MEC entrance examination.
  • To qualify, candidates must score a minimum of 50% in this entrance exam.
  • Only NEET scores from the current academic year will be considered for admission.
  • The minimum NEET score required for general category candidates will determine their eligibility.

  • 10th mark sheet and certificate.
  • 12th mark sheet and certificate.
  • Birth certificate
  • 10th passport-size photographs
  • Official invitation letter from the Chitwan Medical College.
  • Verified documents from the Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi
  • Verified documents by the Nepal Embassy.

  • Bank receipt of the paid tuition fee of 1st year.

  • The MBBS program has a duration of five and a half years, aligning with the NMC guidelines.
  • Instruction in the program is conducted in English, eliminating the need to learn an additional language unlike many overseas universities.
  • Admission to medical colleges in Nepal, including Chitwan Medical College, does not require IELTS.
  • The approximate cost of pursuing an MBBS degree from Chitwan Medical College is around Rs 60 Lakhs.

A group of 1200 professionals in several fields manages and operates the Institute of Medicine. The institution provides 104 postgraduate programmes and 280 undergraduate courses in the medical area. All of the Institute of Medicine’s courses are available to students with their desired criteria. The levels of the courses can be undergraduate, graduate, or doctoral. Institute of Medicine Nepal Ranking

Institute of Medicine Nepal’s position in the world is well known. They are without a doubt regarded as one of Nepal’s top medical schools. They have a lot to offer the students, including a safe and healthy campus as well as lodging and dining facilities. They have always given their students the greatest care available and have always been worried about their safety.

The Institute of Medicine Nepal is ranked 58 overall and 3778 globally. They make every effort to provide their pupils with the greatest education they can. The institute offers the top Ph. D, post-graduate, and graduation programs for students. Additionally, they have a lot of connections to reputable hospitals that provide the best training for pupils.

Study MBBS in Nepal

The MBBS program in Nepal typically follows a structured curriculum, and I’ve simplified the information you provided for easier understanding:

Academics of Institute of Medicine Kathmandu

  • Duration: Four and a half years, followed by a 1-year compulsory residential rotating internship.
  • Language of Instruction: English

Preclinical Curriculum (Semesters 1-4)

  • First and second years include subjects like Anatomy, Microbiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, and Physiology.
  • These subjects are integrated and taught alongside Community Medicine and Introduction to Clinical Medicine.
  • Medical Informatics is integrated to provide computer expertise relevant to medical education.
  • University examinations are held at the end of the first and second years.
  • Students must complete all preclinical subjects within specified timeframes.

Clinical Sciences (Semesters 5-9)

  • Clinical subjects include Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, Ophthalmology, Medicine & Allied Subjects, Psychiatry, Dermatology, Radiology, Emergency Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, and other specialties.
  • Third-year university examinations are held for Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, and Ophthalmology.
  • A student cannot progress to the ninth semester without passing these subjects.
  • Ninth semester includes final university examinations in Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Pediatrics.

Evaluation

  • Continuous evaluation is conducted through fortnightly tests, semester exams, end-posting evaluations, seminars, and problem-based learning sessions.
  • The continuous evaluation system contributes to excellent results in university examinations.

Teaching Methodology

  • Preclinical teaching includes didactic classroom lectures, practical sessions, problem-based learning (PBL) sessions, and community/hospital visits.
  • Seminars and PBLs are conducted every fortnight to provide clinical orientation.
  • Clinical teaching involves practical training in hospitals, community visits, symposia, seminars, clinical meetings, faculty talks, and guest lectures.
  • An emphasis is placed on clinical practical training.

Internship

  • A one-year rotating internship is compulsory.
  • Different internship schemes are approved for students from various countries.
  • Internships can be completed in Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Australia, USA, UK, and South Africa.
  • Internship rules are subject to change based on the regulations of the Medical Council of Nepal.

Admission Procedure For Institute of Medicine Kathmandu

  • Application forms for admission into medical colleges in Nepal are typically available in September/October.
  • Applicants can collect these forms from authorized centers in India and abroad.
  • The filled application form should be accompanied by various documents, including a passport or Aadhar card, a recent passport-size photo, and attested copies of 10th and 12th-grade mark sheets.
  • An application fee of INR 5000 payable to the Medical Education Commission, Nepal, is required.
  • If applying for direct admission based on NEET scores, candidates need to include their NEET scorecard.

Notes:

  • The MEC entrance exam is conducted only in Nepal, so applicants from other countries need to travel there to take the exam.
  • If there are more applicants through the MEC entrance examination compared to direct NEET admission, priority will be given to candidates who have qualified through the entrance exam.

Eligibility Criteria For Institute of Medicine Kathmandu

Admission to medical colleges MBBS in Nepal for Indian students follows two main pathways: one through an entrance examination conducted by the Medical Education Commission (MEC) and the other through direct admission based on NEET scores for Indian students. Here’s a simplified explanation:

Direct Admission Through NEET Scores for Indian Students:

  • Indian students seeking direct admission to private medical colleges in Nepal can do so based on their NEET scores.
  • The MBBS course duration is 4.5 years, followed by a 1-year internship.
  • Eligibility criteria include passing 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology with a 50% aggregate or equivalent grades from certificate-level programs.
  • Candidates should be at least 17 years old by the application deadline.

Admission Through MEC Entrance Examination:

  • Students interested in studying MBBS in specific Nepalese institutions like BP Koirala Institute of Health Science, Dharan Institute of Medical Science, Patan Academy of Health Science, Kamali Academy of Health Science, Nepalese Army Institute of Health Science, and Kathmandu University School of Medical Science need to take the MEC entrance examination.
  • To qualify, candidates must score a minimum of 50% in this entrance exam.
  • Only NEET scores from the current academic year will be considered for admission.
  • The minimum NEET score required for general category candidates will determine their eligibility.

These encompass a dedicated medical center to address health concerns, a comprehensive library to support academic research, a spacious auditorium for various events and gatherings, comfortable hostel options for accommodation, advanced computer labs for technology-driven learning, sports facilities to promote physical well-being, a convenient cafeteria for dining, and well-equipped laboratories for practical experiments and research. title: Siberian State Medical University Russia 2026-27 | Courses, Fees, Admission
content:
Siberian State Medical University (SibMed) is one of Russia’s oldest and most prestigious medical institutions, established in 1878. Located in Tomsk, it is a top-ranked university known for its cutting-edge research, international education standards, and English-medium MBBS programmes. The university is approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and the World Health Organisation (WHO), making it a preferred choice among Indian students aspiring to study MBBS abroad.

The university offers a 6-year programme in medicine for domestic and international students. The university offers quality education at low cost. Students across continents and 12 countries try to land a seat in this university each year. More than 60,000 pharmacists, doctors and medical specialists have graduated from this university. The university enrols around 4,000 students each year. Siberian State Medical University is recognised by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation.

In 2015 SibMed became the first medical university in Russia to be accredited by the Skolkovo Technopark. the other recognitions include that of the World Directory Of Medical Schools (WDOMS), Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), Foundation for Advancement of International Medical Education and Research (FAIMER), World Federation for Medical Education (WFME), erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI)/National Medical Commission (NMC), etc.

title: Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital
content:
Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital (GDIMS) is a premier medical education and healthcare institution located in West Bengal. Established in 2016 with the mission to provide quality medical education and healthcare services, GDIMS has rapidly become one of the top choices for aspiring doctors in the region. 

The institute is affiliated with the West Bengal University of Health Sciences (WBUHS) and is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). With state-of-the-art infrastructure, experienced faculty, and a commitment to excellence, GDIMS offers a nurturing environment for medical students and serves as a vital healthcare provider for the local community.

The combination of academic excellence and practical experience ensures that students at Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital are well-prepared to meet the challenges of the medical profession.

Highlights 2024

Vision and Mission

The vision of Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital is to create a center of excellence in medical education, research, and healthcare. The institution aims to produce competent, compassionate, and ethical medical professionals who will contribute to society’s well-being.

The mission of GDIMS includes:

  • Offering high-quality medical education and training.
  • Promoting research and innovation in the medical field.
  • Providing comprehensive healthcare services to the community.
  • Upholding the highest standards of ethics and professionalism.

Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital Courses Offered

MBBS Program

The MBBS program at Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital is a five-and-a-half-year course, including a one-year compulsory rotating internship. The curriculum is designed as per the guidelines of the Medical Council of India (MCI) and aims to provide a strong foundation in the basic sciences, clinical skills, and community health.

Key Features:

  • Duration: 5.5 years (including 1-year internship)
  • Total Seats: 150
  • Eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English; NEET UG qualification
  • Admission Process: Based on NEET UG scores, followed by centralized counseling conducted by WBUHS.

Postgraduate Programs (MD/MS)

GDIMS offers a variety of postgraduate courses in different medical specializations. These programs are designed to provide in-depth knowledge and training in the chosen field of study.

Key Features:

  • Specializations: Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, Microbiology, etc.
  • Duration: 3 years
  • Eligibility: MBBS degree with internship completion; NEET PG qualification
  • Admission Process: Based on NEET PG scores and counseling conducted by WBUHS. 

Nursing and Allied Health Sciences

The institute also offers programs in nursing and allied health sciences, catering to the growing demand for healthcare professionals.

  • B.Sc. Nursing
  • Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)
  • Diploma in Radiology Technology (DRT)
  • Diploma in Operation Theatre Technology (DOTT)

Infrastructure and Facilities at GDIMSH

Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital boasts a sprawling 25-acre campus equipped with modern infrastructure and facilities that cater to both educational and healthcare needs. 

  • Lecture Halls: The institute has spacious, well-ventilated lecture halls equipped with audio-visual aids for effective teaching.
  • Library: The central library is stocked with a vast collection of medical books, journals, and digital resources, providing students and faculty with access to the latest information and research.
  • Laboratories: State-of-the-art laboratories for subjects like anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, and microbiology ensure that students get hands-on training and experience.
  • Simulation Center: A modern simulation center allows students to practice clinical skills in a controlled environment before they interact with real patients.

Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities

  • Gouri Devi Hospital: A 700+-bed multi-specialty teaching hospital is attached to the institute, providing clinical training to students. The hospital is equipped with advanced medical technology and offers a wide range of services, including emergency care, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, and internal medicine.
  • Outpatient Department (OPD): The OPD serves thousands of patients daily, offering consultation and treatment across various specialties.
  • Emergency Services: The hospital has a well-equipped emergency department that operates 24/7 to handle critical cases.
  • Diagnostic Facilities: The hospital features advanced diagnostic facilities, including radiology, pathology, and laboratory services.

Hostel and Accommodation

Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital provides comfortable and secure hostel accommodation for both male and female students. The hostels are equipped with all necessary amenities, including:

  • Rooms: Well-furnished single and double occupancy rooms.
  • Mess Facility: Hygienic and nutritious food is served in the mess, with separate arrangements for vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals.
  • Recreational Facilities: common rooms, TV, indoor games, and gymnasium for relaxation and fitness.
  • Security: 24/7 security commonl and CCTV surveillance ensure a safe living environment.
  • Auditorium: A large auditorium with a seating capacity of over 500 for seminars, conferences, and cultural events.
  • Cafeteria: A cafeteria that serves a variety of snacks and meals throughout the day.
  • Transport: The institute provides transportation facilities for students and staff, including buses and ambulances.
  • Sports and Recreation: Facilities for outdoor sports like cricket, football, and volleyball, as well as indoor games like table tennis and chess.
  • Medical Services: On-campus medical services are available for students and staff, including a dispensary and first-aid center.

Faculty and Departments at Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital

MBBS In West Bengal – Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital prides itself on its highly qualified and experienced faculty. The faculty members are not only involved in teaching but also actively participate in research and clinical services.

The departments are well organized, each headed by senior professors with vast experience in their respective fields.

Key Departments:

  • Department of Anatomy
  • Department of Physiology
  • Department of Biochemistry
  • Department of Pharmacology
  • Department of Pathology
  • Department of Microbiology
  • Department of Forensic Medicine
  • Department of Community Medicine
  • Department of General Medicine
  • Department of Surgery
  • Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology
  • Department of Pediatrics
  • Department of Anesthesiology
  • Department of Radiology

Admission Process

MBBS Admission

The admission process for the MBBS program at Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital is based on the NEET UG examination. The steps involved are:

  1. Qualify NEET UG: Aspiring candidates must appear for the NEET UG exam and secure a qualifying score.
  2. Counseling: Based on the NEET UG score, candidates must participate in the counseling process conducted by WBUHS.
  3. Seat Allotment: Seats are allotted based on merit and preferences filled by the candidates during counseling.
  4. Document Verification: After seat allotment, candidates must report to the institute for document verification and fee payment.
  5. Admission Confirmation: Final admission is confirmed after the completion of all formalities and payment of fees.

Postgraduate Admission (MD/MS)

Admission to MD/MS programs is through the NEET PG examination. The process is similar to the MBBS admission but involves NEET PG counseling.

Documents required

  • 10th or 12th class results 
  • NEET scorecard
  • ID Proof
  • Offer letter provided by university
  • Birth certificate
  • Migration certificate

Fees for nursing and allied health sciences programs vary based on the course and duration. Generally, the annual tuition fee ranges between INR 50,000 and 1,00,000.

Scholarships and Financial Assistance

Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital offers various scholarships and financial aid options to deserving and economically challenged students. These include:

  • Merit-Based Scholarships: Awarded to students with exceptional academic performance.
  • Need-Based Scholarships: Provided to students from economically weaker sections.
  • Government Scholarships: Various state and central government scholarships are available for SC/ST/OBC and minority students.
  • Educational Loans: The institute has tie-ups with several banks to facilitate educational loans at concessional rates.

Placements and Career Opportunities

GDIMS has a dedicated placement cell that assists students in securing internships and job placements in reputed hospitals and healthcare institutions. The placement cell organizes workshops, seminars, and mock interviews to prepare students for the competitive job market.

Career Opportunities for MBBS Graduates:

  • Residency Programs: After completing the MBBS program, students can pursue residency programs in various specialties to become specialists or consultants.
  • Private Practice: Graduates can start their clinics or join private hospitals as junior doctors.
  • Government Jobs: MBBS graduates are eligible for various government healthcare jobs through state and central recruitment exams.
  • Research and Academics: Graduates interested in academics and research can join medical colleges as faculty members or research scholars.

Research and Development

GDIMS encourages research and innovation among its students and faculty. The institute has a research cell that facilitates research activities, including clinical trials, community health projects, and biomedical research. The faculty and students regularly publish research papers in national and international journals.

Campus Life

Life at Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital is vibrant and enriching. The institute provides a conducive environment for holistic development through various extracurricular and co-curricular activities.

Cultural and social activities

  • Annual Fest: The institute hosts an annual fest that includes cultural programs, sports events, and academic competitions, fostering camaraderie and team spirit among students.
  • Student Clubs: Various student clubs, including literary, cultural, and sports clubs, offer opportunities for students to pursue their interests and talents.
  • Community Outreach: The institute regularly organizes health camps, awareness programs, and blood donation drives as part of its social responsibility.

Sports and Recreation

  • Sports Facilities: GDIMS provides facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports, including cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, and table tennis.
  • Gymnasium: A well-equipped gymnasium is available for students to maintain their fitness and well-being.

Prospects and expansion plans

GDIMS is committed to continuous improvement and expansion. The institute plans to increase its intake capacity for MBBS and postgraduate courses, introduce new specializations, and expand its hospital facilities to cater to more patients. 

The Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital also aims to enhance its research capabilities and collaborate with national and international institutions for academic exchange and research projects.

This comprehensive guide should provide you with all the essential information regarding Gouri Devi Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital, helping you make an informed decision about your medical education journey. The institute is affiliated with the West Bengal University of Health Sciences and recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and the World Health Organization (WHO). SRIMS is part of the Sanaka Group of Institutions, which is renowned for its contribution to education in various fields.  

SRIMS offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in medicine, focusing on the holistic development of students through a blend of academic excellence, practical training, and research opportunities. 

The Shri Ramkrishna Institute of Medical Sciences is well-equipped with modern infrastructure, state-of-the-art laboratories, and an attached multi-specialty hospital, Sanaka Hospitals, which serves as a teaching hospital, providing students with hands-on clinical experience.

Popular Programs at SRIMS

Shri Ramkrishna Institute of Medical Sciences offers a variety of medical programs, catering to the needs of aspiring doctors and healthcare professionals. Some of the popular programs include:

  2. MD (Doctor of Medicine): Postgraduate specialization in various disciplines such as general medicine, pediatrics, and more. This program is typically of 3 years and focuses on advanced medical training.
  3. MS (Master of Surgery): A postgraduate surgical program that offers specializations in fields like general surgery, orthopedics, etc. The duration of this program is also 3 years.
  4. B.Sc. Nursing: A 4-year undergraduate program aimed at training students in the art and science of nursing, preparing them for various roles in healthcare. 

Eligibility Criteria for SRIMS

The eligibility criteria for admission to Sanaka Hospital, West Bengal are as follows:

MBBS Program:

  • Candidates must have completed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects.
  • The minimum aggregate marks required are 50% for general category students and 40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates.
  • Candidates must qualify for the NEET-UG examination and participate in the centralized counseling process.

MD/MS Programs:

  • Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a recognized medical college.
  • They must have completed a 1-year compulsory rotating internship.
  • Admission is based on the NEET-PG examination, followed by counseling.

Shri Ramkrishna Institute of Medical Sciences and Sanaka Hospitals Application Process

The application process for SRIMS is straightforward and is done through the centralized counseling system. Candidates must follow these steps:

  1. Visit the Official Website: Candidates should visit the official SRIMS website and access the application form for their desired program.
  2. Fill in the application form: Enter all required personal, educational, and contact details accurately.
  3. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of required documents, including NEET scorecards, mark sheets, and identity proof.
  4. Pay Application Fee: Pay the non-refundable application fee online through the provided payment gateway.
  5. Submit the Form: Review the application and submit it. Take a printout of the application form for future reference.
  6. Follow Up: Keep an eye on the website or registered email for updates on counseling and admission procedures.

title: NEET College Predictor 2026: Forecast early to know which college to secure your MBBS seat
content:
Predict Your Rank Here

The NEET College Predictor 2026 is an useful tool designed to help MBBS aspirants predict their chances of admission into top private and private-public medical colleges in India based on their NEET scores. 

This predictor analyzes previous years’ NEET cutoff data for 548 MBBS colleges to provide candidates with suitable college options. It uses opening and closing ranks from NEET counselling conducted by MCC for 15% AIQ seats and respective state authorities for 85% state quota seats. 

NEET 2026 exam is on 3rd May 2026 . NEET qualifying percentile is 50 for General category and 40 for reserved categories. The NEET 2025 cutoff was 686–144 for General/EWS and 129-105 for reserved categories. Only candidates meeting the qualifying cutoff will be eligible for counseling.

After the NEET 2026 result, candidates can use the predictor and enter their scores to check expected college allotment. This will help them plan better for counseling by analyzing chances of getting into preferred private/private-public MBBS colleges based on previous years’ cutoff trends. The predictor will be updated with the latest NEET 2026 cutoff once released.

Estimate Your Rank with NEET College Predictor 2026

title: NEET Exam 2026
content:
NEET 2026: Don’t Miss Your Chance to Become a Doctor – Get Complete Updates, Dates & Strategy Now!

The NEET Exam 2026 is the gateway to pursue MBBS in India. The nationwide exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) is your chance to secure a seat in MBBS, BDS, and other medical courses across the country. Aspiring doctors and dentists of India, mark your calendars! The National Eligibility and Entrance Test (NEET) is around the corner, and this year holds some crucial updates you must be aware of.  Let’s break it down:

What is the NEET?

NEET is a single national entrance exam for admission to undergraduate medical (MBBS), dental (BDS), and AYUSH courses in government and private institutions across India. It’s also mandatory to pursue these qualifications abroad.

Updates Regarding NEET Exam Registration

NEET Exam registration forms have been released as of February 8, 2026. NTA  releases the official notification for the NEET Application Form on the official website, i.e., exam.nta.ac.in. As per the latest notification, the last submission date for the application form is March 11, 2026. 

There is no age limit for the NEET exam 2026, and there is also no limit to the number of attempts. Eligible candidates can assess the NEET Exam application form in 2026. The NTA released the syllabus for the exam, and the good thing is that the syllabus has been reduced from 97 chapters to 79 chapters

NEET Exam 2026 Highlights

NEET exam details are summarized in the table below. Candidates can complete every exam component.

NEET Exam 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Here’s a summary of the NEET eligibility criteria for 2026:

Educational Qualification:

  • Must have completed (or appeared for) the 12th or equivalent exam.
  • Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English are major subjects.
  • Minimum 50% aggregate marks in physics, chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology for the general category.
  • Minimum 40% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWD category.
  • Must have passed individually in all four subjects mentioned above.

Age:

  • Candidates should be at least 17 years old by December 31, 2024.
  • There is no upper age limit.

Nationality:

  • Indian Nationals, NRIs, OCIs, PIOs, and international citizens are eligible.

Additional notes:

  • It is now mandatory for all Indian citizens who want to pursue medicine abroad to qualify for NEET UG 2026.
  • Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are now part of the 15% All India Quota scheme.
  • A new section on ethics, integrity, and aptitude in medical practice has been introduced in the NEET 2024 exam.

NEET Exam 2026 Application Process

The NEET 2026 application process is currently open and will close on March 11, 2026. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to apply:

Step 1: Registration

  • Visit the official NEET website: https://neet.nta.nic.in/ for the NEET registration date.
  • Click on "New Registration" under the "Apply Online" link.
  • Read the instructions carefully and select the checkbox.
  • Click on the "Proceed" option.
  • Fill out the registration form with your details, such as name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth, gender, nationality, category, etc.
  • Click on "Preview and Submit.".
  • Verify the details and click on "Next.".
  • You will receive an application number and password for your registered mobile number and email ID.

Step 2: Application Form Filling

  • Log in to the website using your application number and password.
  • Fill out the application form with details such as your educational qualifications, exam medium, exam city preference, etc.
  • Upload your photograph and signature in the prescribed format.

Step 3: Document Upload

  • Upload scanned copies of your educational certificates, ID proof, category certificate (if applicable), and PwD certificate (if applicable).
  • Make sure the documents are clear and legible.

Step 4: Fee Payment

  • Pay the application fee online using a credit/debit card, net banking, Paytm, or UPI.
  • The application fee varies depending on your category.

Step 5: Submit the Application Form

  • Review your application form carefully before submitting it.
  • Once submitted, you cannot make any changes to the form.

Important points to remember:

  • The last date to submit the application form is March 9, 2024.
  • The exam will be conducted on May 5, 2024, in 13 languages.

NEET Exam 2026 Syllabus

The National Medical Commission (NMC) released the official NEET syllabus 2026 on October 6, 2025. It covers three major subjects: physics, chemistry, and biology. To deepen your knowledge, download the NEET syllabus for 2026 . 

Download Here: NEET Syllabus 2026

Key Points:

  • No changes in syllabus for 2027: The announced syllabus for 2026 will remain valid for the 2027 exam as well.
  • Focus on Class 11 & 12: Most topics are from CBSE Class 11 & 12 NCERT textbooks.
  • Some deletions from Biology: Digestion and Absorption, along with other chapters, were removed from the Biology section.
  • Total Marks & Questions: 180 marks and 50 questions each for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (45 questions to be attempted).

How to Prepare for the NEET Exam 2026?

NEET exam preparation should start well in advance since the competition is quite high. With approx. 26 lakh students for the NEET examination, we must ensure hard work and practice to crack the exam. Candidates can refer to the tips that are provided below so that they can get a good score.

  • Applicants should carefully review the exam pattern and syllabus before preparing for the NEET exam. 
  • Make a study plan or strategy and write short notes for easy understanding. 
  • Solve & analyze the previous year’s question papers. 
  • Practice with NCERT book 11 or 12 in class, which is very important. Around 70-80% of questions are directly related to NCERT books. 
  • Maintain the proper balance between NEET practices and other activities. 
  • Do a lot of exercise with mock tests 
  • Students should need to invest the last two years in NEET preparation.

NEET Exam Pattern 2026

Exam Mode: Pen and Paper Based (Offline)

Duration: 3 hours, 20 minutes

Total Marks: 720

Number of Questions: 200 (Physics: 50, Chemistry: 50, Biology: 100)

Marking Scheme:

  • Each correct answer carries 4 marks.
  • There is a negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect answer.
  • No marks are deducted for unattempted questions.

Subject-wise distribution of questions:

Important Points:

  • The NEET exam is going to be held in 13 languages; the question papers will be in English, Hindi, Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu.
  • Candidates can choose the language of the question paper while filling out the application form.
  • Calculators, log tables, electronic devices, and other similar materials are not allowed in the examination hall.
  • Only black ballpoint pens are allowed for writing answers.

NEET Exam 2026 Admit Card

Expected Release Date: The NEET UG admit card is expected to be released in the first week of May, potentially around May 1st, 2026. This is based on the previous year’s predictions.

Official Website: Monitor the official NEET website, https://neet.nta.nic.in/ for the latest updates on the admit card release date. It will be announced there first.

Exam Date: Remember, the NEET 2026 exam itself is scheduled for May 3rd, 2026.

Downloading the Admit Card: Once released, you can download your admit card by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official NEET website.
  2. Look for the “NEET Admit Card” link, usually in the Latest News section.
  3. Log in using your registration Number and Date of Birth.
  4. Download and print a copy of your admissions card for future reference.

Important Note: The admit card is a crucial document for appearing in the NEET exam. It contains important information like your exam center, roll number, reporting time, and exam day guidelines. Make sure you download and print your admit card well in advance of the exam date.

NEET Exam Centre for 2026

NEET Exam 2026 centers will be located in 554 cities across India. Last year, the NEET exam was conducted in 499 cities in India and 14 international cities. There were more than 4,000 NEET exam locations in all. As expected, there are more NEET UG 2026 centers overall than there were the previous year to accommodate more candidates from more geographic areas. Along with the information brochure, NTA has released the list of cities or exam centers for NEET 2026. 

NEET Exam 2026 Cutoff

The NEET Exam 2026 cutoff will be released along with the result. The table shows the NEET 2025 cutoff marks and percentiles for the last year.

NEET 2026 Results

The NEET Results 2026 will be declared in June, 2026. The NEET UG result will be declared in online mode in the form of a scorecard. Candidates will have to download the scorecard in PDF format. The NEET 2026 result will carry the following details:

  • Candidates Name 
  • Subjects wise marks
  • Subjects wise percentile 
  • Total score
  • All India Rank

NEET 2026 Counseling

The NEET UG counseling process is conducted by the Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) for 15% of All India Quota (AIQ) seats and by the respective state counseling bodies for the remaining 85% of state quota seats.

General Steps:

  • Registration

    Register online on the MCC website (for AIQ seats) or the website of your state counseling body (for state quota seats).

  • Choice Filling

    Fill in and lock in your choices of colleges and courses based on your preferences and eligibility.

  • Seat Allotment

    Seats will be allotted based on your rank, choices filled, and seat availability.

  • Document Verification

    Get your documents verified at the designated center.

  • Reporting to the College

    Report to the allotted college with all the required documents to complete the admission process.

Important Dates (Tentative):

  • NEET 2026 Exam Date: May 3, 2026
  • NEET 2026 Result Declaration (Expected): June 2026
  • NEET 2026 Counseling Registration (Expected): July 202

Courses offered Through NEET UG

NEET UG is the gateway to admission to multiple medical opportunities: 

  • MBBS
  • BDS
  • Ayurvedic Medicine
  • Unani Medicine
  • Homoeopathy Medicine
  • BSc (Hons) Nursing
  • Siddha Medicine
  • Bachelors of Occupational Therapy

Conclusion

NEET Exam 2026 is a key step for students aspiring to enter the medical field. Conducted by the National Testing Agency, it requires strong conceptual understanding, consistent practice, and effective time management. With increasing competition, early preparation and regular revision play a vital role in achieving a good score. Staying updated with official notifications and completing the application process on time is equally important. NEET Exam 2026 is not only a test of knowledge but also of discipline and strategy. With proper guidance and dedication, students can successfully secure admission to a reputed medical college.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How many marks are required to crack the NEET exam?

To qualify NEET, you need to clear the cutoff set by the National Testing Agency, which varies every year.

  • General category: approximately 130–150 marks (qualifying cutoff)
  • For top government colleges: 600+ marks (safe score)

Higher marks improve your chances of getting a better college.

Can 12th-grade students apply for the NEET exam?

Yes, appearing students can apply for the National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test (NEET). He/she needs to submit the related documents to prove their eligibility at the time of NEET counseling.

What are the minimum marks required in Class 12?

The minimum marks vary by category

  • General (UR): 50%
  • OBC, SC, ST: 40%
  • PWD: 40%
Can I apply if I'm still awaiting my Class 12 results?

Yes, you can apply provisionally if you’re appearing for your Class 12 exams in 2024.

Is there an upper age limit for NEET?

No, there is no upper age limit for NEET.

The university’s mission focuses on building a strong academic and research center to support innovation in fields such as petrochemistry, biotechnology, IT, and machine building. It also promotes Kazan as a global creative and educational hub while preserving its unique cultural heritage.
