Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the duration of the MBBS program in Nepal?

The MBBS program in Nepal typically takes 5.5 years to complete, including a one-year mandatory internship.

Is the MBBS degree from Nepal recognized in India and other countries?

Yes, MBBS degrees from Nepalese medical colleges recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or now the National Medical Commission (NMC) are valid in India. They are also recognized by the World Health Organization (WHO) and are accepted in many other countries.

What are the eligibility criteria for Indian students to pursue MBBS in Nepal?

Indian students must have completed their 10+2 education with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as main subjects. They must also qualify for the NEET exam to be eligible for admission to MBBS programs in Nepal.

How much does it cost to study MBBS in Nepal?

The cost of studying MBBS in Nepal varies by institution but generally ranges from INR 40 lakhs to INR 60 lakhs for the entire program, including tuition fees and other expenses.

Do I need to appear for an entrance exam to get admission to an MBBS program in Nepal?

Yes, most medical colleges in Nepal require students to clear an entrance exam, such as the Medical Education Common Entrance Examination (MECEE), conducted by the Medical Education Commission (MEC) of Nepal. Indian students must also qualify for NEET for admission.

What is the medium of instruction for MBBS in Nepal?

The medium of instruction for the MBBS program in Nepal is English, making it easier for international students to follow the curriculum.

Are there good clinical exposure and hospital facilities for MBBS students in Nepal?

Yes, medical colleges in Nepal are affiliated with well-equipped hospitals, providing students with excellent clinical exposure and practical experience during their studies.

What is the process for obtaining a student visa for Nepal?

Indian students do not require a visa to study in Nepal. However, students from other countries need to obtain a student visa by presenting their admission letter, passport, and other necessary documents at the Nepalese embassy or consulate.

What are the living conditions and accommodation facilities for students in Nepal?

Most medical colleges in Nepal offer on-campus hostels with good living conditions, including basic amenities like food, internet, and security. Off-campus accommodations are also available at reasonable costs.

What are the career prospects after completing MBBS in Nepal?

After completing MBBS in Nepal, students can return to India to practice medicine by clearing the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE). Graduates can also pursue further studies or work in Nepal or other countries, depending on their qualifications and career goals.

Is an MBBS degree from medical universities in China valid in India?

Yes, MBBS degrees from NMC-approved medical colleges in China are recognized in India. After completing the course and passing the Foreign Medical Graduate Exam in India, students can work in India.

MBBS in Kazakhstan has become a top choice for Indian students who want quality medical education at affordable cost. MBBS in Kazakhstan has also become a popular choice especially among Indian students as all the medical universities in Kazakhstan are approved by NMC, WHO etc. The country offers excellent medical education which is at par with international standards. 

The course duration is 5 years with an additional 1-year internship. The degree is globally recognized and accepted in India after clearing the FMGE/NEXT exam.

Overview MBBS in Kazakhstan

Kazakhstan is a very beautiful country located in Central Asia. If you are thinking of doing MBBS from Kazakhstan, then you can do MBBS in Kazakhstan without any worry. It is one of the largest landlocked countries in the world. Russia to the north and west, China to the east, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan to the south, and Turkmenistan to the southwest.are its neighboring countries. Kazakhstan is also a favorite place for Indian students. 

Kazakhstan has an excellently developed medical education system. Various medical universities here are ranked among the top medical institutions around the world. Kazakhstan provides a safe and welcoming environment for all international students. It has now experienced a large student population and a growing number of English-taught MBBS in Kazakhstan in its medical universities.

Why Choose Kazakhstan for MBBS?

Studying MBBS Abroad can be costly, but MBBS in Kazakhstan will ensure that students pursuing MBBS here get a quality education without the heavy budget that is often involved in private medical colleges in India. The tuition fees here start at around $3,000 per year, making it a great option for Indian students planning to pursue MBBS abroad.  

Kazakhstan medical universities are recognized and approved by international bodies like World Health Organization (WHO), National Medical Commission (NMC), this recognition ensures that the degree earned in Kazakhstan or globally valid. 

Affordability

MBBS in Kazakhstan The first and most important reason is affordability. Often students choose the MBBS Abroad option because quality medical education is available there at an affordable cost.

Kazakhstan’s education system focuses both theoretical and practical knowledge, preparing students for real-world clinical experience. Many universities also offer preparatory courses and language classes to help students adjust better.

Globally Acknowledged Degree

Every medical university in Kazakhstan takes care that its degree is valid in the country and around the world. Students graduating from any medical university in Kazakhstan should not face any kind of problem. A person can practice medicine  from any country, after graduating but if the degree is not valid worldwide, then it is a matter of great concern for the students. But the medical university of Kazakhstan is recognized by NMC and World Health Organization, due to which its degree is also valid globally.

No donation or capitation charges

Often, private medical colleges in India demand high donations or capitation fees in addition to the tuition fees. But in Kazakhstan, students pay only for their academic and hostel fees, without any hidden or additional charges. This makes MBBS abroad in Kazakhstan completely transparent and fair, especially for students from middle-class families.

Student Life and Safety

Kazakhstan is a safe and welcoming country for international students. Cities like Almaty and Nur-Sultan (formerly Astana) are considered quite safe for students who come from another country to pursue MBBS in Kazakhstan and in these countries one can also see low crime rates and good infrastructure and student-friendly amenities Universities provide hostel facilities, Indian mess, 24/7 security, and medical care to ensure a comfortable stay for Indian students pursuing MBBS Abroad.

NMC and WHO-Recognized Universities

All top medical universities in Kazakhstan are recognized by:

  • NMC (National Medical Commission), India
  • WHO (World Health Organization)

     

This means your MBBS degree from Kazakhstan is valid not just in India, but also in countries like the USA, UK, Canada, and more. After completing your degree, you can appear for NEXT (India) or USMLE (USA) and start your medical career globally.

Applying for MBBS in Kazakhstan 2026 is a simple, transparent process. Unlike in many countries, Kazakhstan offers direct admission to its medical universities without entrance exams (except NEET, which is mandatory for Indian students). Following the correct procedure ensures a hassle-free admission experience.

  • 10th & 12th mark sheets

Once your documents are verified, the university will issue a provisional admission letter.

Travel & Join Classes

  • The university will provide airport pickup and hostel accommodation.

Student life in Kazakhstan

The life of medical students in Kazakhstan is extremely exciting, balanced, culturally rich and they get a chance to experience a new country. Moving to a country other than your own is not that easy, but medical universities in Kazakhstan make students feel at home. The university offers a highly supportive environment, affordable lifestyle and vibrant campus life is also one of the reasons why students love it to pursue MBBS in Kazakhstan.

Let’s explore what student life in Kazakhstan looks like for those pursuing MBBS Abroad.

Campus Environment

Most universities offering MBBS in Kazakhstan have modern and spacious campuses 

designed for practical and theoretical learning. Facilities include:

  • Smart classrooms and 3D anatomy labs
  • Advanced simulation centers and surgical practice units
  • Fully digital libraries with thousands of medical journals

Kazakh medical universities focus not just on academics but also on building a positive student environment that encourages learning, collaboration, and innovation. For students pursuing MBBS Abroad, this environment ensures all-round development.

Separate hostels for boys and girls are available in most universities. The hostels are close to the university buildings, making daily travel easy and safe for all MBBS students.

Universities organise:

These activities make life more exciting and help MBBS aspirants build global friendships and professional networks.

Kazakhs experience extreme winters, with temperatures dropping below -10°C. But for students pursuing an MBBS in Kazakhstan , there’s no need to worry—hostels, classrooms, and hospitals are well-heated and comfortable.

In fact, many students enjoy winter activities such as:

This unique lifestyle becomes a memorable part of their MBBS Abroad journey.

Is MBBS in Kazakhstan a Good Option for Indian Students?

MBBS in Kazakhstan is becoming quite popular among Indian students who are unable to secure a seat in government colleges in India due to tough competition. But is MBBS in Kazakhstan really a good option? Let us look at various aspects like FMGE pass rate, language, food, hostel and security to understand whether pursuing MBBS abroad, especially in Kazakhstan, is the right choice.

FMGE/MCI Passing Rate

The FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) is a mandatory test for students who complete MBBS Abroad and want to practice medicine in India. One common concern among students is whether MBBS in Kazakhstan prepares them well for the FMGE.

While the overall FMGE pass rate for foreign medical graduates has traditionally been lower compared to Indian medical graduates, students from top medical universities in Kazakhstan have shown steady improvement. This is because many Kazakh universities are now offering dedicated FMGE coaching, focusing on clinical training and Indian syllabus orientation.

Some reputed NMC-approved Kazakh universities have recorded better FMGE results than others due to their robust academic structure and English-medium teaching. With proper preparation, Indian students pursuing MBBS in Kazakhstan are clearing the exam and starting successful careers back home. 

Language Barrier: Myth vs Reality

Another common myth about MBBS in Kazakhstan is the language barrier. It’s true that Kazakh is the native language, but most top medical universities offer the entire MBBS course in English for international students.

However, students are also taught basic Kazakh in the first year to help them communicate with patients during clinical rotations. This dual-language exposure becomes an advantage during hospital postings. Learning a new language might seem intimidating, but Indian students quickly adapt and feel comfortable within a few months.

So, the language barrier is more of a myth than a reality for students doing MBBS in Kazakhstan.

Indian Food Availability

For many Indian students considering MBBS Abroad, food is a major concern. The good news is that most universities in Kazakhstan have Indian mess facilities or nearby Indian restaurants. Many hostels provide kitchen access so students can cook their meals if they prefer home-style food.

Also, cities like Almaty, Astana, and Aktobe have well-established Indian communities and Indian grocery stores. So, Indian students pursuing MBBS in Kazakhstan rarely face issues regarding food.

Often, private medical colleges in India demand high donations or capitation fees in addition to the tuition fees. But in Kazakhstan, students pay only for their academic and hostel fees, without any hidden or additional charges. This makes MBBS abroad in Kazakhstan completely transparent and fair, especially for students from middle-class families.

Hostel & Accommodation

Universities in Kazakhstan provide secure, comfortable, and affordable hostel accommodations for international students. Hostels are equipped with all the basic amenities, including Wi-Fi, heating, laundry services, and attached kitchens.

Separate hostels are often available for boys and girls. Safety is a top priority, and most hostels have security guards and CCTV surveillance. MBBS in Kazakhstan : students also enjoy easy access to the university campus from their hostel, making daily travel hassle-free.

Compared to the high living expenses in private Indian colleges, staying in Kazakhstan is far more budget-friendly for students doing MBBS Abroad.

Safety for Indian Students

Kazakhstan is a safe country for international students, including Indians. University campuses are secure, and local communities are generally friendly and helpful. Indian embassies and student support centres also provide assistance in case of emergencies.

Major cities like Almaty, Astana and Shymkent are home to many Indian students, making the environment even more welcoming. As long as students follow local rules and stay cautious like in any foreign country, studying MBBS in Kazakhstan is absolutely safe.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for Studying MBBS in Kazakhstan for Indian Students 2026-27

Is MBBS in Kazakhstan valid in India?

Yes. MBBS degrees from universities in Kazakhstan that are approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC) are valid in India. After completing the degree, students must clear the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) to practice in India.

What is the duration of MBBS in Kazakhstan ?

The duration of MBBS in Kazakhstan is 6 years for English-medium courses. This includes 5 years of academic study and 1 year of internship/clinical rotation, which may be completed in Kazakhstan or India.

What is the total cost of MBBS in Kazakhstan for Indian students?

The total cost usually ranges between 25 lakh to 30 lakh for the full 6-year course. This includes tuition fees, hostel charges, and other basic expenses. Some universities may offer scholarships.

Is NEET required for admission to MBBS in Kazakhstan ?

Yes. NEET qualification is mandatory for Indian students planning to study MBBS Abroad, including in Kazakhstan. The NEET score is needed for eligibility and NMC registration.

Are Kazakhtan’s medical universities NMC approved?

Yes, many top Kazakh universities are NMC-approved. It is important to check the official NMC list before applying. AR Group of Education can help you choose only approved universities.

Is the MBBS course taught in English in Kazakhstan?

Yes. Most top medical universities offer MBBS in English medium, especially for international students. Some universities may include Kazakh language training for clinical interaction.

Are there Indian mess or food facilities available?

Yes. Most universities have Indian mess or tiffin services. Local restaurants and grocery stores also offer Indian spices and ingredients, making it easier for students to cook or eat Indian food.

Is Kazakhstan safe for Indian students?

Yes. Kazakhstan is generally safe for international students, including Indians. Universities provide secured hostels, and cities have good public transport and police support. Students are advised to follow local laws and safety guidelines.

Exams required

Disadvantages Of Studying Mbbs In Russia

Studying MBBS in Russia can be a viable option for Indian students due to its affordability, quality education, and global recognition. However, there are several disadvantages that students should be aware of before making a decision. Here are the key disadvantages of studying MBBS in Russia for Indian students:

Climate and Weather Conditions

Russia is known for its extreme and cold climate, which can be challenging for Indian students. The temperatures in many parts of Russia remain below zero degrees Celsius for about three to four months, which can be particularly difficult for students from warmer regions of India. This climate can pose health issues and require significant acclimatisation.

Language Barrier

The official language of Russia is Russian, and not everyone speaks English. This language barrier can be a significant challenge for Indian students who are not proficient in Russian. While some universities offer courses in English, many others teach in Russian, necessitating students to learn the language to interact with locals and succeed in their studies.

Food and Accommodation

Indian students may find it difficult to adjust to the local food and accommodation in Russia. While some universities offer Indian food facilities, these may not always be available or of good quality. Additionally, renting an apartment can involve risks and security issues. University-governed hostels can provide a safer and more comfortable living environment, but the quality of these facilities can vary.

Cultural and Lifestyle Adjustments

Russia offers a vibrant nightlife, which can be tempting but also distracting for students. The cultural differences and nightlife can lead to addictions and negatively impact students’ health and academic performance. Choosing university-provided accommodation with strict monitoring can help mitigate these risks.

FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination)

After completing MBBS in Russia, Indian students must pass the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) to practise medicine in India. This additional examination can be a significant hurdle and adds to the overall duration and cost of becoming a practising doctor in India

Recognition and Validation

Although the degree from Russian universities is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) in India, there is still a need to pass the FMGE, which can be a source of anxiety for students.

title: Yaroslav-the-wise Novgorod State Medical University

The Yaroslav-the-wise Novgorod State Medical University, also known as NovSU, was founded in 1993 by merging the two oldest higher education institutions, Velikly Novgorod and the second Pedagogical and Polytechnic Institution. It is located in the oldest city in Russia, i.e., Veliky Novgorod. 

The structure of Novgorod State Medical University represents the 8 institutes, which include the 4 departments of secondary vocational education, 3 colleges, and 56 departments. Practice-orientated education at the university is organised according to 250+ programmes taught by more than 450+ specialists of the faculties. 

More than 15,000 students are studying at Novgorod Medical University, including more than 1,600 international students from 63 countries. There are around 22 student groups, 13 student councils, 18 volunteer associations, 18 sports sections, 9 creative studios, language centres, and recreation centres. 

The Yaroslav-the-wise Novgorod State Medical University offers a 6-year medical programme which is recognised by the World Health Organisation (WHO), National Medical Commission (NMC), and Foundation for Advancement of International Medical Education & Research (FAIMER). 

Yaroslav-the-Wise Novgorod State University is the largest educational institution in the northwest of the Russian Federation and the only one in the Novgorod region. Today, the university in Veliky Novgorod is known as the unique “multi-university-technopolis” which, in 1993, for the first time in Russia, brought together several universities and technical schools, as well as research and production structures, preserving and increasing their scientific, educational and socio-cultural potential.

Currently, Novgorod State University comprises 7 scientific and educational institutions: Institute of Medical Education, Humanities Institute, Institute of Electronic Information Systems, Institute of Continuous Pedagogical Education, Institute of Digital Economics, Management and Service, Institute of Agriculture and Natural Resources, and Polytechnic Institute. The university also includes 4 vocational colleges: Polytechnic, Humanities, Medical, and Economic.

The MBBS program at Vyas Medical College is of 5.5 years duration, which includes a one-year mandatory internship. This course is designed as per the guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC), with the main aim of shaping students into skilled and compassionate doctors.

  4. Seats are then allotted on the basis of the NEET UG 2026 score that students have secured, the category that they belong (for reservation), and in accordance with their preferences.
  5. Once the colleges are allotted, candidates will have to get all their documents verified by either visiting the allotted college or submitting on its online portal. All the candidates are advised to check this with their respective colleges.

Overview of MBBS at Index Medical College

The hospital, established in 2006, serves rural, suburban, and urban populations, providing free diagnostic and treatment services. The first batch of MBBS students was admitted in 2007 and graduated in March 2012. 

Postgraduate (MD/MS) courses began in 2011, with the Government of India and NMC permitting PG degree courses in non-clinical subjects that same year and in clinical subjects in 2014. 

In 2021, D.M./M.Ch. degree courses in clinical subjects were approved by the GOI and NMC/NMC. The hospital has ISO 9001-2008 certification and is affiliated with DAVV University Indore, MPMSU Jabalpur, and Malwanchal University, Indore. 

It is approved for 250 MBBS seats, 131 MD/MS seats, and 4 D.M./M.Ch. seats per year across various departments. The institution also extends its services to students from rural, suburban, and urban areas, offering them opportunities for professional growth.

The college has an advanced and spacious Skills Lab, adhering to the latest NMC guidelines from New Delhi. In response to the Covid-19 pandemic, the Department of Microbiology at Index Medical College, Hospital & Research Centre, Indore, has developed a BSL-2 Level Laboratory for testing infectious pathogens.

The college has five lecture theaters, each with a seating capacity of 300 students. These theaters are equipped with sound amplification systems and modern audio-visual teaching aids.

The medical college features three spacious examination halls, each accommodating 250 students. These halls are air-conditioned and equipped with CCTV cameras.

The facility includes a spacious dissection hall with adequate cadavers for group discussions, and a well-established museum with rare specimens to enhance the teaching of anatomy. The laboratories are furnished with modern equipment and instruments, allowing for practical demonstrations and individual student training with charts, models, and case reports. title: Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore
content:
Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences (SAIMS) Indore is one of the leading private medical colleges in Madhya Pradesh, founded in 2003 by Dr Vinod Bhandari and Dr Manjushree Bhandari in association with SAIMS Society and Bhandari Group of Hospitals. The institute is named after the great philosopher and spiritual leader Sri Aurobindo, which reflects the vision of both holistic development and educational excellence. The institute is spread over a Wi-Fi-enabled green campus of ​​35 to 70 acres, the institute is located on Indore-Ujjain Highway, which provides a comfortable and peaceful learning environment. 

SAIMS Indore is fully recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and affiliated to Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV), Indore, ensuring high academic standards and quality education. Over the years, the institute has gained a reputation for modern infrastructure, advanced medical training and excellent clinical exposure. One of the main attractions of the SAIMS campus is the 1400-bed multi-speciality hospital, which provides hospital services as well as professional experience to the students. 

The hospital comprises the enchanting hi-tech speciality hospital, known across the country for achieving remarkable feats in bariatric and metabolic surgery, including performing surgery on the youngest patient in the country. The presence of such advanced medical facilities on the campus enhances the practical learning and research opportunities of the students. SAIMS offers undergraduate (MBBS), postgraduate (MD/MS) and super-speciality programmes (DM/M.Ch), which attract students from across the country. With modern classrooms, state-of-the-art laboratories, a rich library and excellent hostel facilities, Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences remains a preferred destination for medical aspirants seeking quality education and career growth in the healthcare sector.

Reputation and Accreditation

SAIMS Indore is fully recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and affiliated with Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV), Indore, this ensures quality education, and the MBBS degree is valid in India and abroad. 

Experienced Faculty

The faculty at SAIMS comprises experienced professionals and renowned experts in various fields of medicine. Their expertise and dedication to teaching ensure that students receive high-quality education and mentorship.

Advanced Infrastructure

SAIMS has an extensive college campus equipped with modern facilities, including the best for MBBS in Madhya Pradesh lecture halls, well-equipped laboratories, a well stocked library, and advanced research facilities. The institute also has a 1300-bed hospital that provides ample clinical exposure to students.

Highly Qualified Faculty

SAIMS boasts an experienced and skilled teaching staff of renowned doctors and specialists to guide the students through the theoretical and practical aspects of medicine.

Diverse Courses & Career Growth

Apart from MBBS, the institute also offers PG (MD/MS) and Super-Specialty (DM/M.Ch) programmes, providing long-term career opportunities to students under the same roof.

Strategic Location & Campus Life

Located on the Indore-Ujjain Highway, SAIMS offers excellent connectivity, top hostel facilities, sports, extracurricular activities, and a vibrant student life, making it ideal for overall development.

All-round Development

Apart from academic excellence, SAIMS focuses on the overall development of students. The institute organizes various extracurricular activities, cultural events, and sports competitions, ensuring a well-rounded educational experience.

Strong Alumni Network

SAIMS has a strong and active alumni network that provides support and guidance to current students. The alumni network helps in career advancement, networking, and professional growth.

Fees of MBBS at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences

The MBBS course at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore offers quality education with reasonable annual tuition, NRI and hostel fees. The institute offers modern facilities, clinical experience and excellent infrastructure for aspiring medical students.

MBBS Eligibility Criteria at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore

Planning to study MBBS at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Science, but still worried about how to get admission here? To be eligible for the MBBS program at SAIMS, candidates must meet the following criteria:

  1. Students need to qualify 10+2 class with 50% marks in physics, chemistry, and biology. 
  2. Reserved category students need to obtain 40% marks to get admission in SAIMS. 
  3. Candidates must be at least 17 years old as of December 31 of the year of admission. There is no upper age limit for the NEET exam.
  4. Candidates must qualify for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA). 
  5. The NEET score is the primary criterion for admission to the MBBS program at SAIMS.

Admission Process for MBBS at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore

  1. Candidates must appear for the NEET exam and obtain a valid score.
  2. After the NEET results are declared, candidates need to apply for the MBBS program at SAIMS through the institute’s official website or the Directorate of Medical Education, Madhya Pradesh.
  3. The Directorate of Medical Education, Madhya Pradesh conducts centralized counseling for MBBS admissions. Candidates are allotted seats based on their NEET score, preferences, and availability of seats.
  4. Shortlisted candidates must undergo document verification at the designated centers. 

They need to produce original documents such as 

  • NEET UG scorecards 
  • Admit cards 
  • 10th and 12th mark sheets 
  • Transfer certificates 
  • Migration certificates
  • Caste certificates (if applicable)
  • Passport-size photographs.

     

    After successful document verification, candidates need to pay the admission fee to confirm their seat. The institute provides further instructions regarding the commencement of classes and other formalities.

MBBS Duration and Medium of Instruction at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore

The MBBS at SRI Aurobindo Institute of Medical Science is five and a half years in duration, which includes four and a half years of academic study and one year of compulsory internship. The academic study is divided into nine semesters, each focusing on different aspects of medical sciences and clinical practice.

Medium of Instruction at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences

The medium of instruction for the MBBS program at SAIMS is English. The use of English as the medium of instruction ensures that students are well-versed in medical terminology and can communicate effectively in a professional environment. 

Hostel & Accommodation Facilities at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences Indore

Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences provides excellent hostel and accommodation facilities for its students, ensuring a comfortable and conducive living environment. The hostel facilities are designed to cater to the needs of both male and female students.

Hostel Facilities at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences

  1. Accommodation: The hostels offer well-furnished rooms with basic amenities such as beds, study tables, chairs, and wardrobes. The rooms are available on a sharing basis (double or triple occupancy).
  2. Mess and Dining: The hostels have an attached mess that provides nutritious and hygienic meals. The menu is designed to cater to the diverse tastes and preferences of students.
  3. Recreational Facilities: The hostels are equipped with recreational facilities such as common rooms with television, indoor games, and reading areas. This ensures that students have a balanced and enjoyable stay.
  4. Security: The hostels have round-the-clock security to ensure the safety and well-being of students. The institute also has strict rules and regulations to maintain discipline and order within the hostel premises.
  5. Wi-Fi and Internet: High-speed Wi-Fi and internet facilities are available in the hostels, allowing students to access online resources and stay connected with their families.
  6. Laundry and Housekeeping: The hostels provide laundry and housekeeping services to ensure a clean and comfortable living environment.

Accommodation for International Students at Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences

Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences also provides separate accommodation facilities for international students. These accommodations are designed to meet the specific needs of international students and provide a homely atmosphere.

Propel your medical career by joining SRI Aurobindo Institute of Medical Science

Are you ready to pursue a successful medical career in the state of Madhya Pradesh, then look no further as SRI Aurobindo Institute of Medical Science provided with the best opportunity to chase your dream.

Conclusion

The Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences (SAIMS) in Indore is a top-notch institution for pursuing an MBBS degree. With its excellent infrastructure, experienced faculty, comprehensive curriculum, and focus on holistic development, SAIMS provides an ideal environment for aspiring medical professionals. The institute’s commitment to academic excellence, research, and healthcare services makes it one of the best places in India to pursue an MBBS degree.

If you are considering a career in medicine, SAIMS Indore should be at the top of your list. With its excellent academic and clinical training, SAIMS ensures that its graduates are well-prepared to meet the challenges of the medical profession and contribute to the betterment of society.

Graduates of SAIMS have excellent career prospects. They can pursue postgraduate studies (MD/MS) in various specialties, work in reputed hospitals, join the healthcare sector, engage in research, or start their own medical practice.

title: Peoples College of Medical Science Bhopal
content:
Founded in 2005, the People’s College of Medical Sciences and Research Centre is a medical college in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. It is a member of the People’s Group, which also manages other educational facilities, two dental colleges, and a hospital. 

The college is associated with Peoples University, Bhopal, and recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and the Government of India. The Medical College accepts applications for 150 MBBS seats each year and 49 seats in 20 postgraduate study areas.

People’s College of Medical Sciences and Research Centre (PCMS&RC) in Bhopal, for MBBS in Madhya Pradesh, stands as one of the premier medical institutions in Central India. Established with the vision of providing top-notch medical education and healthcare services, the college is part of the People’s University, a private university known for its commitment to excellence in education, research, and healthcare.

Key Highlights

  • Affiliation and Recognition: Peoples College of Medical Science is affiliated with the People’s University and is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and the World Health Organization (WHO). 
  • Infrastructure: The college boasts state-of-the-art infrastructure, including modern laboratories, advanced medical equipment, well-equipped lecture halls, and an extensive library.
  • Clinical Exposure: With a fully functional hospital attached to the college, students receive ample clinical exposure, ensuring they are well-prepared for their professional careers.

Why MBBS at People's College of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, Bhopal?

Choosing the right medical college in India needs to consider some most important factors that make prestigious medical colleges in the nation. Here we mention some of the prime factors that need to be considered. 

Comprehensive Curriculum

The curriculum for Peoples College of Medical Science’s MBBS program is created to give students a solid foundation in clinical practice and medical science. A well-rounded education is ensured by the course framework, which covers clinical courses, basic sciences, and practical training.

Experienced Faculty

The faculty members at the college take great satisfaction in their extensive training and expertise. In addition to being authoritative in their domains, these teachers are committed to mentoring and advising students at every stage of their academic careers.

Clinical Exposure

The attached hospital offers a diverse range of cases, giving students hands-on experience in diagnosing and treating patients. This clinical exposure is invaluable for developing practical skills and clinical acumen.

Holistic Development

Beyond academics, Peoples College of Medical Science focuses on the holistic development of students. Various extracurricular activities, sports, and cultural events are organized to ensure students have a balanced and enriching college life.

How to Get Admission to People's College of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, Bhopal

Getting MBBS admission to the People’s Colleges of Medicine Science and Research Centre involves a systematic process. Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you navigate the process:

Eligibility Criteria

  1. Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects. A minimum aggregate score of 50% (40% for reserved categories) in the PCB group is required.
  2. Reserved category students required 40% marks to get admission. 
  3. Age Limit: Candidates must be at least 17 years old as of December 31 of the admission year.

Entrance Exam

Admission to the MBBS program is based on the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) score. It is mandatory for all aspiring medical students in India.

Application Process

  1. NEET-UG Registration: Register and appear for the NEET-UG exam. Ensure you meet the cutoff marks for PCM S&RC.
  2. Counseling Registration: After the NEET-UG results are declared, register for the counseling process conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) or the respective state counseling authority.
  3. Choice Filling: During the counseling process, select PCMS&RC as your preferred choice for admission.
  4. Seat Allotment: Based on your NEET-UG score and choices filled, seats will be allotted. If allotted a seat at PCMS&RC, you will receive an allotment letter.
  5. Reporting to College: Report to the college with the allotment letter and complete the admission formalities.

Required Documents

According to the college requirements, students need to submit some fundamental documents. Here’s a list of essential documents needed during the admission process:

  1. NEET-UG Score Card
  2. 10th and 12th Mark Sheets 
  3. Transfer Certificate (TC) 
  4. Migration Certificate
  5. Character Certificate
  6. Category Certificate (if applicable)
  7. Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  8. Passport-size Photographs
  9. Allotment Letter from Counseling Authority
  10. Identity Proof (Aadhar Card, Passport, etc.)

Admission Process

  1. Verification of Documents: Submit the required documents for verification.
  2. Medical Examination: Undergo a medical examination conducted by the college to ensure fitness for the medical course.
  3. Payment of Fees: Pay the admission fee as prescribed by the college.
  4. Confirmation of Admission: After completing all formalities, you will receive a confirmation of admission from the college.

Infrastructure and Facilities

  • Campus: The People’s College of Medical Sciences and Research Center campus is the pinnacle of style and utility.
  • Laboratories: To meet the demands of students, there are contemporary laboratories available.
  • Clinical Rotations: These allow medical students excellent chances to work with a medical team and learn about the various facets of each specialty.
  • Library: The Peoples College of Medical Science library provides the opportunity to learn and is updated with the most recent books.
  • Hostel amenities: The hostels have all the conveniences guests may need, including laundry machines, beds, shared TV and reading areas, gyms, and water coolers with water purifiers.

Hostel & Accommodation Facilities at People's College of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, Bhopal

Hostel Facilities

PCMS&RC provides excellent hostel facilities to ensure a comfortable and conducive living environment for students.

  1. Accommodation Types: Separate hostels for boys and girls with various accommodation options such as single, double, and triple occupancy rooms.
  2. Amenities: Well-furnished rooms with essential amenities like study tables, chairs, beds, wardrobes, and internet connectivity.
  3. Safety and Security: 24/7 security, CCTV surveillance, and wardens ensure the safety and well-being of students.
  4. Common Areas: Common rooms equipped with TV, recreational facilities, and indoor games.
  5. Dining Facilities: Hygienic and nutritious meals are provided in the hostel mess. The college canteen provides three times as many fresh and delicious meals. 

Additional Facilities

  1. Medical Facilities: In-house medical facilities with round-the-clock availability of doctors and emergency care.
  2. Sports and Recreation: Sports grounds, gymnasium, and recreational activities for holistic development.
  3. Laundry Services: Laundry services are available within the hostel premises.
  4. Transportation: Shuttle services for transportation within the campus and to nearby locations.

What is the duration of the MBBS program at PCMS&RC?

The MBBS program at PCMS&RC has a duration of 5.5 years, which includes a one-year compulsory internship.

Yes, admission to the MBBS program at PCMS&RC is based on the NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) score.

Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English with a minimum aggregate score of 50% (40% for reserved categories) in the PCB group and should be at least 17 years old as of December 31 of the admission year.

What documents are required during the admission process?

Essential documents include NEET-UG Admit Card and Score Card, 10th and 12th Mark Sheets and Certificates, Transfer and Migration Certificates, Character Certificate, Category Certificate (if applicable), Domicile Certificate (if applicable), Passport-size Photographs, Allotment Letter, and Identity Proof.

Does PCMS&RC provide hostel facilities?

Yes, PCMS&RC offers separate hostels for boys and girls with various accommodation options, well-furnished rooms, internet connectivity, dining facilities, and 24/7 security.

Are there any scholarships available for students at PCMS&RC?

PCMS&RC offers various scholarships based on academic performance, merit, and financial need. Students are encouraged to inquire with the college administration for specific scholarship opportunities.

PCMS&RC offers extensive clinical exposure through its attached hospital, providing students with hands-on experience in diagnosing and treating patients, which is crucial for their professional training.

The institute provides a variety of general and multispecialty medical treatments, including both modern surgery and traditional Ayurvedic treatment. VIMS offers undergraduate or postgraduate courses. 

Additionally, the institute has a 1600-bed super-specialty hospital that provides hands-on training for students and offers world-class healthcare to patients. The curriculum integrates modern technology and innovative research in real-world scenarios to enhance the quality of medical education.

Eligibility Criteria for Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre

The eligibility criteria for various courses at VIMS are as follows:

MBBS:

  • Candidates must have completed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as the main subjects.
  • They must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in PCB (40% for reserved categories).
  • Must have qualified NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test).

MD/MS:

  • Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • Must have completed a one-year internship.
  • Must have qualified for NEET-PG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduates).

BDS:

  • Completion of 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
  • A minimum of 50% aggregate in PCB is required.
  • Must have qualified NEET-UG.

MDS:

  • Candidates must hold a BDS degree from a recognized dental college.
  • Must have completed a one-year internship.
  • NEET-MDS qualification is required.

Admission Process at Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre

The admission process at Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre is primarily based on the candidate’s performance in national entrance exams. Below is a step-by-step guide for admissions:

Step 1: Entrance Exam:

  • For MBBS and BDS, candidates must appear for the NEET-UG exam.
  • For postgraduate programs like MD/MS and MDS, candidates must appear for NEET-PG and NEET-MDS, respectively.

Step 2: Counseling:

  • After clearing the entrance exams, candidates must participate in the counseling process conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) or the respective state counseling authority.

Step 3: Choice Filling:

  • During the counseling process, candidates can choose VIMS as their preferred institution.

Step 4: Seat Allotment:

  • Based on the candidate’s rank, seat availability, and reservation criteria, seats are allotted.

Step 5: Document Verification:

  • After seat allotment, candidates must report to the institute for document verification.

Step 6: Fee Payment:

  • Candidates must pay the required course fees to secure their admission.

Step 7: Admission Confirmation:

  • Once all formalities are completed, the admission is confirmed.

The university has visionary educationist Dr. M.S. Ramaiah; the college has grown to become a center of excellence in medical education, research, and healthcare. 

Over the years, the college has maintained a strong reputation for producing skilled and compassionate healthcare professionals who have made significant contributions in India and abroad.

MS Ramaiah Medical College is part of the larger Ramaiah Group of Institutions and is affiliated with the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Karnataka. The total number of seats in the MS Ramaiah Medical College Bangalore is 150. 

It is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty programs in medicine and healthcare.

Why is MS Ramaiah Medical College Bangalore the Best?

MS Ramaiah Medical College stands out as one of the leading medical colleges in India for several reasons:

Excellent Faculty

The college boasts highly qualified and experienced faculty members who provide exceptional medical education and guidance. Many faculty members are actively involved in research and have contributed significantly to the field of medicine.

State-of-the-art Infrastructure

The college is equipped with modern facilities, including advanced laboratories, an extensive library, research centers, and simulation labs that offer students hands-on experience in real-world healthcare settings.

Affiliation with Top Hospitals

MS Ramaiah Memorial Hospital, a multi-specialty hospital, is attached to the college, providing students with extensive clinical training. Students gain real-time exposure to a wide range of medical cases, enhancing their learning experience.

Strong Alumni Network

MS Ramaiah Medical College boasts a robust alumni network spread across the globe. Many graduates have made significant contributions to healthcare and medical research.

Focus on Holistic Development

 The college emphasizes not only academic excellence but also the overall development of students. Various extracurricular activities, cultural festivals, and sports facilities are provided for students’ personal growth.

Courses Offered by MS Ramaiah Medical College, Bangalore

MS Ramaiah Medical College offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty courses in medicine and healthcare.

They need to have received at least a minimal cumulative score in PCB (typically between 50% and 60%, depending on the college), and they must have passed each topic separately.

title: Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences
content:
Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences (KIMS) is one of the premier medical institutions in Karnataka, located in Bangalore. Established in 1980, the institute is named after Kempegowda, the founder of Bangalore. 

Affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), KIMS is recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) and has earned a reputation for providing quality medical education and excellent healthcare services. 

The institute has a sprawling campus, well-equipped laboratories, and highly experienced faculty, making it one of the top choices for aspiring medical students to study MBBS in Karnataka.

KIMS aims to deliver quality medical education while focusing on research and healthcare excellence. It offers both undergraduate (MBBS) and postgraduate programs (MD, MS, and PG diplomas) in various specializations. 

The institution has an impressive infrastructure with modern medical facilities, clinical laboratories, and a well-stocked library, contributing to an enriched academic environment. The teaching hospitals associated with Kempegowda Institution of Medical Science provide ample clinical exposure to the students, ensuring they gain hands-on experience during their education. 

In addition to its academic credentials, KIMS has been pivotal in serving the community with healthcare services, often engaging in social responsibility initiatives. The institution consistently produces competent and ethical medical professionals who are well-prepared for the challenges of the medical field.

Why Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences is the Best Medical Institution

Experienced Faculty

KIMS boasts a highly qualified and experienced faculty that plays a crucial role in shaping future medical professionals. The professors and lecturers at KIMS are experts in their fields, offering students high-quality education and guidance.

Comprehensive Clinical Exposure

With its associated teaching hospitals, KIMS provides extensive clinical exposure to its students. They gain real-world experience through patient care, surgeries, and medical procedures in various departments.

State-of-the-Art Infrastructure

The institution is equipped with modern facilities such as digital libraries, advanced research labs, simulation labs, and fully-equipped lecture halls, ensuring that students have access to the best educational resources.

Community Service

Kempegowda Institute of Medical Science Bangalore is deeply involved in serving the local community. The institution regularly conducts health camps, awareness drives, and outreach programs, contributing to public health while giving students a chance to gain practical experience.

Research Opportunities

The institute encourages research and innovation among its students. Various research projects in collaboration with national and international institutions allow students to contribute to the medical field’s growth and development.

Affiliation and Recognition

KIMS is affiliated with the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) and recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). These affiliations highlight the credibility and standard of education at the institution.

The college offers a 5.5-year MBBS program, including a one-year internship. Admission is through the NEET UG (National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test).

Postgraduate

Eligibility Criteria

MBBS Program:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 or equivalent examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as mandatory subjects.
  • Minimum Marks: General category candidates should have obtained at least 50% marks in the 10+2 exam (40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates).
  • Age Limit: The candidate should be at least 17 years old by December 31 of the admission year.
  • Entrance Exam: Candidates must qualify for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) for admission.

Postgraduate Programs (MD/MS):

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • Completion of Internship: A one-year rotating internship must be completed before the admission deadline.
  • Entrance Exam: Admission is based on the NEET-PG score.
  • Eligibility Criteria for Specializations: Different specializations may have specific requirements.

Admission Process

The admission process at KIMS is strictly based on merit, with candidates required to appear for relevant entrance exams (NEET-UG for MBBS and NEET-PG for MD/MS). Below is a step-by-step guide for the admission process:

For MBBS Program:

  1. Step 1: Appear for NEET-UG
    Candidates must register and appear for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).
  2. Step 2: Check eligibility
    Ensure you meet the eligibility criteria for the MBBS program, including educational qualifications, minimum marks, and age.
  3. Step 3: NEET-UG Result and Counseling
    After the NEET-UG results are declared, candidates must participate in the centralized counseling process conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA). The counseling involves document verification, choice filling, and seat allotment based on NEET-UG rank.
  4. Step 4: Seat Allotment
    Based on the NEET-UG score, the seat allotment process is conducted. Candidates are required to select KIMS as their preferred institution during the counseling.
  5. Step 5: Admission Confirmation
    Once the seat is allotted, candidates must report to the college, complete the required formalities, and pay the admission fees to secure their seat.

For Postgraduate Programs (MD/MS):

  1. Step 1: Appear for NEET-PG
    Candidates seeking admission to the postgraduate programs must appear for the NEET-PG conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE).
  2. Step 2: NEET-PG Counseling
    After clearing NEET-PG, candidates must participate in the counseling process for postgraduate medical courses. The seat allocation is done based on merit and rank.
  3. Step 3: Seat Allotment and Document Verification
    Selected candidates will be allotted seats in their chosen specialization based on their NEET-PG score. Document verification and fee submission follow the seat allotment process.
  4. Step 4: Final Admission
    Candidates must report to KIMS, complete the admission formalities, and begin their program.

Seats Reservation

Admission to KIMS is based on the NEET UG score, which is conducted by NTA. The institute has a total of 150 seats, which are fielded through the government quota, private quota, and NRI & Management quota. 

  • Government Quota Seats (G): 40% Seats
  • Private Seats (P): 40% Seats [50% for General Merit (GMP) & 50% for Open Seats (OPN)]
  • NRI Seats (N): 15% Seats
  • Other Seats (Q): 5% Seats

Is an MBBS degree from Romania valid in India?

Yes, MBBS degrees from MCI approved Romanian universities are recognized in India. Graduates can practice medicine back home after qualifying the MCI screening test.

What are the key advantages of studying MBBS in Romania?

Key advantages include English medium programs, globally valid MCI approved degrees, low fees, excellent education infrastructure, no donation or entrance exam, and vibrant student life.

How does MBBS in Romania compare with India?

The cost of education is lower in Romania but quality is at par with Indian colleges. Romania offers global exposure but studying in India has no language barrier. Both allow practicing medicine in India after qualifying Exam.

What is the MBBS admission process in Romania?

Admission involves applying directly to universities with class 12 marks, NEET score, paying fees and confirming admission. No entrance exam in Romania. Students get invitation letters for visa.

What documents are required to apply for MBBS in Romania?

Key documents include 10th/12th marksheets, NEET scorecard, passport copies, birth certificate, medical certificate, financial documents and passport size photos.

title: MBBS in Pondicherry
content:

With its well-established institutions and commitment to excellence, Pondicherry offers a unique opportunity to pursue MBBS in a conducive learning environment. This blog post aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the MBBS in Pondicherry, covering the admission process, top medical colleges, and the support available from renowned counseling services.

Pondicherry is a popular destination for medical education, offering high-quality MBBS programs through prestigious institutions like Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Sri Manakula Vinayagar Medical College, and Pondicherry Institute of Medical Sciences. The city’s medical colleges are known for their advanced infrastructure, experienced faculty, and excellent clinical exposure.

The MBBS course in Pondicherry spans 5.5 years, including a one-year mandatory internship. Admission is based on NEET-UG scores, with government and private colleges offering seats under state and management quotas. Government medical colleges, such as JIPMER, have relatively low fees, ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh per year, while private institutions charge ₹10–₹22 lakhs annually.

To be eligible for MBBS in Pondicherry, candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology and meet the NEET cutoff requirements. Government medical colleges generally require higher NEET scores (550+), while private colleges have lower cutoffs.

Pondicherry’s medical colleges provide excellent hands-on training, research opportunities, and diverse clinical cases, making it an attractive option for medical aspirants. The pleasant environment, affordable cost of living, and top-tier education make MBBS in Pondicherry a great choice for future doctors.

The MBBS program in Pondicherry is offered by several medical colleges, including government and private institutions. Some of the top medical colleges in Pondicherry are Aarupadai Veedu Medical College & Hospital, Shri Lakshmi Narayan Institute of Medical Sciences, and Mahatma Gandhi Medical College & Research Institute. title: SKS Hospital Medical College, Mathura
content:
SKS Hospital Medical College and Research Centre (SKSHMC), located in the spiritual city of Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, is a relatively new but rapidly growing institution in the field of medical education and healthcare services. Established under the aegis of the SKS Group, the college was founded with a vision to bridge the gap between rural health needs and quality medical education. The institution is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and affiliated with Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University (ABVMU), Lucknow.

Positioned in a region with a high demand for medical professionals and healthcare access, SKS Hospital Medical College has quickly made a name for itself by integrating modern medical training with a commitment to community service. The associated hospital – SKS Hospital is a tertiary care center providing a wide array of services to the local and nearby rural population.

The SKS Hospital Medical College is known for its state-of-the-art infrastructure, modern teaching facilities, and a dedicated faculty committed to shaping the future of medical professionals. The SKS Hospital Medical College offers undergraduate programs in Medicine (MBBS) and post-graduate courses in various medical specialties. The MBBS program provides students with a strong foundation in medical sciences, clinical practices, and hands-on experience through its well-equipped teaching hospitals.

The SKS Hospital, attached to the medical college, provides students with opportunities for clinical training, where they can gain experience in diagnosing and treating patients under the supervision of skilled professionals. The hospital is equipped with advanced medical technology and facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality healthcare services to the public.

The campus of SKS Hospital Medical College is designed to foster a conducive learning environment, with spacious lecture halls, well-equipped laboratories, libraries, and recreational areas. The college also emphasizes extracurricular activities, ensuring the overall development of students, which is crucial in producing well-rounded healthcare professionals.

In addition to academic excellence, SKS Hospital Medical College is also dedicated to research and innovation in the medical field. The institution regularly conducts medical seminars, workshops, and conferences to promote knowledge exchange and keep up with the latest advancements in healthcare.

Overall, SKS Hospital Medical College stands as an excellent choice for aspiring medical students seeking quality education in a supportive and well-equipped environment.

Overview of SKS Hospital Medical College, Mathura

Vision and Mission

SKS Hospital Medical College, Mathura envisions becoming a center of excellence in medical education, healthcare, and research. The institution aims to nurture compassionate, competent, and ethically sound healthcare professionals who are committed to serving society. Our vision is to bridge the gap between modern medical advancements and community health needs, especially in rural and underserved areas. We strive to cultivate a learning environment that encourages innovation, continuous improvement, and a deep sense of responsibility towards the health and well-being of humanity.

Vision:

To emerge as a center of excellence in medical education, healthcare, and research by nurturing competent, compassionate, and ethical medical professionals.

Mission:

  1. To provide quality medical education through a well-structured curriculum and innovative teaching methods.
  2. To offer affordable and accessible healthcare services to underprivileged and rural communities.
  3. To foster research, community outreach, and student-centered learning.

Campus and Infrastructure

SKS Hospital Medical College and Research Centre, Mathura, offers a well-planned and modern campus designed to provide a conducive environment for medical education and healthcare services. Spread over a spacious area, the campus is green, clean, and equipped with facilities that support both academic and residential life.

The academic block houses lecture halls with audio-visual aids, seminar rooms, and well-equipped laboratories that cater to various pre-clinical and para-clinical departments. The central library is a knowledge hub with a rich collection of medical books, national and international journals, and digital resources, offering a quiet space for students to study and conduct research.

The teaching hospital attached to the college, SKS Hospital, is a multi-specialty facility with more than 350 beds. It serves as a clinical training ground for students and provides healthcare to the local population. The hospital is equipped with modern diagnostic, surgical, and intensive care units, ensuring hands-on exposure to a variety of clinical cases.

The campus also features separate hostels for boys and girls, with clean and secure accommodation, mess facilities, and recreational areas. A cafeteria, sports grounds, and a gym are available for students’ physical and mental well-being. The college ensures 24/7 security and medical support, along with uninterrupted power and water supply.

SKS Hospital Medical College focuses on creating a holistic learning experience, blending academics with practical training and overall development. With a focus on discipline, professionalism, and compassion in healthcare, the campus infrastructure supports students in becoming competent and ethical medical professionals.

SKS Hospital Medical College is spread across a lush green campus in Mathura, featuring well-planned academic blocks, administrative offices, and residential zones for students and faculty.

Key Facilities:

  1. Academic Block: State-of-the-art lecture halls with modern teaching aids like LCD projectors, smart boards, and audio-visual systems.
  2. Library: A central library stocked with thousands of medical textbooks, national and international journals, e-resources, and digital access through HELINET and other portals.
  3. Laboratories: Fully equipped labs for anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, microbiology, pharmacology, pathology, and forensic medicine.
  4. Hostels: Separate hostels for boys and girls with 24/7 security, internet access, common rooms, and mess facilities.
  5. Hospital Building: A 350 bedded multispecialty hospital with OPD, IPD, ICU, NICU, PICU, emergency, and trauma care units.
  6. Auditorium: A large auditorium for conferences, seminars, workshops, and cultural activities.
  7. Cafeteria: Hygienic and nutritious meals available for students, staff, and patients.
  8. Sports and Recreation: Playground, indoor games room, gymnasium, and recreational zones for extracurricular development.

Academics

SKS Hospital Medical College, located in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, places a strong emphasis on academic excellence and comprehensive medical education. The institution offers the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) program, which is designed in accordance with the guidelines set by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The curriculum is a balanced blend of theoretical knowledge and practical training, ensuring students are well-prepared for the medical profession.

SKS Hospital Medical College currently offers the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) course and plans to expand into postgraduate programs and paramedical training in the coming years.

MBBS Course Details:

  1. Duration: 4.5 years of academic training + 1-year compulsory rotatory internship
  2. Annual Intake: 150 students
  3. Affiliation: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University, Lucknow
  4. Recognition: National Medical Commission (NMC)

Curriculum:

The curriculum follows the NMC’s Competency-Based Medical Education (CBME) model, which focuses on hands-on learning, clinical exposure, community medicine, and professional ethics.

Phases of Study:

  1. Phase I: Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry
  2. Phase II: Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Forensic Medicine, and Community Medicine
  3. Phase III (Part 1): General Medicine, General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Pediatrics
  4. Phase III (Part 2): Specialties like Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, ENT, Psychiatry, Dermatology, Radiology

Departments

SKS Hospital Medical College & Research Centre in Mathura offers a comprehensive range of medical and allied departments aimed at delivering quality education, research, and patient care. The college follows the guidelines set by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and ensures that all departments are equipped with the latest medical infrastructure and staffed with experienced faculty.

The SKS Hospital Medical College comprises various departments categorized into pre-clinical, para-clinical, and clinical disciplines:

  • Physiology
  • Biochemistry

  • Pharmacology
  • Pathology
  • Microbiology
  • Forensic Medicine
  • Community Medicine

  • Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy
  • Psychiatry
  • Anesthesiology
  • Radiodiagnosis
  • Emergency Medicine
  • Pulmonology
  • Dentistry

Each department is headed by experienced faculty and supported by associate professors, assistant professors, demonstrators, and tutors as per NMC norms.

Teaching and Learning Methods

SKS Hospital Medical College in Mathura places strong emphasis on a modern and holistic approach to medical education. The teaching and learning strategies adopted at the college are designed to ensure that students not only acquire theoretical knowledge but also develop practical skills, clinical reasoning, and a compassionate attitude toward patient care.

  • Interactive Lectures: Emphasis on case-based discussions, clinical correlations, and digital content.
  • Bedside Clinics: Regular ward rounds and OPD postings.
  • Simulation Labs: Skill development through mannequins and models before patient interaction.
  • Integrated Teaching: Horizontal and vertical integration among subjects.
  • Assessment: Formative and summative evaluations, practical exams, OSCE, OSPE, and internal assessments.
  • Mentorship: Faculty members mentor small groups of students for academic and emotional guidance.

Hospital Facilities (SKS Hospital)

SKS Hospital offers a wide range of healthcare services, including outpatient and inpatient care, emergency services, specialized consultations, and diagnostic services. The hospital is staffed with experienced medical professionals, including doctors, nurses, and support staff, ensuring that patients receive comprehensive care. Specialized departments in cardiology, orthopedics, pediatrics, dermatology, and gynecology are well-equipped to handle complex cases. The hospital also has advanced diagnostic equipment like CT scans, MRI machines, and ultrasound facilities, providing accurate and timely results for diagnosis and treatment.

The attached SKS Hospital is a fully functional, multi-specialty hospital with all essential diagnostic and therapeutic services.

Facilities:

  1. Beds: 350 with medical, surgical, obstetric, pediatric, and specialty wards
  2. Operation Theatres: Modular, sterile OTs equipped with modern surgical instruments
  3. ICUs: Medical ICU, Surgical ICU, NICU, PICU, and CCU
  4. OPD Services: Daily outpatient clinics across all departments
  5. 24/7 Services: Emergency care, Ambulance, Pharmacy, Radiology, Blood Bank
  6. Diagnostic Labs: Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology labs
  7. Imaging Services: Digital X-Ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan, and MRI (in development)

Admission Process

Admission is based on the NEET-UG score and follows the guidelines set by the Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh.

Eligibility:

  1. Minimum 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, Biology in 10+2 (40% for SC/ST/OBC)
  2. Qualifying NEET-UG with required cutoff
  3. Age: Minimum 17 years as of December 31 of the admission year

Admission Procedure:

  1. Appear for NEET UG
  2. Register for UP State NEET Counseling at upneet.gov.in
  3. Choice filling and locking
  4. Seat allotment as per NEET rank and preferences
  5. Reporting to the college with original documents

SKS Hospital Medical College, Mathura, offers various scholarships and financial aid options to help support students in their medical education. The SKS Hospital Medical College is committed to ensuring that deserving students, regardless of their financial background, can pursue their medical studies without the burden of high fees.

Faculty and Mentorship

SKS Hospital Medical College in Mathura prides itself on having a committed and experienced faculty dedicated to providing quality medical education and shaping future healthcare professionals. The SKS Hospital Medical College attracts well-qualified professors, associate professors, and assistant professors from diverse specialties, most of whom have rich academic backgrounds and clinical expertise. Their teaching methodology blends theoretical instruction with hands-on clinical training, ensuring that students not only understand the concepts but also know how to apply them effectively in real-world medical scenarios.

The SKS Hospital Medical College maintains a student-centric approach where faculty members are approachable and actively involved in the academic and professional growth of students. In addition to regular teaching, faculty members also guide students in research projects, publications, and participation in seminars and conferences at national and state levels.

Each student is assigned a mentor from the teaching faculty who provides continuous guidance throughout the duration of the course. These mentors help students cope with academic stress, improve their learning techniques, and make informed decisions regarding their future careers. The personalized mentorship ensures that every student receives the support needed for holistic development, not just academically but also emotionally and socially.

Furthermore, senior students and interns also play a supportive role in guiding juniors, creating a collaborative and encouraging learning environment. This layered mentorship system helps foster a sense of belonging and confidence among students as they progress through the rigorous MBBS program.

SKS Hospital Medical College takes pride in its committed and experienced faculty. Professors and associate professors are NMC-approved and come with years of teaching and clinical experience.

Academically, students benefit from well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, and a comprehensive library. Regular lectures, clinical postings, seminars, and workshops ensure that students receive thorough theoretical knowledge along with hands-on experience. The hospital attached to the SKS Hospital Medical College allows students to interact with patients and learn under the guidance of experienced doctors, which helps in building strong clinical skills from the early years.

Beyond academics, SKS Hospital Medical College promotes holistic development. The campus hosts various cultural events, sports tournaments, and student-led clubs throughout the year. Annual fests and celebrations bring together students from different batches, fostering a sense of community and friendship. The college encourages participation in intercollegiate competitions, debates, and awareness programs, helping students grow their confidence and communication skills.

Hostel facilities are provided within the campus for both boys and girls, with a focus on comfort and safety. The canteen serves hygienic food, and recreational areas give students a break from their busy schedules. Internet access, reading rooms, and sports facilities add to the quality of campus life.

Faculty members are approachable and supportive, often acting as mentors to guide students academically and personally. The environment encourages discipline, empathy, and teamwork—qualities essential for a future medical professional.

The SKS Hospital Medical College offers a well-balanced academic and social environment for overall student development.

Advantages of studying MBBS in Georgia

Affordable Tuition Fees

MBBS programs in Georgian medical universities cost relatively lower  compared to countries like the USA, UK or even private colleges in India. 

Globally Recognized Degrees

Georgian MBBS degrees are recognized by organisations like WHO and NMC,making it easier to practise medicine internationally. 

English Medium Programs

Georgian medical universities offer MBBS programs in English. 

No Entrance Exam

Admission in Georgian medical universities are straightforward, often without the need for an additional entrance exam like NEET. 

Safe and Welcoming Environment

Georgia is known for its hospitality and low crime rates.  

International Exposure

Georgia has a multicultural environment due to its medical universities attracting students from around the world, giving students a chance to build a global network. 

Post-Graduation Opportunities

Graduates can pursue further studies or practice medicine in various countries. 

Disadvantages of Studying MBBS in Georgia

Language Barrier

Language can be a barrier for students during clinical training due to Georgian being the local language. 

Climate Adaptation

Georgia’s harsh winters can be challenging for students from warmer countries. 

Cultural Adjustment

Indian food is available in some areas, it might not always match the students’ expectations and Adapting to Georgian culture, food, and social norms can take time. 

Recognition Issues

Georgian universities are recognized globally but not all, choosing a non- reputed or non NMC approved university could lead to problems in practising abroad or in India. 

Employment Opportunities

Employment opportunities may limit for international students as Georgia may prioritize local graduates for medical professions. 

Licensing Challenges

Students must clear the FMGE to practise medicine in India, which has a low passing rate.  

Limited Clinical Exposure

The patient inflow for clinical training in some universities is relatively low compared to countries like India.

MBBS in Georgia Vs MBBS in India

Cost of Education

Georgian: Georgian medical universities offer  affordable tuition fees.

India: Private Medical universities in India have extremely high tuition fees. 

Admission Process

Georgia: Georgian medical universities have a much simpler admission process,  requiring a qualifying NEET score and basic academic qualifications. 

India: Admission process in Indian medical universities is highly competitive based on NEET scores which have limited seats.  

Exposure and Opportunities

Georgia: Georgia offers international exposure to its students and opportunity by studying with students from different countries. 

India: Indian medical universities offer rich clinical exposure due to the large population of the country and variety of cases. 

Duration

Georgia: The duration of an MBBS course in Georgia  is 6 years including 1 year of clinical internship. 

India: The duration of an MBBS course in India is 5.5 years including 1 year of internship. 

Scholarship

Georgia: Georgian medical universities offer limited scholarships.

India: Indian medical universities offer various government and private scholarships.

Quality of Education

Georgia: Georgian medical universities offer English medium courses and has global reputation but language barriers might arise for students during clinical training which includes interacting with local patients 

India: MBBS colleges in India have great education and language barriers will not occur. 

Recognition and Licensing

Georgia: Georgian medical universities degrees are globally recognized by WHO and NMC. However, to practise in India, students must pass the FMGE/NExT exam, which has a low passing rate. 

India: Indian medical universities do not require any additional licensing exams, it directly qualifies students for internships and practice in India. 

Post- Graduate Opportunities

Georgia: Graduates have to take additional exams to pursue post- graduation. 

India: Graduates have to clear NEET-PG to pursue post- graduation. 

Course Duration in Georgia Universities

The MBBS course in Georgia  is 6 years long, which includes 5 years of academic education and 1 year of internship. The MBBS courses in Georgian  universities are English -medium.

Other countries: All other countries’ tuition fees range higher than Georgian universities. 

Language

Georgia: Georgian medical universities offer English medium courses to international students. 

Other countries: Countries like Germany have courses in only German and students are required to be fluent. 

Clinical Exposure

Georgia:  Georgian universities provide early clinical exposure to their students. 

Other countries:  In other countries clinical exposure starts in later years but can vary. 

Safe Environment

Georgia: Georgia has a safe, welcoming and culturally rich environment. 

Other countries: Countries like the USA and UK are safe but expensive, cultural adaptation may be challenging. 

Admission Process

Georgia: Georgian medical universities take direct admission without any entrance exam.

Duration

Other countries:  Countries like the USA and Germany take at least 7-10 years to complete MBBS. 

Cost of Living in Georgia
