Recognition and Affiliation

HIMSR is recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) and is affiliated with the Jamia Hamdard University, which is a deemed-to-be university. The college is also accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). Its programs are designed to meet the highest standards in medical education, with a focus on providing students with the latest scientific knowledge and clinical skills.

The college has been consistently ranked among the top medical institutions in India and continues to attract students from across the country. HIMSR is also a key contributor to the research community, with faculty and students engaged in various innovative research projects that focus on improving healthcare delivery and addressing health challenges faced by society.

Academic Programs Offered

HIMSR offers a wide array of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in medicine and allied healthcare fields. The institution is committed to maintaining high standards of medical education, equipping students with the knowledge, skills, and ethical foundation required to excel in the healthcare industry.

  • MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery): This is the flagship program of HIMSR, designed for students who wish to pursue a career in clinical medicine. The MBBS program is structured to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of medical sciences, followed by practical clinical experience through rotations in various specialties. It typically spans five and a half years, including one year of compulsory internship.
  • HIMSR offers several postgraduate degrees in different medical specialties, such as MD (Doctor of Medicine) and MS (Master of Surgery). These programs are designed to develop expertise in specific medical fields, preparing graduates for higher roles in the healthcare sector, such as consultants, researchers, and academicians.
  • In addition to degree programs, HIMSR also offers a variety of diploma courses in medical and paramedical disciplines. These programs are aimed at providing specialized training and technical skills in fields like medical imaging, clinical laboratory technology, and other allied healthcare fields.
  • HIMSR encourages advanced research in medical sciences through its Ph.D. programs. These programs allow students to delve deeper into medical research, contributing to new advancements in health science and medicine.

Infrastructure and Facilities

The infrastructure at HIMSR is world-class, with modern facilities designed to cater to the academic and healthcare needs of its students and faculty. The college has well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, and research centers. The campus is designed to facilitate an interactive and engaging learning environment, ensuring that students receive a holistic education in both theoretical and practical aspects of medicine.

  • Lecture Halls and Classrooms: HIMSR’s classrooms are equipped with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, making it easier for students to grasp complex medical concepts. The lecture halls are spacious, designed to accommodate a large number of students, and provide an environment conducive to learning.
  • Libraries: The HIMSR library is well-stocked with a vast collection of medical textbooks, journals, and research papers. It provides a quiet and comfortable space for students to study, conduct research, and stay updated with the latest developments in the field of medicine.
  • Laboratories: HIMSR has a wide range of specialized laboratories that offer practical training to students. These include anatomy, physiology, microbiology, pathology, and biochemistry labs. The labs are equipped with advanced technology to provide hands-on experience to medical students.
  • Hospital and Clinical Training: HIMSR is affiliated with the Hamdard Hospital and Research Centre, which serves as the teaching hospital for medical students. This hospital provides comprehensive healthcare services to the community and serves as a platform for students to gain practical clinical experience in different specialties. The hospital is well-equipped with advanced medical technology and is recognized for its patient care services.
  • Hostel Facilities: The college provides separate hostel facilities for male and female students, offering a comfortable and secure environment. The hostels are equipped with necessary amenities such as Wi-Fi, recreational areas, and mess facilities, ensuring that students have a home-like experience.

Faculty and Research

HIMSR boasts an experienced and dedicated faculty who are experts in their respective fields. The faculty includes renowned professors, associate professors, assistant professors, and guest lecturers, many of whom are actively involved in research and publication in leading medical journals. The faculty members employ innovative teaching methods, using case-based learning, problem-solving, and practical demonstrations to help students learn effectively.

Research is an integral part of HIMSR’s mission. The institution encourages students and faculty to engage in cutting-edge research in fields like medical sciences, public health, and health policy. HIMSR has several research collaborations with national and international institutions, and its researchers have contributed significantly to the medical community through various publications and patents.

Campus Life and Extracurricular Activities

The HIMSR campus provides students with a vibrant atmosphere where they can participate in various extracurricular activities. These activities include sports, cultural events, seminars, workshops, and medical conferences. The institution believes in fostering a well-rounded development for its students, and campus life at HIMSR reflects this philosophy.

  • Sports and Fitness: HIMSR offers a variety of sports and fitness activities, encouraging students to stay active and healthy. The campus includes sports facilities for cricket, football, basketball, and indoor games. Students also have access to a gymnasium and fitness center.
  • Cultural Activities: HIMSR has a thriving cultural scene, with events like annual fests, cultural shows, and music competitions. These events help students showcase their talents in the arts and provide them with a well-balanced lifestyle.
  • Medical Conferences and Workshops: HIMSR frequently organizes medical conferences, workshops, and seminars that provide students and professionals with opportunities to learn from renowned experts in various medical fields. These events are valuable for networking and staying abreast of the latest trends in healthcare.

Admissions and Eligibility Criteria

HIMSR admits students through the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test), a nationwide exam that serves as the primary entrance exam for undergraduate medical courses in India. Admission to postgraduate courses is based on the results of the NEET-PG exam. Eligibility requirements for different courses vary, and prospective students are encouraged to review the official guidelines provided by the institution.

MBBS Course Structure at HIMSR

The MBBS program at HIMSR is a comprehensive five-and-a-half-year course designed to produce skilled and compassionate doctors. The curriculum is divided into pre-clinical, clinical, and internship phases.

Pre-clinical Phase (First Year)

The first year of the MBBS program is focused on building a solid foundation in the basic sciences. The subjects covered include:

  • Anatomy: The study of human body structure, including dissection and understanding of body systems.
  • Physiology: The study of the functions of various systems in the human body.
  • Biochemistry: The study of chemical processes within and related to living organisms.

Para-clinical Phase (Second and Third Year)

In the second and third years, the focus shifts to the applied aspects of medical sciences. Students learn to connect their basic knowledge with clinical practice. The subjects taught include:

  • Pharmacology: The study of drugs and their effects on the human body.
  • Pathology: The study of diseases, including their causes, mechanisms, and effects on the body.
  • Microbiology: The study of microorganisms and their role in causing infections.
  • Forensic Medicine: The application of medical knowledge in legal matters.

Clinical Phase (Fourth and Fifth Year)

The clinical phase of the MBBS course focuses on hands-on training and exposure to real-life medical cases. Students are trained to diagnose and treat patients in various specialties such as:

  • Medicine: Understanding internal diseases and their treatment.
  • Surgery: Gaining skills in performing surgeries and post-operative care.
  • Obstetrics and Gynecology: Focusing on women’s health, pregnancy, and childbirth.
  • Pediatrics: The study of medical care for infants, children, and adolescents.
  • Orthopedics: Understanding musculoskeletal conditions and their treatment.

Internship (One Year)

The final year of the MBBS program is dedicated to a compulsory internship. Students are assigned to various departments of the teaching hospital to gain practical experience in diagnosing, treating, and managing patients under the supervision of qualified professionals. This phase helps students develop clinical skills and prepares them for independent practice.

Eligibility Criteria for Admission

Admission to the MBBS program at HIMSR is highly competitive and is based on academic performance and entrance examinations. The following are the eligibility criteria:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have completed their higher secondary education (12th grade) with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as subjects.
  • Minimum Marks: Candidates must have obtained a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in the 12th grade (45% for reserved category candidates).
  • Entrance Examination: Admission is based on the performance in the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test), which is a national-level examination conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

Admission Process

The admission process for the MBBS program at HIMSR follows a strict procedure:

  1. Application Submission: Candidates must fill out the application form for the NEET examination through the official NTA website.
  2. Entrance Exam: Candidates must appear for the NEET exam, which consists of multiple-choice questions covering Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
  3. Counseling: Based on the NEET score, candidates are called for counseling by the Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) or the HIMSR admission office. During counseling, candidates are allotted seats based on their ranks and preferences.
  4. Document Verification: Once a seat is allotted, candidates must submit their documents for verification, including educational certificates, NEET scorecard, and proof of identity.
  5. Final Admission: After document verification, candidates are admitted to the MBBS program at HIMSR.

Faculty at HIMSR

HIMSR boasts a highly qualified and experienced faculty who are dedicated to providing quality education to medical students. The faculty members include professors, associate professors, and assistant professors, many of whom are recognized experts in their respective fields. The faculty members are not only involved in teaching but also in research and clinical practice, ensuring that students receive up-to-date knowledge and real-world medical insights.

Infrastructure and Facilities

HIMSR is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities to support the academic and clinical needs of its students. Some of the key facilities include:

  • Lecture Halls: Spacious and well-equipped lecture halls with modern audio-visual aids for effective learning.
  • Laboratories: Well-equipped laboratories for practical sessions in Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, and Microbiology.
  • Library: A well-stocked library with a vast collection of medical textbooks, journals, and digital resources.
  • Hospital: HIMSR operates in association with Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, providing students with hands-on clinical training in a real-world hospital setting.
  • Hostels: The campus provides separate hostels for male and female students, with essential amenities for a comfortable stay.
  • Sports and Recreational Facilities: HIMSR provides sports facilities and organizes various extracurricular activities to promote a balanced lifestyle for its students.

Research at HIMSR

HIMSR emphasizes the importance of research in medical education. The college encourages students and faculty to engage in research activities to contribute to the advancement of medical science. Research projects at HIMSR focus on a variety of areas, including:

  • Clinical Research: Studying the effectiveness of various treatments and interventions.
  • Biomedical Research: Investigating new technologies and innovations in medical equipment and treatments.
  • Public Health Research: Analyzing health trends and working on solutions to improve public health.

Student Life

The student life at HIMSR is vibrant and enriching. Apart from academic pursuits, students are encouraged to participate in various extracurricular activities, such as:

  • Cultural Events: HIMSR organizes annual cultural fests where students can showcase their talents in music, dance, drama, and other forms of art.
  • Sports Competitions: The college hosts various inter-college sports events to promote physical fitness and teamwork.
  • Workshops and Seminars: HIMSR regularly organizes workshops, seminars, and guest lectures on contemporary medical topics to enhance the learning experience.

Career Opportunities

Graduates of HIMSR are well-prepared for careers in medicine and healthcare. They can pursue a variety of career options, including:

  • Clinical Practice: Many graduates go on to become practicing doctors in hospitals and clinics.
  • Postgraduate Education: HIMSR also prepares students for postgraduate studies in medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and other specialties.
  • Research and Academia: Some graduates choose to pursue careers in medical research or teaching in medical colleges.

Conclusion

Hamdard Institute of Medical Sciences & Research (HIMSR) is one of the leading medical colleges in India, offering high-quality education, clinical training, and research opportunities. With its state-of-the-art infrastructure, experienced faculty, and commitment to excellence, HIMSR continues to play a significant role in shaping the future of healthcare professionals. Its focus on holistic development, research, and patient care makes it an ideal choice for students pursuing a career in medicine. As HIMSR continues to grow, it remains dedicated to contributing to the healthcare industry by producing competent, compassionate, and skilled medical professionals.

title: Surendera Dental College
content:
The Surendera Dental College and Research Institute was founded in 2003, the SDCRI has advanced quality and given its student’s leadership skills while influencing the direction of dental education, research, and clinical care. In dentistry, SDCRI provides both undergrad (BDS) and graduate (MDS) programs.

Surendera Dental College and Research Institute (SDCRI) is a prestigious institution dedicated to providing quality education in dentistry. Located in the vibrant city of Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan, SDCRI is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities, distinguished faculty, and comprehensive curriculum designed to produce competent dental professionals. 

The institution provides a range of courses, such as UG Diploma, MDS, and BDS in the MBBS and Health Sciences stream. Out of the 127 available seats, students can take one of the popular courses with a focus on radiology, oral pathology, prosthodontics, periodontology, orthodontics, public health, or oral medicine.

This blog will provide a complete overview of SDCRI, discussing its advantages, admission requirements, admission process, available MBBS specializations, infrastructure, and hostel facilities, and answering frequently asked questions.

Overview of Surendera Dental College and Research Institute

Surendera Dental College and Research Institute was established to create a center of excellence in dental education and research. The institute aims to nurture future dental professionals by providing them with a robust educational foundation and clinical experience. 

Accredited by the Dental Council of India (DCI) and affiliated with Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS), Jaipur, SDCRI has consistently maintained high standards in dental education.

Modern Infrastructure

The institute boasts a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members who are committed to imparting quality education and guiding students in their academic and professional journey.

Research Opportunities

The institute encourages research activities, providing students with opportunities to engage in innovative research projects and contribute to the field of dental science.

Facilities

There is a well-stocked library at the Surendera Dental College & Research Institute with about 5000 books, 800 titles, and about 100 online journals. The college administration plans a wide variety of social, recreational, educational, and cultural events.

Holistic Development

Apart from academic excellence, the institute focuses on the overall development of students by organizing various extracurricular activities, workshops, and seminars.

Admission Requirements

To secure admission to Surendera Dental College and Research Institute, prospective students must meet the following eligibility criteria:

Educational Qualification

Students need to qualify for PCB in 10+2 standard. 

Minimum Marks

General category candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology. For SC/ST/OBC candidates, the minimum required marks are 40%.

Age Limit

 Candidates must be at least 17 years of age as of December 31 of the year of admission.

Entrance Exam

Candidates must qualify for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) for undergraduate admissions. For postgraduate admissions, candidates must clear the NEET-PG exam.

Admission Process

The admission process at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute is systematic and transparent, ensuring that deserving candidates secure a place in the institute. Here is a step-by-step guide to the admission process:

Application Form

Interested candidates need to fill out the online application form available on the institute’s official website.

Submission of Documents

Candidates must submit the required documents, including academic transcripts, NEET scorecard, identity proof, and passport-sized photographs.

Counseling Process

Shortlisted candidates are invited to the counseling process based on their NEET scores. During counseling, candidates can choose their preferred course and confirm their admission.

Fee Payment

After the counseling process, candidates must pay the requisite admission fees to secure their seats.

Enrollment

Finally, candidates need to complete the enrollment process by submitting the necessary documents and completing other formalities.

Required Documents

To complete the admission process at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute students need to submit some necessary documents. 

  • 10th or 12th class mark sheet
  • NEET Scorecard
  • Medical certificate
  • Passport size photographs
  • ID Proof
  • Bank Statement
  • Transfer Certificate

Medical Specializations at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute

Surendera Dental College & Research Institute offers a wide range of specializations in the field of dentistry, catering to the diverse interests and career aspirations of students. The major Surendra Dental College and Research Institute specializations available at SDCRI include: 

  • Oral Medicine and Radiology: Focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases and conditions using radiographic techniques.
  • Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery: Involves surgical procedures related to the face, mouth, and jaws.
  • Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics: Deals with the diagnosis, prevention, and correction of malpositioned teeth and jaws.
  • Periodontology: Focuses on the study and treatment of periodontal (gum) diseases.
  • Prosthodontics: Involves the design, manufacture, and fitting of artificial replacements for teeth and other parts of the mouth.
  • Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics: Pertains to the conservation of teeth and the treatment of dental pulp and root canal therapy.
  • Pediatric Dentistry: Specializes in dental care for children and adolescents.
  • Public Health Dentistry: Focuses on preventing and controlling dental diseases through community-based interventions.

 

Infrastructure at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute

SDCRI is committed to providing a conducive learning environment through its modern infrastructure and facilities. Some of the key features of the institute’s infrastructure include:

The institute has spacious and well-ventilated academic buildings equipped with modern amenities, digital classrooms, and lecture halls.

SDCRI boasts advanced laboratories for various dental specializations, providing students with hands-on experience using the latest equipment and technology.

Dental Clinics

The institute operates fully functional dental clinics where students gain practical experience by treating patients under the supervision of experienced faculty.

Research Center

The institute has a dedicated research center that promotes innovative research and development in the field of dentistry.

The state-of-the-art auditorium serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and cultural events, fostering a vibrant campus life.

Library

The library at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute comprises more than 900 titles, 200 journals, and about 5000 books. In addition, the library has a collection of books written by both domestic and foreign writers, as well as computers, an audiovisual room, and national and international journals. 

Hostel Facilities at Surendera Dental College and Research Institute

SDCRI provides comfortable and secure hostel facilities for its students, ensuring a home-like environment conducive to academic and personal growth. Key features of the Surendera Dental College and Research Institute hostel facilities include:

  • Accommodation: The institute offers separate hostels for boys and girls with well-furnished rooms equipped with essential amenities.
  • Dining: The hostel mess provides nutritious and hygienic meals, catering to the diverse dietary preferences of students.
  • Security: The hostel premises are secured with round-the-clock surveillance and security personnel, ensuring the safety and well-being of students.
  • Recreational Facilities: The hostels have recreational areas, including common rooms with TV, indoor games, and fitness centers, promoting a balanced lifestyle.
  • Wi-Fi: High-speed internet connectivity is available throughout the hostel premises, facilitating academic and personal online activities.
  • Laundry and Housekeeping: The hostel provides laundry and housekeeping services, ensuring a clean and comfortable living environment.

Conclusion

Surendera Dental College and Research Institute stand as a beacon of excellence in dental education, providing students with a comprehensive learning experience through its robust curriculum, modern infrastructure, and experienced faculty. 

With a focus on academic excellence, clinical exposure, and holistic development, SDCRI prepares students to become competent and compassionate dental professionals, ready to make significant contributions to the field of dentistry. Career Opportunities After MBBS in Tamil Nadu

Career opportunities after MBBS in Tamil Nadu Completing an MBBS in Tamil Nadu opens a wide range of career opportunities in both medical and non-medical fields. Tamil Nadu, known for its strong healthcare system and medical education infrastructure, provides several ways for MBBS graduates to create a successful career. 

  1. Postgraduate Medical Studies (MD/MS/Diploma) For people looking for expertise in a particular medical field, a doctor of medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS), or Postgraduate Diploma is a popular option. These courses help doctors specialize in various fields such as general medicine, pediatrics, orthopedics, dermatology, and more. The entry is through NEET-PG exam, and Tamil Nadu has many prestigious medical colleges that offer these programs. 

  2. Super-Specialization (DM/MCH) After completing MD/MS, doctors can opt for super-spatialization (DM/MCH) in areas such as cardiology, neurology, or gastroenterology. It adds significant expertise and enhances career prospects in high-deservable medical fields. 

  3. Government medical services Tamil Nadu has a strong public healthcare system, and MBBS graduates can work in primary health centers (PHCs), government medical colleges and district hospitals.MBBS in Tamil Nadu Medical Services Recruitment Board (MRB) conducts examinations for the posts of Medical Officer in government hospitals. Working in the government sector provides job safety, attractive salary and retirement benefits. 

  4. Private practice and hospital jobs Many MBBS in Tamil Nadu graduates choose to work in private hospitals, multi-specific clinics, or begin their practice. Tamil Nadu has top private hospitals like Apollo Hospitals, SRM Medical College Hospital and Miat International, which provide excellent career development opportunities.

  5. Medical research and teaching MBBS graduates with a passion for academics can enter medical research or teaching. Tamil Nadu has famous medical colleges such as Madras Medical College and Christian Medical College, Vellore, where graduates can pursue research after completing postgraduate degrees or join as faculty members. 

  6. Career in alternative medicine and overall health Some MBBS doctors also detect careers in alternative medicine, natural medicine and overall healthcare. In Tamil Nadu, areas such as Ayurveda, homeopathy, and yoga and naturopathy are growing, which offer diverse career options. 

  7. Medical administration and hospital management People interested in healthcare management can chase MBA in the hospital administration. This allows them to play the leadership role in hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and healthcare startups. There are prestigious institutions offering healthcare courses in Tamil Nadu, such as IIT Madras and Madras School of Economics. 

  8. Opportunity abroad Tamil Nadu MBBS graduates can do medical licensing examinations like USMLE (USA), Plab (UK), AMC (Australia), or MCCCU (Canada) to practice abroad. These routes provide high salary and risk for advanced medical systems. 

  9. Career in medical writing and journalism With the rise of digital health platforms, MBBS may work as graduate medical writers, health bloggers or medical journalists. Companies such as Medscape, BMJ and Pharmaceutical firms appoint medical professionals for material development. 

  10. Civil service and defense services MBBS graduates may appear for the UPSC Joint Medical Services (CMS) examination to work in the central government hospitals or to join the Indian Army, Navy or Air Force.

Admission Procedure MBBS in Tamil Nadu

Tamil Nadu is one of the most demanded states for medical education in India, offering many government and private medical colleges. 

The admission process for MBBS in Tamil Nadu follows the guidelines set by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and the Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Tamil Nadu. The admission is based on the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) run by the National Testing Agency (NTA). 

1. Eligibility criteria To be eligible for  admission to MBBS in Tamil Nadu, candidates have to fulfill the following criteria: Eligible NEET-NG should be 2026. 

  • An Indian citizen should be a foreign national (OCI) of India, or a non -resident Indian (NRI). Physics, chemistry, biology/biotechnology and English should be completed as core subjects with 10+2 or equivalent. 
  • PCB will receive at least 50%of the total marks (40%for SC/ST/OBC, 45%for PWD candidates). 
  • The age of 17 years should be completed by 31 December, 2026. 

2. The admission process MBBS in Tamil Nadu includes several stages, including registration, consultation, seat allocation and final admission.

Step 1: NEET-UG Examination

  • Candidates must appear for the NEET-UG 2026 and secure the minimum required cutoff percentile.
  • NEET-UG is the only entrance exam for MBBS admission in Tamil Nadu and across India.

Step 2: Registration for Counseling

  • After the NEET result is declared, candidates will have to register for Tamil Nadu Medical Counseling 2026 on the official website of DM, Tamil Nadu. 
  • Candidates will have to upload the necessary documents and pay the required registration fee.

Step 3: Merit List Publication

  • The Directorate of Medical Education (DME) releases the state merit list based on the NEET-OG score. 
  • Candidates are ranked based on their NEET score, and they are eligible for counseling only in the merit list.

Step 4: Counseling and Seat Allotment

Tamil Nadu conducts two types of counseling:

  • All India Kota (AIQ) Consultation (15% seats) – run by Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) State Kota Consultation (85% seats) – DME, run by Tamil Nadu. 
  • Round 1 Counseling: Candidates select their favorite colleges on merit basis. 
  • Round 2 counseling: If the seats remain vacant, the second round is held.
  • MOP-UP Round: If the seats are still unformed after the first two rounds. Stray Vacancy Round: Final Stage for any remaining vacant seats.

Step 5: Document Verification and Fee Payment

Candidates have to report to the Medical College allotted with the following documents:

NEET-UG 2026 scorecard class 10 and 12 mark sheet and passing certificate card groping certificate (for Tamil Nadu State quota) category certificate (if applicable) ID proof (Aadhaar, Passport, etc.) after verification of passport after verification of passport size after verification Photos, the candidates will have to pay the prescribed tuition fees and complete the admission formalities.

  • 15% AIQ Seats: Filled through MCC Counseling.
  • 85% State Quota Seats: Reserved for Tamil Nadu domiciled candidates.

What are the eligibility criteria for MBBS in Tamil Nadu?

In order to advance MBB -s in Tamil NADU, the candidates must complete 10+2 (PCB) with at least 50% marks (40% for reserved categories). They should also qualify for the meet-and-exam, as the entry is based on the neet score.

How many medical colleges are there in Tamil Nadu?

Tamil Nadu has around 70+ medical colleges, including authorities, private and regarded universities. Some top institutions include Madras Medical College, Stanley Medical College and Christian Medical College (CMC) Vellore.

 

What is MBBS recording process in Tamil Nadu?

Tamil Nadu is entered through NEET-ID consultation, which is administered by the Directorate of Medical Education (DM), Tamil NADU. Candidates must register, fill the election and participate in the counseling round based on their NEET -UG

 

What is the fee structure for MBBS in Tamil Nadu?

Government College: ₹ 13,000 – ₹ 1 lakh per year

Private College: ₹10 lakh – 25 lakh per year

Employed University: ₹ 15 lakh – out of 30 lakhs per year

 

What are the internship requirements for MBBS students?

Students at MBBS will have to complete one year of compulsory internships in hospital wards such as medical, surgery, pediatrics and maternity science and gynecology.

 

Are there any reservations for Tamil Nadu students?

Yes, Tamil Nadu follows state reservation policies including SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EWS categories. A certain percentage of government seats is reserved for state residential candidates.

 

What are the career opportunities for MBBS in Tamil Nadu?

Graduates can follow PG (MD/MS/DNB), can work in authorities/private hospitals, start their practice or join research. Tamil Nadu also has good opportunities in public health and medical administration.

title: Rohilkhand Medical College, Bareilly
content:
Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), Bareilly, is one of the leading private medical institutions in Uttar Pradesh. Established in 2006, the college is affiliated with Bareilly International University and recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). It provides high-quality medical education and healthcare services with advanced facilities and experienced faculty.

Spanning 42 acres of lush greenery, the Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital campus offers a serene environment conducive to learning. Its strategic location in the heart of Bareilly, along the National Highway, ensures easy accessibility from the bus stand and railway station. The campus is equipped with modern amenities, including air-conditioned classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, and a spacious library with separate reading rooms. Additionally, the college provides secure residential facilities with separate hostels for male and female students, offering accommodations on a twin-sharing basis. The hostels are complemented by hygienic canteen services and internet connectivity throughout the campus.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital is affiliated with a 1160-bedded super-specialty hospital that provides students with extensive clinical exposure and hands-on training. The hospital offers a wide range of medical services, ensuring that students gain practical experience across various specialties. Regular seminars, medical camps, guest lectures, and Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs are conducted to enhance students’ knowledge and skills.

The college encourages a balanced approach to education, promoting both academic excellence and extracurricular engagement. Various events and festivals are organized throughout the year, fostering a vibrant campus life. Students have access to clubs and societies that cater to diverse interests, facilitating personal growth and networking opportunities.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), located in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, is a prominent institution dedicated to medical education and healthcare services. Established by the Rohilkhand Educational Charitable Trust, Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital has evolved into a self-financing university under the aegis of Bareilly International University. The college is recognized for its commitment to providing quality medical education and comprehensive healthcare services.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), Bareilly, boasts a modern and well-developed infrastructure that supports both academic excellence and quality healthcare services. Spread across a sprawling campus, the college features state-of-the-art lecture halls equipped with audio-visual aids, well-stocked departmental libraries, and advanced laboratories for pre-clinical and clinical training. The central library is spacious and digitally equipped, offering a vast collection of medical books, journals, and online resources for students and faculty.

The hospital attached to the college is a 1160 bedded facility, providing a wide range of healthcare services, including emergency and trauma care, with dedicated ICUs, NICUs, and modular operation theatres. Additionally, the institution offers reliable transportation, 24/7 security, and in-house banking and pharmacy services. Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital emphasizes a holistic learning environment, integrating academics, clinical practice, and extracurricular activities to shape competent and compassionate healthcare professionals.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), located in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, offers robust hospital and clinical exposure that plays a pivotal role in shaping competent and confident medical professionals. The attached teaching hospital, with a capacity of over 1160 beds, provides a diverse and dynamic clinical environment for students right from the early years of their MBBS journey.

The hospital is well-equipped with modern diagnostic tools, advanced surgical units, and specialized departments such as cardiology, neurology, nephrology, oncology, and orthopedics. Students get hands-on experience under the guidance of experienced doctors and professors in both outpatient (OPD) and inpatient (IPD) departments. Daily rounds, case discussions, and interactive clinical postings are integral to their training, ensuring they gain practical skills in patient care, diagnosis, and treatment planning.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital also emphasizes early clinical exposure, where students interact with patients even in the first year, helping them build clinical acumen and patient communication skills gradually. The Emergency and Trauma Centre offers 24/7 services, and students witness a variety of real-time emergency cases, which enriches their practical learning.

Additionally, the college regularly organizes health camps, rural outreach programs, and specialty clinics, giving students opportunities to serve underserved communities and understand public health challenges. Simulation labs and skill labs further supplement their training, helping them refine procedural techniques in a controlled setting.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital has a 1160 bedded teaching hospital that serves as a learning ground for students.

Research & Academic Excellence

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), Bareilly, stands as a beacon of academic excellence and progressive research in the field of medical sciences. Affiliated with Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University and recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC), RMCH is committed to cultivating a strong academic foundation among its students while promoting a culture of inquiry and innovation.

The Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital offers a comprehensive array of undergraduate (MBBS), postgraduate (MD/MS), and diploma programs, designed to blend theoretical knowledge with practical clinical exposure. With a strong emphasis on evidence-based learning, the curriculum is regularly updated to align with global medical standards. The Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital also integrates modern teaching methodologies such as problem-based learning (PBL), case discussions, and simulation labs, ensuring that students gain critical thinking and hands-on skills essential for clinical excellence.

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital has made significant strides in the field of medical research. The college actively encourages students and faculty to engage in meaningful research activities through its well-established Research and Development Cell. Numerous papers have been published in reputed national and international journals, reflecting the institution’s growing academic footprint. Annual research conferences and CME (Continuing Medical Education) programs are organized to foster academic exchange and professional development.

The faculty at Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital includes experienced academicians and clinicians who mentor students with a deep commitment to academic rigor and ethical medical practice. Students are also encouraged to participate in national academic competitions, workshops, and seminars, helping them develop a broader perspective on healthcare delivery and innovation.

Through its integrated approach to academics and research, Rohilkhand Medical College and hospital, Bareilly, continues to prepare the next generation of healthcare professionals who are not only clinically competent but also research-oriented and socially responsible.

The institution encourages research activities among students and faculty.

  3. Collaboration with national and international medical organizations.

Student Life & Extracurricular Activities

The college fosters an environment where students can grow not only as competent medical professionals but also as well-rounded individuals.

The campus is equipped with modern amenities and a friendly atmosphere that encourages collaboration and camaraderie among students. Hostels are well-maintained, providing a comfortable and safe living environment. The college organizes regular orientation programs, cultural fests, and sports meets that help new students blend in and connect with their peers.

Extracurricular activities are a vital part of campus life at Rohilkhand Medical College and hospital. Students actively participate in clubs related to music, dance, dramatics, fine arts, literature, and debate. Events like the annual cultural fest “Oorja” and the inter-college sports competition are major highlights that draw enthusiasm from students across various years. These platforms allow students to showcase their talents, build confidence, and foster team spirit.

The Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital also encourages students to engage in community service and public health awareness drives. Medical camps, blood donation drives, and health check-up events in rural areas help students gain real-world exposure and contribute meaningfully to society.

Additionally, student councils and academic societies play an important role in leadership development. They help organize seminars, guest lectures, and quiz competitions, ensuring a stimulating academic atmosphere beyond the classroom.

Placements & Career Opportunities

Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital (RMCH), Bareilly, offers a wide range of career opportunities for its graduates, backed by a strong academic foundation and extensive clinical exposure. As one of the reputed private medical institutions in Uttar Pradesh, Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital focuses on producing competent medical professionals ready to meet the challenges of the healthcare industry.

Rohilkhand Medical College equips its students with the knowledge, clinical skills, and confidence required to build successful careers in medicine, whether they choose to practice, teach, research, or pursue higher studies.

title: TS Misra Medical College and Hospital, Lucknow

TS Misra Medical College and Hospital (TSMMCH), located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, is a premier private medical institution that has earned a name for itself in the field of medical education and healthcare services. Established with a vision to provide quality education and medical care, TS Misra Medical College and Hospital combines state-of-the-art infrastructure with a highly qualified faculty to nurture the next generation of healthcare professionals.

The TS Misra Medical College and Hospital is affiliated with Dr. Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation University, and is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC), ensuring that it meets national standards in education and clinical practice.

TS Misra Medical College and Hospital was founded under the umbrella of the Vishwamitra Educational and Social Welfare Society, with the aim of addressing the growing need for quality medical professionals in the country. The institution was envisioned by its founders to serve both rural and urban populations by combining education with accessible healthcare services.

The TS Misra Medical College and hospital is situated in Amausi, on the outskirts of Lucknow, making it easily accessible yet away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The serene and green campus is spread across more than 25 acres, offering an ideal environment for learning and patient care.

Well-connected by road and located close to the Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport, the campus is convenient for students and faculty traveling from different parts of the country.

The central library spans approximately 2,400 square meters and houses a diverse collection of books and journals. Laboratories are equipped with advanced research facilities for practical training.

Separate hostels for male and female students provide essential amenities, including 24/7 power backup, security, medical facilities, water heaters, air conditioning, and a food court. Sports facilities encompass basketball, cricket, and football grounds, along with a gymnasium.

The on-campus cafeteria offers a variety of hygienic food options. An auditorium is available for events and activities. Additionally, the college provides transportation services for students and faculty.

TS Misra Medical College and Hospital offers modern infrastructure to support holistic medical education.

Each department has its own state-of-the-art lab with modern equipment. Practical training in anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, and microbiology is conducted under the guidance of trained staff.

Hospital and Clinical Training

The hospital is equipped with numerous operating theaters and critical care beds across various specialties, providing students with comprehensive exposure to diverse medical conditions and treatment modalities.

The TS Misra Medical College and Hospital emphasizes hands-on experience, allowing students to engage in patient care under the supervision of experienced faculty members. This practical approach ensures that students develop essential clinical skills and a deep understanding of patient management. The hospital’s advanced infrastructure and technology further enhance the learning environment, preparing students for real-world medical challenges. ​

In addition to clinical training, TS Misra Medical College and Hospital offers a range of in-patient and out-patient healthcare services, addressing the needs of the community and providing students with opportunities to participate in comprehensive patient care. The institution’s commitment to integrating education with practical experience fosters the development of competent and compassionate healthcare professionals.

The T.S. Misra Hospital is a 700 bedded multi-specialty hospital situated within the same campus. It serves as the primary clinical training ground for students. 

Key features include:

  1. 24×7 Emergency and Trauma Services
  2. Intensive Care Units (ICU, PICU, NICU)
  3. Modular Operation Theatres
  4. Advanced Radiology and Imaging Services (CT, MRI, X-Ray, USG)
  5. Blood Bank
  6. Pharmacy
  7. Specialized OPDs and IPDs

Students receive hands-on training in patient care under close supervision. From third year onward, students actively participate in clinical rounds, diagnosis, and patient interaction.

The hospital caters to a large patient population from rural and semi-urban areas, giving students vast exposure to a wide range of medical conditions.

Research and Innovation

Research is encouraged at all levels. Students are guided to take up ICMR STS projects, attend national and international conferences, and publish papers. The TS Misra Medical College and Hospital has a dedicated Research Cell that monitors ongoing research and promotes ethical scientific inquiry.

The labs are equipped for basic and advanced research in biomedical sciences. Collaborative projects with other institutions are in the pipeline.

TS Misra Medical College and Hospital (TSMMCH) in Lucknow is dedicated to advancing medical research and fostering innovation. The institution emphasizes a culture of inquiry, aiming to contribute significantly to the medical community. ​

Research Contributions:

  • Circadian Rhythm Studies: Investigations into the circadian patterns of serum 25(OH) vitamin D, calcium, and phosphorus levels in type-2 diabetes mellitus patients have been conducted, providing insights into metabolic fluctuations in diabetic individuals.
  • Peptic Ulcer Research: Studies on the circadian time structure of plasma lipid peroxides, antioxidant enzymes, and other small molecules have enhanced the understanding of peptic ulcer pathophysiology.
  • Renal Artery Stenosis Analysis: A comparative study assessed the prevalence and characteristics of renal artery stenosis in diabetic versus non-diabetic patients, utilizing renal artery Doppler ultrasonography.
  • Postoperative Sore Throat Prevention: Research evaluated the effectiveness of budesonide suspension in preventing postoperative sore throat in surgical patients following endotracheal intubation.
  • Cervical Pap Smear Observations: An observational study analyzed 200 cervical Pap smears to identify the prevalence of various cytological abnormalities in women.

TS Misra Medical College and Hospital remains committed to integrating research with clinical practice, ensuring that innovative findings translate into improved patient care and medical education.

title: Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College Ujjain
content:
Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College (RDGMC), Ujjain, is one of best medical colleges in Madhya Pradesh, known for its quality education, top-notch infrastructure, and dedicated faculty. 

Located in the historic city of Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, RDGMC is committed to producing competent doctors equipped with modern medical knowledge and all-round skills. This blog provides an in-depth look at various aspects of the Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College, from the MBBS program to facilities and recognitions.

Overview of MBBS at RDGMC

Ujjain has been an epicenter of learning since ancient times. It is historically significant as the place where Lord Krishna received his education at Sant Sandipani’s Ashram, located on the banks of the river Kshipra. 

In 1997, a dedicated group of trustees envisioned and initiated the Medical College project, successfully establishing R D Gardi Medical College (RDGMC) in 2001. RDGMC, the first private medical college offering MBBS in Madhya Pradesh, operates under the Ujjain Charitable Trust Hospital and Research Centre. It is recognized by the National Medical Commission And the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. 

Since 2009, RDGMC has been offering undergraduate and postgraduate courses in eighteen subjects, including pioneering PG degrees in Dermatology, Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases, and Psychiatry in Madhya Pradesh.

The hospital associated with the college has 400 beds, and an additional 800-bedded functional hospital on the Medical College Campus provides all services free of charge. So far, nine batches of undergraduate students and five batches of postgraduate students have graduated successfully.

Why is RDGMC Ujjain the Best Option?

Stop wondering about whether to get enrolled in Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College. Read all the points stating the college’s advantageous feature provided below to know why this college should be your choice.

Infrastructure

  1. The medical college building comprises all pre-clinical and para-clinical departments along with an administrative wing. Each department is equipped with office chambers for faculty members, demonstration rooms, various laboratories, and a museum. 
  2. The college features lecture theaters, an examination hall, and an auditorium that meet NMC standards.
  3. Students here receive practical training at the renowned Ujjain Charitable Trust Hospital & Research Centre, a 400-bed multi-specialty hospital established in 1992. 
  4. This hospital, extending their services to patients within a 200 km radius of Ujjain city, was the first in Madhya Pradesh to install a world-class CT scanner and a lamellar airflow-equipped operation theater. 
  5. It still remains the only hospital in the Ujjain Division offering facilities for hemodialysis, EEG, gastroscopy, cystoscope, and neurosurgery.

Hospital situated in the College Campus

  1. Additionally, a world-class 720-bed hospital established in 2001 on the medical college campus provides almost free services to patients. 
  2. The hospital has several revered specialties such as cardiology, nephrology, urology, neonatology, general surgery, orthopedics, ophthalmology, gynecology, trauma management, otorhinolaryngology, TB & chest diseases, dermatology, psychiatry, and pediatrics.
  3. This hospital features twelve well equipped operation theaters, ICU, ICCU, NICU, PICU, SICU, obstetric ICU, and respiratory ICU. It also has advanced diagnostic facilities, including a 1.5 Tesla MRI, DSA with Cath lab, various fiber optic and rigid endoscopes, laser equipment, a fundus camera, operating microscopes, CD4 counter, dry chemistry auto analyzer, cell counter, blood gas analyzer, ELISA reader, chemiluminescence analyzer, video EEG, EMG, BERA, blood component facility, Bactac, and immunohistochemistry.
  4. The hospital’s outpatient department, designed with patient convenience in mind, is spread over 80,000 square feet to prevent overcrowding and provides services across all clinical disciplines. Both outpatient and inpatient services, including medicines, investigations, and operations, are provided free of cost.

Library

  1. The medical college has  a central library housing over 20,634 textbooks and reference books, 80 national and 46 international journals. 
  2. For all the youth out there, It ranks among the most aesthetically pleasing libraries in India and includes audio/visual materials and equipment. 
  3. The library offers internet access, with 2,300 international journals available online through Medlar and Proquest. Internet library facilities are also accessible in departmental libraries and hostels.

MBBS Duration and Medium of Instruction

The MBBS program at Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College is of 5.5 years duration, which includes:

  • 4.5 years of academic study divided into nine semesters.
  • 1 year of compulsory rotatory internship.

The medium of instruction for the MBBS program is English.

Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for admission to the course of MBBS in Madhya Pradesh at RDGMC, candidates must fulfill the following criteria:

  1. The candidate must have passed a 10+2 or equivalent examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects.
  2. At least an aggregate score of 50% is needed in core subjects like Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.  
  3. For SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories, the minimum score required lowers down to 40%. 
  4. Candidates must be at least 17 years old as on 31st December of the year of admission.
  5. All the candidates looking for MBBS admission in Madhya Pradesh at Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College must qualify for the NEET UG conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

Documents Required for Admission

Candidates need to submit the following documents during the admission process:

  1. 10th and 12th Mark sheets and Passing Certificates
  2. NEET Admit Card and Score Card
  3. Transfer Certificate (TC) from the previous institution
  4. Migration Certificate (for students from other boards/universities)
  5. Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  6. Passport-size Photographs
  7. Aadhar Card or any valid ID proof
  8. Medical Fitness Certificate
  9. PwD certificate (if applicable)

Recognitions and Affiliation

Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College is recognized by various national and international bodies, which adds to its credibility and quality of education. The institution is recognized by the National Medical Commission(NMC), which is responsible for looking after all the medical institutes of India .

The institute is also certified by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. It is affiliated to Vikram University, Ujjain.

Hostel and campus

They offer beautifully constructed separate hostels for boys, girls, resident doctors, interns, and nurses on campus. These hostels feature twin-sharing rooms equipped with mess facilities and solar water heating.

The college provides excellent transportation facilities, including four buses with a capacity of 50 seats each, several 10-seater vehicles, and ambulances. Additionally, a 20-seater bus and an ambulance are available for village-level health services.

title: MVJ Medical College & Research Hospital

MVJ Medical College and Research Hospital is one of India’s premier medical education and healthcare services institutions. Situated in Bangalore, Karnataka, it has earned a reputation for providing quality medical education, world-class infrastructure, and advanced healthcare facilities. 

Established in 2001, the institution is affiliated with the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) and recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). The college has significantly contributed to medical education in Karnataka, producing skilled doctors who have excelled in their fields.

MVJ Hospital Hoskote offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs in various medical specializations, ensuring students receive a comprehensive and hands-on education. 

The attached 950-bed hospital provides students with practical exposure to diverse medical conditions and treatment procedures, making it an ideal place for clinical training.

The medical college has 150 3D projection halls, 6 lecture halls, and 500 examination hall capacity. The library is spread over 35,000 sq ft. on two floors. One floor accommodates over 850 at a single time.

For Postgraduate Programs (MD/MS):

  • NEET PG: It is mandatory to qualify for NEET-PG for admission into postgraduate medical courses.
  • Internship: The completion of a one-year rotating internship is essential.

Admission Process of MMU Ambala Medical University

Candidates must pass the NEET UG exam 2026 to be taken into consideration for admission to clinical schools in India. The National Testing Agency (NTA) administers this examination, which is used as a trend-setting entrance exam for scientific programmes at numerous institutions around the country. Candidates have to attain the minimal qualifying marks required with the aid of the NTA, which allows them to be taken into consideration for additional admissions strategies.

MBBS Admission Process

  • Check NEET UG eligibility criteria before participating in the counseling process, candidates should carefully review the eligibility criteria set by the NTA.
  • Participate in Haryana NEET Counseling
  • During the counseling process, candidates are required to fill in their preferred choices of colleges and courses online. Based on the candidate’s NEET UG rank, choices filled, and availability of seats, the authorities will allocate seats to the candidates
  • After the seat allotment, candidates need to undergo document verification.
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm admission

MD/MS Admission Process

  • Candidates aspiring for postgraduate medical courses must qualify for the NEET PG exam. This exam is conducted at the national level and gives a common entrance test for admission to various MD/MS/PG Diploma courses in medical colleges across India.
  • After qualifying for the NEET PG exam, candidates need to participate in the counseling process conducted by the authorities of Haryana.
  • During the counseling process, candidates are required to provide their preferences for colleges and courses based on their NEET PG rank.
  • Once the seat allotment is done, candidates need to undergo document verification.
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm admission

Haryana NEET Counseling Process

Step 1: Candidates must register on the official online platform or portal that has been supplied by the authorities. They must then complete the registration form by entering their personal information, academic information, and other required facts.

Step 2: After registration, candidates are required to make an online payment of the security money or counseling fee. This payment is necessary to confirm the candidate’s participation in the counseling process.

Step 3: Once the registration and payment processes are completed, the authorities release the merit list. The merit list is prepared based on the candidate’s performance in the entrance examination.

Step 4: Candidates now have to fill in their preferred choices of medical colleges and courses. The choice filling is done online through the designated portal within a specified time frame.

Step 5: After the choice filling, the seat allotment process started. The allotment is done based on the candidate’s merit rank, choices filled, reservation criteria, and availability of seats. The seat allotment results will get published on the online portal or official website.

title: Sharda University
content:
The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) was established in the year 2009 under Sharda University, which envisions an ambience of excellence, inspiring value-based education, research and development.

SMSR is approved for an intake of 250 students in MBBS courses by the Medical Council of India, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. The school provides comprehensive facilities for teaching, research and patient care.

The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) primarily imparts medical education of the highest standards to its MBBS and postgraduate students and students of related biological sciences.

A high academic standard is maintained by an experienced and dedicated team of professors, clinicians and scientists, who are engaged in teaching, research and developing technologies in healthcare.

The school adopts innovative methods in education with community-based teaching, learning and research.

The educational goal of SMSR is to ensure a holistic development of theoretical and practical skills with the aim to prepare compassionate human beings, caring and courteous medical professionals, responsible and socially-conscious citizens.

One of the important requirements of the medical education program is the practical training, be it medical, nursing or paramedical courses. This is why SMSR is co-located with Sharda Hospital, a 1600+ bed super-specialty hospital for imparting extensive clinical & practical training to its medical students.

The hospital is functioning as an integral part of the medical institution. It is equipped with all the modern facilities and sophisticated medical equipment with the objective of providing a comprehensive healthcare solution under one roof to all sections of the community.

SMSR and Sharda Hospital have highly qualified, experienced consultants and teachers who continuously strive to improve the educational activities, the health care delivery system and to make SMSR a center of excellence in medical education.

In SMSR and Sharda Hospital, research is an integral part of academic work. Research is undertaken on relevant major public health and medical problems, mostly revolving around the tropical environment in which this institution is located.

The school envisions signing Memorandum of Undertaking with National and International institutes and Government agencies to enhance collaboration & research partnership.

The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR), established in 2009 under Sharda University, is dedicated to providing high-quality medical education, research, and training. Located in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, SMSR offers a comprehensive MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery) program designed to cultivate competent and compassionate medical professionals.

Lecture Theatres: The institution boasts air-conditioned lecture halls fitted with modern audio-visual aids to facilitate effective teaching and learning.

Hostel Accommodation: Separate hostel facilities for male and female students offer comfortable living spaces with essential amenities, ensuring a conducive environment for study and relaxation.

Medical Facilities: Students have access to Sharda Hospital, a 1600+bed super-specialty hospital adjacent to the college, providing extensive clinical exposure and practical training opportunities.

Sports and Recreation: The campus offers various sports facilities, including courts for basketball, tennis, and volleyball, promoting physical well-being and extracurricular engagement.

Distinguished Faculty:

SMSR prides itself on a team of dedicated and highly experienced faculty members drawn from leading academic institutions such as AIIMS, PGI, UCMS, Lady Hardinge, and BHU. Their expertise and commitment significantly contribute to the institution’s reputation for academic excellence.

Research and Development

Emphasizing the importance of research, SMSR encourages students and faculty to engage in innovative projects addressing major public health and medical challenges, particularly those relevant to the tropical environment of the region. Collaborations with national and international institutions further enhance research opportunities and knowledge exchange.

Graduates of the MBBS program at SMSR are well-prepared to pursue various career paths, including clinical practice, medical research, healthcare administration, and further specialization through postgraduate studies. The comprehensive education and training equip them to excel in diverse healthcare settings both nationally and internationally.

In summary, the School of Medical Sciences and Research at Sharda University offers a robust MBBS program characterized by a comprehensive curriculum, distinguished faculty, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and extensive clinical training, all aimed at developing skilled and compassionate medical professionals.

Research Facilities

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University integrates research as a fundamental component of its academic framework. The institution is dedicated to advancing medical knowledge through a variety of research initiatives and collaborations.​

Research Infrastructure:

  1. Central Research Laboratory: SMSR houses a central research lab equipped with advanced instruments, facilitating interdisciplinary research across various medical fields.
  2. Departmental Research Facilities: Individual departments, such as Anatomy, possess specialized research facilities supporting studies in osteology, histology, and gross anatomy.

Collaborative Research:

The institution emphasizes partnerships with national and international organizations to enhance research endeavors. These collaborations aim to deepen the understanding of biological processes and improve disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

Research Output:

Faculty and students actively engage in research activities, contributing to numerous publications in esteemed national and international journals. This scholarly output reflects SMSR’s commitment to addressing significant public health and medical challenges, particularly those pertinent to the tropical environment of its location.

In summary, SMSR provides a robust research environment with state-of-the-art facilities and collaborative opportunities, fostering advancements in medical science and education.

Hostel and Accommodation

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University in Greater Noida offers comprehensive hostel accommodations designed to provide a comfortable and conducive living environment for its students. The university maintains separate hostels for male and female students, each equipped with modern amenities to cater to diverse preferences and needs.

Hostel Facilities:

Room Options: Students can choose from various room configurations, including single, double, and triple occupancy rooms. These rooms are available in both air-conditioned (AC) and non-air-conditioned (Non-AC) variants, allowing students to select accommodations that best fit their comfort and budget.​

Amenities: Each room is furnished with essential amenities such as beds, study tables, chairs, and wardrobes. The hostels also provide 24/7 security, ensuring a safe living environment for all residents.​

Dining Services: The hostel premises include a dedicated dining facility capable of catering to over 3,800 students. The mess serves four meals daily—breakfast, lunch, evening tea, and dinner—with menus that are regularly updated to offer a variety of nutritious and hygienic food options.

Sports and Extracurricular Activities

The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University in Greater Noida emphasizes the holistic development of its students by offering a variety of sports and extracurricular activities. These programs are designed to complement the rigorous academic curriculum, promoting physical well-being, creativity, and a sense of community among students.​

Sports Facilities and Activities:

SMSR provides a range of sports facilities catering to diverse interests. Students have access to various sports clubs and activities, allowing them to engage in physical exercise and team sports. Participation in these activities not only enhances physical health but also fosters teamwork, leadership skills, and stress relief, which are essential for medical professionals. ​

Cultural and Artistic Pursuits:

Understanding the importance of cultural engagement, SMSR offers clubs and events focused on dance, music, and other artistic endeavors. These platforms enable students to explore and showcase their talents, contributing to a vibrant campus culture. Involvement in cultural activities aids in the development of creativity and provides a balanced lifestyle amidst the demands of medical education. ​

Student Organizations and Leadership:

The institution encourages students to participate in various clubs and organizations, providing opportunities for leadership and community involvement. Engagement in these groups helps students develop organizational and interpersonal skills, preparing them for collaborative roles in their future medical careers. ​

By integrating sports and extracurricular activities into its educational framework, SMSR aims to cultivate well-rounded individuals who excel academically and possess the personal attributes necessary for success in the medical field.

Campus Life

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University in Greater Noida offers a vibrant and enriching campus life that extends beyond academics. Students have access to a variety of extracurricular clubs and activities, including dance, music, theatre, and literature, fostering a well-rounded educational experience.

The campus is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, featuring fully air-conditioned libraries stocked with an extensive collection of books and resources, providing an ideal environment for study and research.

Sports enthusiasts can engage in both indoor and outdoor games, with facilities available for various sports. The university regularly organizes sports contests, promoting physical well-being and teamwork among students.

Cultural events and festivals are integral to campus life at SMSR, offering students opportunities to showcase their talents and celebrate diverse traditions. The campus also hosts various technical clubs associated with each school, encouraging students to pursue their interests and develop new skills.

Overall, SMSR provides a dynamic and supportive environment that nurtures both academic excellence and personal growth, ensuring a holistic development experience for its students.

Alumni Network

The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University, established in 2009, has cultivated a robust alumni network comprising thousands of graduates who have become integral members of the global medical community. These alumni have significantly contributed to healthcare both within India and internationally, showcasing the institution’s commitment to excellence in medical education.​

SMSR actively fosters connections among its alumni through various initiatives, including annual events like Foundation Day and Alumni Meets. For instance, the Foundation Day & Alumni Meet was held on December 16, 2023, providing a platform for graduates to reconnect, share experiences, and engage with current students and faculty.

The alumni network serves as a vital resource for mentorship, professional development, and collaborative opportunities, reflecting SMSR’s dedication to nurturing a supportive and dynamic medical community.

Placement and Career Opportunities

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University offers robust career opportunities for its graduates. Upon completing the MBBS program, graduates are required to undertake a one-year mandatory internship at Sharda Hospital. During this period, interns receive a structured stipend: ₹7,000 per month for the first three months, ₹8,000 for the next three months, ₹9,000 for the subsequent three months, and ₹10,000 for the final three months.

Post-internship, many graduates secure positions as Junior Residents (JRs) at Sharda Hospital or other reputable healthcare institutions. The starting salary for JRs at Sharda Hospital is approximately ₹65,000 per month. Those employed in hospitals in Delhi may earn around ₹1,00,000 per month.

Additionally, a significant number of graduates opt to prepare for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET-PG) to pursue specialized medical fields. This pathway enhances their expertise and broadens career prospects in various medical disciplines. ​

In summary, SMSR provides a comprehensive platform for medical students, encompassing structured internships, immediate employment opportunities, and avenues for advanced specialization, thereby ensuring a promising career trajectory in the medical field

Student Life and Activities

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University, established in 2009, offers a vibrant student life enriched with diverse activities and facilities that foster both academic and personal development.

Campus Life

SMSR provides a dynamic campus environment with various gardens and playgrounds, offering students spaces for relaxation and recreational activities. The campus promotes a balanced lifestyle, allowing students the freedom to engage in pursuits beyond academics.

Students at SMSR have opportunities to participate in a range of extracurricular activities, including sports and cultural events. These activities are designed to enhance the overall student experience, promoting teamwork, leadership, and cultural awareness.

The institution emphasizes student well-being by providing access to counseling services and wellness programs. These resources aim to support students’ mental and emotional health, ensuring a conducive learning environment.​

Community Engagement

SMSR encourages students to engage in community service and outreach programs, fostering a sense of social responsibility and empathy. These initiatives provide practical experience and contribute positively to society.​

In summary, SMSR at Sharda University offers a holistic educational experience, blending rigorous academic training with a supportive and enriching student life.​

Accreditations and Recognitions

​The School of Medical Sciences and Research (SMSR) at Sharda University, established in 2009, has garnered several key accreditations and recognitions that underscore its commitment to excellence in medical education and healthcare services.​

National Medical Commission (NMC) Approval

SMSR is approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC), formerly known as the Medical Council of India (MCI), which is the apex regulatory body overseeing medical education in India. This approval authorizes SMSR to admit students into its MBBS and postgraduate programs, ensuring that the curriculum and training meet national standards.

University Grants Commission (UGC) Recognition

As a constituent of Sharda University, SMSR benefits from the university’s recognition by the University Grants Commission (UGC) of India. The UGC is responsible for maintaining standards of higher education in the country, and its recognition affirms the university’s adherence to quality benchmarks.

National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH)

The institute’s associated teaching hospital has achieved accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH). This accreditation reflects the hospital’s commitment to delivering high-quality patient care and maintaining rigorous healthcare standards.

National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL)

SMSR has also secured accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL). This accreditation signifies that the institution’s laboratories meet international standards for quality and competence, ensuring reliable and accurate diagnostic services.

These accreditations and recognitions collectively affirm SMSR’s dedication to providing exemplary medical education and healthcare services, aligning with both national and international quality standards.

Delhi is widely recognized as a prime destination for pursuing MBBS in Delhi and MD/MS courses due to its exceptional medical institutions and numerous advantages of learning and accommodation facilities. The capital city of India attracts students from different parts of the country and even from abroad, offering a diverse and enriching educational experience.

Delhi’s medical institutions provide exceptional research opportunities, with state-of-the-art laboratories and research facilities that allow students to engage in impactful research projects and contribute to advancements in the medical field. Candidates must pass the NEET UG exam in order to be considered for admission to medical colleges for MBBS in India. The National Testing Agency (NTA) administers this exam, which is used as a standard entrance exam for medical programmes at numerous institutions around the nation. Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks required by the NTA in order to be considered for additional admissions procedures.

  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm admission

MBBS in Bihar, every year, thousands of Indian students want to get admission to Bihar’s medical colleges. To  be eligible for admission to the MBBS program at LBKMCH, candidates must fulfill the following criteria:

Candidates must have completed their 10+2 or equivalent examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as main subjects. A minimum of 50% aggregate marks is required for general category students, while reserved category students must have at least 40%.

  5. Payment of Fees: Upon successful counseling and document verification, candidates must pay the requisite admission fees to confirm their seat.
  6. Commencement of Classes: After the admission process is completed, students will be informed about the start date of the academic session.

This institute was established in 2016, since then JIMSH has been providing top-notch medical services to patients from West Bengal and neighboring states. 

The institute has received the Letter of Permission from the National Medical Commission to commence a medical college offering 200 MBBS seats, 100 GNM seats, 100 B.Sc. Nursing seats under the West Bengal Nursing Council & Indian Nursing Council, and 130 Paramedical seats under the State Medical Faculty of West Bengal for the 2023-2024 academic year.

Overview

Why MBBS at RKDF Medical College & Research Centre Bhopal is the Best Place in India
