  • Global Recognition: The MBBS degree is recognized worldwide, opening doors for future practice or specialization abroad. The WHO, NMC, and other world-leading organizations recognize a degree.

Eligibility and Admissions Process for MBBS in India

Those students who looking for an MBBS in India need to meet the eligibility criteria to get into reputed colleges.

Educational Qualification:You must have a clear 12th class in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, scoring a minimum of 50% marks.

Entrance Exam:Crack the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET), the sole MBBS entrance exam in India.

Age:Students should be 17 years of age and complete their age by December 31st of the admission year. 

Required Documents for MBBS in India

To get MBBS admission in India, students are required to submit some documents, which are mentioned below. 

  • 10th class mark sheet 
  • 12th class mark sheet 
  • NEET score card
  • Passport size photographs
  • Original passport
  • Medical certificate
  • Neet admit card
Read more : Documents Required For Neet Counselling

MBBS Course Duration in India

  • The course of MBBS in India takes 5.5 years to complete, including a one-year required internship. 
  • The medium of instruction is mainly English. 
  • Medical study in India is divided into 9 semesters. 
  • The 4.5 years are going to theoretical studies and the last year is dedicated to internships. 

Curriculum and Internship

The MBBS curriculum in India is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of medical sciences, clinical skills, and patient care. It follows the guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC) and spans 5.5 years, including 4.5 years of academic study and one year of mandatory internship.

The academic phase is divided into three professional phases:

  • Pre-Clinical (1st year) – Subjects include Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry.
  • Para-Clinical (2nd year) – Includes Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, and Forensic Medicine.
  • Clinical (3rd to 4.5 years) – Focuses on Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Orthopedics, ENT, Ophthalmology, Psychiatry, and Community Medicine.

The one-year internship is compulsory and provides hands-on training in various hospital departments like Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Community Medicine. Interns gain practical experience in patient management, emergency care, and minor procedures under supervision.

The curriculum integrates theoretical knowledge with clinical exposure, ensuring students develop essential diagnostic, therapeutic, and communication skills. Regular assessments, including university exams, clinical postings, and practical evaluations, shape competent medical professionals ready for postgraduate studies or medical practice.

Scope and Career Opportunities

After completing MBBS, graduates can pursue postgraduate studies (MD/MS) or opt for super-specialization (DM/MCh). They can work in hospitals, research institutions, or even start their own clinics. Opportunities also exist in public health, medical writing, and international healthcare organizations.MBBS in India opens a wide range of career opportunities in both the clinical and non-Nordic fields. Graduates can choose to be a specialist, go into clinical practice or to detect alternative career paths in health care, research and administration.  

1. Post Graduate Specialization (MD/MS/DNB)

Many MBBS candidates choose to specialize in areas such as cardiology, neurology, surgery or pediatrics MD (Doctor of Medicine) or MS (MS of Surgery).DNB (Diplomate of National Board) There is another option for super-facilization. 

2. Clinical practice and government jobs

Doctors can work in public or private hospitals, clinics and health stations . Competitive exams such as UPSC CMS and State PSC Medical Officer Recruit MBBS candidates for state services.  

3. Research and academics

Medical research, drugs and medical colleges have opportunities in teaching, for example,  after cleaning qualifying studies such as Neet/PhD. Program. 

4. Option career

Graduates can detect areas such as hospital administration, medical journalism, medicine-legal advice and health IT.

5. Global Opportunity

In many countries, the opportunities for international careers offer and are recognized in many countries after approving exams such as (USA), PLAB (UK) and AMC (Australia) 

Along with India’s growing health sector, MBBS is made up of a  high-lack and  rewarding profession.

Conclusion

Pursuing an MBBS in India is a prestigious and rewarding journey for aspiring doctors. With numerous government and private medical colleges across the country, students have diverse options based on their NEET-UG ranks. Institutions like AIIMS, JIPMER, and top private colleges provide world-class education, modern infrastructure, and experienced faculty. The rigorous curriculum, extensive clinical exposure, and practical training prepare students for a successful medical career. While competition is intense, opportunities for specialization and global recognition make MBBS in India a valuable choice. Ultimately, dedication, perseverance, and hard work are key to excelling in this field and serving society effectively.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the duration of MBBS in India?

MBBS in India takes 5.5 years, including 4.5 years of academic study and a 1-year internship.

What is the eligibility for MBBS in India?

Students must complete 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology and qualify for NEET-UG.

Is NEET compulsory for MBBS?

Yes, NEET-UG is mandatory for admission to any medical college in India.

What is the average MBBS fee in India?

Fees vary: Government colleges charge ₹10,000–₹2,00,000 per year, while private colleges charge ₹10–₹25 lakh annually.

How many MBBS seats are there in India?

As of 2024, India has around 1,07,000 MBBS seats across government and private colleges.

What are the best government medical colleges in India?

AIIMS, JIPMER, MAMC, and KGMU are among the top government medical colleges.

Can foreign students study MBBS in India?

Yes, foreign students can apply under the NRI or foreign quota.

What is the internship duration in MBBS?

One year of mandatory internship in hospitals is required after completing the course.

Is an MBBS degree from India recognized abroad?

Yes, but students may need to pass licensing exams like USMLE (USA) or PLAB (UK) for practice abroad.

 

What are the career options after MBBS in India?

Graduates can become doctors, pursue PG studies (MD/MS), research, or work in healthcare management.

Admission procedure for NEET PG counselling

  1. Registration and Fee Payment: Candidates must register online on the official website and pay the required fee to participate in the counselling process. Upon completion of registration, candidates can download the acknowledgment page for document verification.
  2. Document Verification: Candidates who are called for document verification must bring all the necessary documents to be verified by the counselling committee.
  3. Eligible List and Seat Matrix Publication: After document verification, the list of eligible candidates and seat matrix will be published on the official website according to the schedule.
  4. Registration, Choice Filling, and Locking: Eligible candidates must register again and fill their choices on the web portal, locking their preferences for seat allotment.
  5. Seat Allotment Process: The committee will conduct the seat allotment process based on the candidates’ preferences.
  6. Result Publication: Selected candidates’ results will be published on the official website for admission, and they must report to the allotted college on the scheduled dates.
  7. Reporting: Candidates must report to the college for admission. Admission will be granted based on seat availability.
  8. Filling up of Vacant Seats: If seats remain vacant after the first round of counselling, they will be filled during the second round of counselling. Candidates must register again for further rounds of counselling.

NEET PG 2023 Cutoff

You may forecast the NEET PG Categories-wise cutoff for 2023 using the information regarding the NBE NEET PG 2023 expected cutoff that is provided in this section. Let’s look at it.

Eligibility for Counselling

  • Candidates need to qualify NEET PG 2023 to be eligible for West Bengal PG medical admission.
  • The state quota seats are divided into three categories: A, B, and C.
  • Category A includes candidates who completed their MBBS from West Bengal.
  • Category B includes candidates who completed their MBBS from outside West Bengal but are permanent residents of the state.
  • Category C includes candidates who completed their MBBS outside West Bengal but have worked in rural areas under the West Bengal government for a minimum of 3 years.
  • The candidate must have completed their MBBS from an institute recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI).
  • Aspirants must be registered with MCI/State Medical Council.
  • The candidate must have completed a mandatory 12 months rotatory internship by March 31, 2022.
  • Medical fitness of the candidate is mandatory for admission.

Pacific Medical College and Hospital Udaipur, popularly known as PMCH Udaipur, is a private medical institute located in Udaipur, Rajasthan. Established in 2014, the college offers undergraduate (MBBS) and postgraduate (MD/MS) courses. It is affiliated with Pacific Medical University Rajasthan and is approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC). As a private institution, PMCH Udaipur provides comprehensive medical education and training, ensuring high-quality healthcare professionals to contribute to the medical field.

The Admission Process of Pacific Medical College

Candidates must pass the NEET UG exam in order to be considered for admission to MBBS in India. The National Testing Agency (NTA) administers this exam, which is used as a standard entrance exam for medical Programmes at numerous institutions around the nation. Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks required by the NTA in order to be considered for additional admissions procedures.

MBBS Admission Process:

  • Qualify the NEET UG entrance exam
  • Check NTA NEET eligibility criteria
  • Participate in rajasthan NEET counseling
  • Complete Seat allotment process
  • Undergo document verification
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm admission

MD/MS Admission Process:

  • Qualify the NEET PG entrance exam
  • Participate in rajasthan NEET PG counseling
  • Undergo Seat allotment process
  • Verification of the documents
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm admission

  • Completion of the 10+2 examination or its equivalent examination.
  • Candidates must have obtained a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying examination.

For M.D/MS

  • Possession of an MBBS degree or its equivalent degree.
  • Candidates must have successfully completed the MBBS course.

Pacific Medical College and Hospital : Affiliation, Recognition and Achievement, 

Pacific Medical College is a private institution affiliated with Jaipur National University Jaipur and approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Being a private medical college, it operates independently without government aid. The affiliation with Jaipur National University ensures academic standards and the integration of a comprehensive curriculum. The approval from the National Medical Commission signifies the college’s adherence to the necessary regulations and guidelines for medical education. With its private status, the institute can provide a unique educational experience and infrastructure to foster the growth and development of aspiring medical professionals.

Student Support

The college is committed to maintaining a safe and conducive learning environment for all students, and as such, has implemented a strict anti-ragging policy. Ragging, in any form, is strictly prohibited, and disciplinary actions are taken against those found guilty. The college also provides counseling services to support students’ mental and emotional well-being. Qualified counselors are available to offer guidance, address personal concerns, and provide assistance with academic or career-related challenges.

The college prioritizes the health and well-being of its students by providing access to healthcare services. Medical facilities are available within the college premises or in collaboration with nearby hospitals to cater to students’ healthcare needs. These services ensure timely medical assistance and promote a healthy campus environment.

Facilities

The institute offers a comprehensive range of facilities and services to support medical education and the well-being of students. It is equipped with medical and computer labs, providing hands-on training and access to advanced technology. The library is a valuable resource, offering a vast collection of medical literature and research materials. Sports facilities and an auditorium promote a well-rounded experience, fostering physical and cultural development. The cafeteria offers nutritious meals, while hostel facilities provide a comfortable living environment for students. With fully-equipped laboratories, students gain practical skills and engage in scientific exploration. The institute’s hospital and OPD cater to healthcare needs, while the Centre for Community Medicine focuses on community health. The presence of a blood bank ensures emergency preparedness, and medical social and welfare services contribute to holistic care.

content:
Punjab NEET PG 2023 Counselling The Baba Faridkot University of Health Sciences (BFUHS) has been appointed as the conducting authority for the counselling process of Punjab NEET PG 2023 admission. Interested candidates who have qualified for the NEET PG examination can apply for admission to both government and private medical colleges in Punjab by registering online. The registration process for Punjab PG medical admission 2023 will be conducted online, and only NEET PG qualified candidates are eligible to participate in this counselling process

MBBS Abroad

Punjab NEET PG Counselling

ParticularsDetails
Name of the admissionPunjab PG medical admission
Admission conducts on the basis ofNEET PG scores

Number of seats (tentative)719 MD/MS/PG Diploma seats & 109 MDS seats

The Punjab PG medical admission process is based on the scores obtained in the NEET PG examination. The counselling for this admission is conducted by the Baba Faridkot University of

Health Sciences in Punjab. The total number of seats available for the MD/MS/PG Diploma courses is 719, while there are 109 seats available for the MDS course. Aspirants who have qualified for the NEET PG exam can participate in this counselling process to secure admission to the desired course.

Eligibility Criteria in Punjab NEET PG  Counselling

  • Only candidates who have completed their MBBS from BFUHS University are eligible for admission to government medical colleges in Punjab.
  • Candidates who have completed their MBBS from Adesh University should select Adesh University as their preferred institute while registering for counselling.
  • Candidates who have completed their MBBS from SGRD Medical College in Amritsar should select SGRD as their preferred institute while registering for counselling.
  • For general category seats in government institutes such as DMC Ludhiana and CMC Ludhiana, candidates who have completed their MBBS from BFUHS University are eligible to apply.
  • Reserved seats for SC and BC categories are available to candidates who are domicile of Punjab, regardless of where they completed their MBBS

Document Required for Punjab NEET PG  Counselling

  • NEET PG admit card 2023
  • Allotment submission form
  • Secondary school certificate for date of birth proof
  • Application form copy
  • NEET PG 2023 result
  • Compulsory rotatory internship certificate
  • MBBS pass certificate form a recognized institute of MCI
  • Original copy of photo ID proof (Voter ID/PAN card/Driving License) for biometric verification
  • A set of photocopy of all the above-mentioned documents

Punjab NEET PG 2023 Counselling Procedure

  • 1.Counselling Registration:
  • Interested candidates must register themselves online on the official website of BFUHS.
  • Candidates must ensure their eligibility before filling out the registration form.
  • Candidates need to upload scanned copies of their photograph and signature.
  • They must submit the application fee through a challan form at any OBC Branch.
  • 2 Appear for Online Counselling and Exercise College and Course Options:
  • Candidates must be physically present at the counselling venue on the scheduled date and time.
  • They need to provide their choice of college and specialty at the time of counselling.
  • Allotment of Seats:
  • The authorities determine the merit of the applicants based on their NEET PG scores and make allocation of seats based on merit, category and exercised choices.
  • Candidates must bring all original documents at the time of physical counselling.
  • Submission of 6-Months Tuition Fee:
    candidates have to pay tuition fee for 6 months at the time of counselling through a demand draft at Registrar, Baba Farid University of Health Sciences.
  • Reporting at Allotted College:
  • Finally, candidates must report to the allotted college as per schedule.
  • Candidates selected for admission to various PG courses have to submit a bond while reporting.

content:
The Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS) in Telangana conducts the centralized online counselling process for NEET PG 2023. This process enables candidates to apply for MD/MS courses in government and private medical colleges affiliated with the state medical university in Telangana.

Telangana NEET PG 2023 Counselling – Overview

Exam nameNEET PG 2023

The counselling process for Telangana PG Medical Admission 2023 is conducted by the KNR University of Health Sciences, Warangal. The admission is based on the NEET PG 2023 scores, which is conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE). Candidates who have qualified for NEET PG 2023 can participate in the Telangana PG Medical Admission 2023 counseling

Eligibility Criteria in Telangana NEET PG 2023 Counselling

  • The candidate must have qualified NEET PG 2023.
  • The candidate must be a citizen of India, including PIO/OCI.
  • The candidate must have either completed their MBBS from an institute located in Telangana/Andhra Pradesh or be a domicile of Telangana/Andhra Pradesh

Telangana NEET PG 2023 Counselling Procedure

Step 1: Register for counselling through the official website of KNRUHS using the NEET PG roll number, rank obtained, date of birth, and mobile number.

Step 2: Pay the application fee based on category (Rs 5,500 for Unreserved/Backward or backward classes, Rs 5,000 for scheduled Caste/Scheduled or scheduled tribes).

Step 3: Submit mandatory documents, including an MBBS degree certificate, an internship certificate, and a medical registration.

Step 4: A state merit list is prepared based on NEET PG 2022 ranks.

Step 5: Candidates submit their preferences for colleges/courses through web-options entry and fill in as many options as possible.

Step 6: If a seat is allotted and the candidate is satisfied, they must report to the respective institute for confirmation of the seat. There is no free exit in Telangana.

The admission process for MBBS in india and BDS programs in Chhattisgarh is known as the Chhattisgarh MBBS and BDS Admission. The Directorate of Medical Education, Raipur, is responsible for the counselling process. Admissions are based on NEET scores from the year 2023, and the National Testing Agency (NTA) is the examination authority. Tentatively, a total of 1565 MBBS seats and 600 BDS seats are offered through this admission process.

Admission process for NEET UG Counselling:

  • Candidates are required to register themselves with CGDME NEET UG 2022 by paying a registration fee of Rs. 1000 for General and OBC categories, Rs. 500 for SC/ST categories, and Rs. 10000 for NRI candidates.
  • Online registration opens only once for students before the first round of counselling.
  • Candidates can log in to their accounts and fill in their choices for seat allotment.
  • The eligible candidates’ list cum merit list will be displayed after the choice-filling process.
  • Seat allocation is based on the candidate’s rank, institute cutoff ranks, candidate’s preference, priority, etc.
  • Candidates can verify their documents and accept the seat, and then report to the respective college for admissions. Alternatively, students can opt for upgradation in Round 2.
  • Subsequent rounds of seat allotment will be conducted as per the schedule, and candidates can participate in further counselling rounds.
  • Only Round 1 and Round 2 will be conducted online, while the Mop-up round will be conducted offline.

Eligibility to Pursue MBBS from Chhattisgarh:

  • Indian citizenship is mandatory for Chhattisgarh MBBS admission 2023.
  • Candidates must be at least 17 years old by December 31, 2023, with no maximum age limit.
  • Class 12 pass certificate from Chhattisgarh or any recognized board with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects is required.
  • Domicile criteria vary based on birthplace, residency, and parent’s employment.
  • Minimum three years of education from an institution located in the state or in undivided Madhya Pradesh required for those with state residency.
  • Class 11 and 12 must be completed by a state-recognized University or Board.
  • NEET cutoff 2023 is a crucial factor for MBBS admission to Chhattisgarh, with category-wise cutoffs varying.

Documents Required for Admission:

The required documents for Chhattisgarh MBBS and BDS Admission are:

  • Class 10th Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate
  • 12th or Equivalent Examination Mark Sheet
  • NEET Score Card
  • Proof of Date of Birth
  • School Leaving Certificate or Transfer Certificate
  • Caste Certificate
  • Non-Creamy Layer Certificate
  • PwD Certificate
  • Domicile Certificate
  • Photo ID Proof

title: China Three Gorges Medical University 2024-25 | Courses, Fees, Admission
content:
An ever more common choice for global medical students is to study China Three Gorges University MBBS in China. China has achieved incredible strides in the realm of medicine, offering its residents a healthy and secure environment thanks to its several highly regarded medical institutes and universities that receive international acclaim. These prestigious colleges provide MBBS in China, making them a desirable option for aspirant physicians.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

Why MBBS in China?

  • Top medical universities in China provide excellent educational facilities and infrastructure.
  • China Three Gorges University provides a well-equipped library, cafeteria, gym, and other amenities for students.
  • The medical universities in China are approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

China Three Gorges University is a famous institution recognized by the Ministry of Education. It was established in 2000 by merging the former Wuhan University of Water Conservancy and Electric Power. The university has gained recognition as one of the top choices for Indian students seeking affordable MBBS in China. It holds accreditation from NMC/ WHO, and other renowned medical organizations.

As one of the leading Medical universities in China, CTGU China is a member of the United Nations Academic Impact (UNAI) and offers a wide range of academic degrees, including Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Doctoral programs. All courses at the university are taught in the English language, making it accessible for international students.

China and India share many similarities as the two countries with the largest populations in the world. Since 2013, there has been an increase in interest among Indian students in studying medicine in China. The medical education system in China is renowned for its commitment to offering top instruction. In addition to academic instruction, students benefit from practical training that enhances their skills and abilities. The availability of several low-cost MBBS in China, which offer education at a fraction of the cost of medical college Nanjing Medical University  in wealthy nations, is one of the most significant advantages.

Apply Now

Why MBBS in China?

  • The New National Medical Commission’s requirements for the Indian Licencing Exam are met by the MBBS programme in China.
  • Indian students can transition to the MBBS programme in China with ease because the curriculum and subjects studied there are extremely comparable to those in India.

Nanjing Medical University provides a comprehensive MBBS program with a duration of 6 years, including a 1-year internship. The program is designed to be completed in 5 years, which includes the internship period and leads to the award of an MBBS degree.

Nanjing Medical University encompasses approximately 16 schools or departments, providing a huge range of disciplines. Some of the faculties available at the university include medical science, public health, stomatology, and pharmacy.

Nanjing Medical University Eligibility Criteria

For rapid admission, Indian students interested in studying MBBS in China should review the Nanjing Medical University Eligibility Criteria.

  • The minimum age requirement is 17 years.
  • Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English are mandatory subjects for higher education
  • A minimum 50% score is required in 10+2 in all the above-mentioned subjects.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates require a minimum of 40% score in 10+2 in all the above-mentioned subjects.
  • Qualification in the NEET exam is a must.

Nanjing Medical University Admission Process

Indian students who are interested in attending Nanjing medical University for MBBS in China can evaluate the entrance requirements for speedy admission.

  • Fill out the application form and attach a passport-sized photo.
  • Submit your 11th and 12th standard mark sheets and school leaving certificates.
  • Pay the required application, admission, and processing fees.
  • Send the processing fees to either China or India, based on the earlier option.
  • Receive the official photocopy of your Admission Letter within seven working days.
  • Begin the student visa process by applying at the nearest Chinese Embassy/Consulate.
  • Gather the necessary documents for the visa application, including a valid passport, photographs, Visa Application Form, JW202 Form, and Admission Letter.
    Complete a health check-up and obtain a Physical Examination Record.
  • Upon arrival in China, be received by a representative at the airport and guided to the university hostel.
  • Assist in paying the admission and administrative fees at the university counter the next morning.
  • The overall timeline from receiving the Admission Letter to obtaining the China Visa is approximately one month.

A: Nanjing experiences a humid subtropical climate with four distinct seasons. Summers are hot and humid, with temperatures reaching around 30-35°C . Winters are cold, with temperatures averaging around 0-8°C . Spring and autumn are mild and pleasant, with temperatures ranging from 10-20°C .

Admission procedure NEET UG counseling 2023

The Karnataka NEET counseling 2023 process involves the following stages:

  1. Registration: Candidates need to register on the official website of KEA by entering their personal details, educational qualifications, uploading their photograph, signature and thumb impression, and paying the registration fee.
  2. List of registered candidates: KEA will release a list of registered candidates along with the schedule for document verification.
  3. Document verification: Candidates need to carry all the required documents to the verification centre for offline document verification
  4. Secret Key and choice filling: Eligible candidates will be provided with a secret key to fill in their choices on the option-entry portal.
  5. Seat allotment list: KEA will release a list of candidates who have been allotted a seat based on their merit and choice of colleges.
  6. Post-allotment process: Candidates who have been allotted a seat need to confirm their choice on the official website of KEA, pay the fee, and report to the allocated institute with the admission order.

Eligibility for NEET UG counseling 2023

  • To be eligible for a particular requirement, the candidate must have passed Class 10 and Class 12 from an educational institution located in Karnataka.
  • In addition to this, the candidate must have studied for a period of seven years at a government school located in Karnataka.
  • Alternatively, the candidate must have passed Class 11 and Class 12 from an educational institution located in Karnataka.
  • For this alternative requirement, either of the candidate’s parents must have studied for a period of seven years at an educational institution located in Karnataka.
  • Another eligibility requirement is that either the candidate or either of their parents must have Kannada/Tulu/Kodava as their mother tongue.
  • Additionally, the parent with the aforementioned mother tongue must be a domicile of Karnataka state.

Documents required for NEET UG Counseling

The following documents are required for the Karnataka NEET counseling 2023 application:

  • A final copy of the application form after submission

  • NEET 2023 admit card

  • Class 10th marksheet

  • Candidate’s study certificate
  • Valid photo ID proof
  • Recent passport-sized photograph (two in number)
  • Caste/caste income certificate (if applicable)
  • Rural study certificate (if claiming rural quota)
  • Kannada medium study certificate (if claiming Kannada medium quota)
  • Hyderabad-Karnataka Region Reservation Certificate (if applicable)

title: Haryana NEET-UG Counseling 2023
content:
DMER, which stands for Department of Medical Education and Research, is responsible for conducting the counseling process for medical seats in Haryana. The counseling process includes 85% seats of government medical colleges and 100% seats of private medical colleges. However, the remaining 15% of seats of government colleges fall under the All-India Quota and the Medical Counseling Committee handles the counseling for these seats.

Apply Now

MBBS India

Haryana NEET Counseling 2023 is conducted by the Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DMER), Haryana for admissions into MBBS/BDS courses in the state. The admission process is solely based on the scores obtained by candidates in the NEET UG examination, which is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Candidates who are eligible and have qualified for the NEET exam can participate in the Haryana NEET counseling process to secure a seat in a medical/dental college in the state of Haryana. 

Eligibility for Haryana NEET counseling

  • The candidate must be an Indian citizen, NRI, OCI, or PIO.
  • The candidate must be a bona fide resident of Haryana.
  • The candidate must be at least 17 years old by December 31, 2023.
  • The candidate must have passed Class 12 or equivalent examination from a recognized institution with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects.
  • The candidate must score a minimum of 50% in aggregate in the above-mentioned subjects (for general category candidates).
  • Reserved category candidates must obtain a minimum of 40%, and PWD category students must secure at least 45%.
  • The candidate must qualify for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) by securing the minimum qualifying percentile.
  • The minimum qualifying percentile is 50 for general category candidates, 40 for SC/ST/OBC aspirants, and 45 for PWD candidates.

Haryana NEET UG  Counseling Process 2023

 Candidates must register themselves for Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2023 and pay the required fee based on their category.

  • Document verification must be done physically at Pt. B.D Sharma UHS, Rohtak.
  • A merit list of eligible candidates will be displayed.
  • Candidates can then exercise choice filling by logging into their respective accounts.
  • Seats will be allotted based on the candidate’s rank, institute cutoff ranks, candidate’s preference, priority, etc.
  • Candidates can accept the seat and report to the respective college for admissions or opt for upgradation in Round 2.
  • Subsequent rounds of seat allotment will be conducted as per schedule, and candidates can participate in further counseling rounds.
  • Candidates need to deposit the requisite amount to participate in the 2nd round, failing which they will not be eligible.
  • This amount will be adjusted later on in the fee of the first year of the UG Course.
  • After the completion of the counseling process, the amount deposited by candidates who are not allotted seats during the 2nd round will be returned.

Document Required for Haryana NEET Counseling

  • Class certificate (PH/FF/SN) of Candidate
  • NEET result 2023
  • Admit card for NEET 2023
  • Affidavit stating that candidate is not being domiciled in a state other than MP.
  • Class 10th mark sheet
  • Class 12th mark sheet
  • Caste certificate of candidate (if required)
  • Income certificate of parents
  • Domicile certificate.

The admission process of NEET Counseling 2023 

  • The counseling for Maharashtra MBBS/BDS 2023 will be conducted online by the authority.
  • Only registered candidates who are included in the state merit list will be eligible for Maharashtra MBBS 2023 counseling.
  • To participate in the counseling process, candidates must first register and fill out the application form.
  • Candidates will need to choose the respective code for the courses and colleges they wish to apply for during the Maharashtra NEET – UG counseling 2023. The code will be a combination of four numbers along with alphabets S and N, where the S suffix will represent the state quota, while the N suffix will be for the NRI quota.
  • Candidates will be allowed to fill in as many choices as they want for the Maharashtra MBBS counseling 2023 process.
  • After filling in the choices, candidates must carefully check and review them before submitting. Once submitted, candidates should lock in their choices for Maharashtra MBBS/BDS Counseling.
  • The authority will release the seat allotment list for Maharashtra MBBS/BDS 2023 based on the preferences submitted by candidates, NEET 2023 result, state merit rank, reservation criteria, eligibility conditions, and availability of seats.

Eligibility criteria for NEET UG 2023 

  • Academic Details: Candidates must have completed their 10th and 12th examinations from a recognized board in the state of Maharashtra.
  • Residence Details: Candidates must have been born in the state of Maharashtra.
  • Other: Candidates must possess a valid domicile certificate of Maharashtra.

Eligibility Criteria in Uttarakhand NEET PG 2023 Counselling

To be eligible for Uttarakhand NEET PG 2023 Counselling and secure admission to MD/MS colleges in Uttarakhand, candidates must meet specific criteria.   • Only Indian citizens can apply for Uttarakhand PG medical courses under the state quota seat.
  • Candidates must have qualified for MBBS from an MCI-recognized institute located in Uttarakhand. However, this clause is not applicable to candidates applying for state quota seats.
  • Completing a Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship is mandatory for candidates.
  • Candidates must be registered with the Medical Council of India/State Medical Council.
  • Candidates pursuing a postgraduate degree or diploma course are not eligible to apply for Uttarakhand PG medical admission until they complete their current course.
  • Candidates from other states are only eligible for management quota seats.

  • The competent authority will release a merit list indicating the number of candidates eligible for each round, based on the applications received.
  • The registration fee for Round 1 or Round 2 is Rs. 5000/-, while the fee for the Mop-Up Round is Rs. 2000/-.
  • Candidates can make corrections to their application form by paying an additional fee of Rs. 500/-.

title: Tamil Nadu NEET PG Counselling 2024: Dates, Registration, Eligibility, Fees, Cutoff & Documents
content:
Tamil Nadu has established itself as a leader in the medical field in India, drawing a significant number of students. The state has always been a crucial hub for medical courses and qualifications, and it ranks highest in the country for the number of students enrolled. The state takes pride in its extensive network of renowned medical practitioners who specialize in various fields of medicine. The admission of Tamil Nadu NEET PG 2024 medical seats will be based on the NEET PG 2024 score.

Candidates who qualify for the counselling will be included in the merit list which will be published online by DME, Tamil Nadu. Subsequently, these candidates will be called for counselling, during which they will be allocated seats in their desired courses and colleges.

The Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling 2024 is an essential opportunity for aspiring medical professionals to pursue their desired courses in well-reputed institutions across the state. Through this counselling process, eligible candidates can pave the way towards fulfilling their career aspirations in the field of medicine.

TamilNadu NEET PG 2024 Counselling – Overview

The Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling process is a crucial step for aspiring medical professionals who wish to pursue their postgraduate studies in the state. The Directorate of Medical Education (DME) conducts this counselling to allocate seats in various MD, MS, and PG Diploma courses offered by renowned medical colleges in Tamil Nadu. The overview table provides a comprehensive glance at the key details regarding the Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling, including the counselling authority, exam name, courses offered, and the official website.

The Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling is a golden opportunity for candidates to secure admission in their desired MD/MS colleges in Tamil Nadu. AR Group of Education, a leading counselling service provider, assists students in navigating the intricacies of the counselling process, ensuring a seamless and successful admission journey. With their expertise and guidance, students can confidently embark on their path to becoming skilled medical professionals.

Apply Now

NEET PG 2021

Tamil Nadu PG Medical Admission counselling for NEET PG 2024 will be conducted by the Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Chennai. The counselling process will provide admission to MD, MS, and PG Diploma courses in professional medical colleges in Tamil Nadu.
The National Board of Education is the exam authority for NEET PG 2024, and the official website for Tamil Nadu PG Medical Admission counselling is tnmedicalselection.net. The counselling committee will be responsible for overseeing the admission process and releasing the merit list based on the NEET PG 2024 score.

Tamil Nadu NEET PG 2024 Counselling: Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for the Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling, candidates must meet specific criteria set forth by the authorities. The eligibility table outlines the essential requirements, such as being an Indian citizen, possessing an MBBS degree from Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R Medical University or obtaining an Eligibility Certificate, completion of compulsory rotatory residential internship, and qualifying the NEET PG 2024 examination with a score equal to or above the qualifying cutoff. Meeting these eligibility criteria is crucial for securing a coveted seat in the desired MD/MS colleges in Tamil Nadu.

  • The candidate must be an Indian citizen.
  • He/she should possess an MBBS degree from Tamil Nadu Dr M.G.R Medical University.
  • Candidates who have pursued their MBBS degree from any other university need to produce an Eligibility Certificate issued by Tamil Nadu Dr M.G.R Medical University during counselling.
  • The candidate must have completed the Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship.
  • He/she should have qualified for NEET PG 2024.
  • The candidate must have scored equal to or above the qualifying cutoff for NEET PG 2024.

AR Group of Education understands the significance of the Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling process and its impact on a student’s future. Their team of experienced counsellors provides personalized guidance, ensuring that candidates fulfill all the eligibility requirements and navigate the process smoothly. With their support, students can focus on their academic pursuits while AR Group takes care of the administrative complexities.

TamilNadu NEET PG 2024 Counselling Procedure

The Tamil Nadu NEET PG counselling procedure is a well-structured process that involves multiple steps. The table outlines the four crucial stages: registration, rank list or state merit list preparation, choice filling, and seat allotment and reporting. Each step plays a vital role in ensuring a fair and transparent admission process for candidates seeking admission to MD/MS colleges in Tamil Nadu. Adhering to the prescribed procedures and deadlines is essential for a successful counselling experience.

Step 1: Registration

  • Candidates need to register themselves on the official website of DME Chennai.
  • After completing the registration process, they will be redirected to the application form for Tamil Nadu NEET PG 2024 counselling.
  • Candidates are advised to fill the application form for Tamil Nadu PG medical counselling carefully.
  • He/she must then print a copy of the duly filled application form on an A4 size paper, sign in the space provided and attach all the necessary enclosures.
  • A copy of the filled application form, along with the enclosures must be sent to the Selection Committee.

Step 2: Rank list or state merit list

  • DME will release two types of Tamil Nadu PG medical merit lists for the 2024 session, one for government quota seats and another for management quota seats.
  • The Tamil Nadu PG 2024 medical rank list will mention the overall rank and community rank allotted to the applicant, NEET PG 2024 roll number, details of the candidate, and the total marks scored by the candidate.

Step 3: Choice Filling

  • All candidates will have to pay a processing fee of Rs 1,000 to submit their choices.
  • Eligible candidates have to submit their preference (course/college) online through choice filling.
  • They have to log in to their registered accounts and fill the choices before the deadline.
  • There will be two confirmation pop-ups before locking the choices.
  • After locking the choices, candidates must take a print out of the choices submitted by them.

Step 4: Seat Allotment & Reporting

  • The Selection Committee releases the seat allotment list, which is prepared on the basis of the choices filled by the candidates and their ranks in the State Merit List.
  • Selected candidates have to report to the allotted institute along with all their documents on the scheduled date and time.
  • Candidates can also opt for e-reporting this year.
  • If a candidate is unable to report to the institute in-person, he/she can send a confirmatory email to the respective institute along with the scanned copies of their documents

Why Study MBBS in Iran ?

  • Iran’s universities are globally recognized and accredited by organizations such as WHO, WDOMS, FAIMER, ECFMG.
  • Iran provides a safe and secure learning environment for its students, particularly in its top medical institutes.
  • Iran has a well-developed public healthcare system, resulting in cutting-edge hospitals and well-equipped medical schools.
  • The MBBS program in Iran lasts seven years, with the first five years focused on theoretical and technical instruction and the remaining two years on practical application through an internship.
  • Advanced technology is utilized in the classroom to provide sophisticated learning opportunities for students.
  • Iran offers a variety of career options for MBBS in iran for indian students based on their interests and preferences.
  • English is the primary language of instruction in most universities.

Admission Process

Enrolling in a top college in Iran for an MBBS program is a hassle-free experience unlike in other countries where the admission process can be extensive and overwhelming. So here is the list of eligibility admission processes and documents required.

Eligibility

  • Applicants must be at least 17 years old by December 31st of the year of admission.
  • A minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in 12th standard from CBSE/ICSE or any equivalent board is required.
  • Qualified NEET(UG) Entrance exam, as per the latest notification by MCI, is mandatory for eligibility to apply for MBBS in Iran.

Application Process

  • Fill out the application form with accurate personal and educational details.
  • Send scanned copies of academic documents and passports to the chosen university.
  • Wait for the university to evaluate the application and generate a report.
  • Pay the tuition fees upon acceptance.
  • Apply for a student visa to begin the immigration process.
  • Travel to Iran and start the journey towards becoming a doctor.

Documents

  1. Original 12th Marksheet
  2. Original Passport with proper scan copy of front and back
  3. NEET Score Card
  4. The digital photograph above the shoulder in white background (clear scan copy to be shared over email)
  5. 6 passport-size photographs

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Is MBBS from Iran valid in India?

Yes, MBBS from Iran is valid in India, provided you have studied from any MCI approved universities. The course structure for MBBS in Iran is similar to that of India. In order to practice in India, the students would be required to qualify for the screening test administered by NMC (MCI).

2. Is NEET required for MBBS in Iran?

Yes, as per the latest guidelines for eligibility, issued by the National Medical Council (NMC) formerly known as Medical Council of India (MCI), to study medicine or any other related field, the student must have qualified NEET(UG) Examination held every year.

3. Which country is the best for MBBS for Indian students?

Indian students have plenty of options when they choose to study MBBS Abroad. However, Iran, as an MBBS destination for Indian students, is an ideal choice for those who are looking for affordable, quality, and the most advanced education.

4. Is MBBS in Iran a good option?

Medical universities in Iran are famous for their reliability, security, and their global rankings across the world. These universities have the best medical education faculties for the training of the expertise among the students.

5. How much does it cost to study MBBS in Iran?

The actual expenditure of stay depends upon the preferences of the students. However, the average cost to study MBBS in Iran excluding the cost of living ranges from 6000 USD to 8000 USD per annum depending on the university and the course.

6. What is the duration of MBBS study in Iran?

The duration of the MBBS course in Iran is seven years. The first five years of the program are dedicated to theoretical and technical instruction, followed by a two-year internship focusing on practical application.

7. What are the documents required for applying to MBBS in Iran?

The documents required for applying to MBBS in Iran typically include academic transcripts, passport copy, NEET scorecard, birth certificate, and a medical fitness certificate.

8. Why do Indian students choose to study MBBS in Iran?

Indian students choose to study MBBS in Iran due to its affordable tuition fees, quality education, and advanced infrastructure. Additionally, the cultural similarities and a large Indian student community in Iran also make it an attractive option.

9. How many international students study MBBS in Iran?

As per the data records, at present, there are 40,000 students from different nationalities currently pursuing their studies in Iran.

If you want to pursue an MD (Doctor of Medicine) or MS (Master of Surgery) then you must qualify the NEET PG exam, MD/MS in Karnataka could be a good choice for graduates. Karnataka has various government and private colleges offering these specialized postgraduate degrees, including renowned institutions. Karnataka offers excellent medical education, advanced clinical training, and a wide range of specializations, making it a preferred hub for MD/MS in India. With several government and private institutions, MD/MS in Karnataka has become a popular choice among students looking for postgraduate medical studies.  

Pursuing higher education in medical science, such as MD (Doctor of Medicine) or MS (Master of Surgery), is a prestigious and challenging career path for aspiring doctors. Many reputed colleges offering MD/MS in Karnataka are located in Karnataka, and these MD/MS in Karnataka colleges provide quality education, advanced research opportunities, and excellent infrastructure to students aiming to specialize in different medical fields.

This comprehensive guide will cover everything about MD/MS in Karnataka—their admission process, eligibility criteria, top colleges, fee structure, specializations offered, and much more, making it a useful resource for anyone exploring MD/MS in India.

All About MD/MS in Karnataka

Pursuing an MD/MS in Karnataka is a dream for many aspiring medical professionals. The state is home to renowned medical institutions that offer various postgraduate medical programs. To secure a seat in these coveted programs, it is essential to meet the eligibility criteria and achieve a qualifying score in the NEET PG examination. The counseling process in Karnataka is conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA), which ensures a fair and transparent admission procedure.

Peruse through the sections explained below to know about the admission process of MD/MS in Karnataka, fees structure, top medical colleges and much more.

Understand Why Karnataka is a Good Choice?

Karnataka has become a top destination for medical students due to several key reasons:

  • Affordability: Compared to other states, many MD Colleges in Karnataka provide quality education at relatively lower tuition fees.
  • Excellent Faculty: The medical institutions in Karnataka employ highly experienced and qualified faculty members who provide in-depth knowledge and clinical skills to students. 
  • Infrastructure and Facilities: The top MD Colleges in Karnataka have modern infrastructure, cutting-edge laboratories, and well-furnished hostels to facilitate a conducive learning environment.
  • Research Opportunities: MD/MS programs in Karnataka also offer excellent research opportunities, enabling students to delve deeper into their areas of specialization.

Learn Admission Process for MD/MS Colleges in Karnataka

To gain admission to the MD Colleges in Karnataka, candidates must go through a competitive process. The most important step is to qualify for the NEET PG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduates), which is the entrance examination conducted for admission to MD/MS courses across India. Here is an overview of the admission process:

Step 1: NEET PG Exam

  • Eligibility: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution and have completed a one-year internship before applying.
  • Exam Pattern: NEET PG consists of 300 multiple-choice questions based on the MBBS curriculum.
  • Cut-off: Candidates need to score above the cut-off marks to be eligible for counselling.

Step 2: Counseling Process

Once candidates have cleared the NEET PG exam, they must participate in the Karnataka NEET PG counselling process, which is conducted by the Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, Karnataka. The counselling process includes:

  1. Registration: Candidates need to register for the counselling process online.
  2. Choice Filling: Candidates select their preferred MD/MS specialisations and colleges.
  3. Seat Allotment: Based on their rank and preferences, seats are allotted to candidates.
  4. Document Verification: Candidates need to submit the necessary documents for verification.
  5. Admission Confirmation: After document verification, candidates can secure their admission by paying the required fees.

Eligibility Criteria for MD/MS Colleges in Karnataka

If you are also interested in getting admission to MD/MS in Karnataka, then it is advised that you thoroughly go through the eligibility criteria of different medical institutes available in India.

Refer to the following section to know the eligibility criteria required to be satisfied in order to get admission to MD/MS in Karnataka.

  1. The candidate should possess an MBBS completion degree with an aggregate score of  50%.
  2. The degree should be recognized by the National Medical Commission(NMC) of India.
  3. The interested student should have successfully completed his or her one year of medical internship.
  4. The candidate should hold a permanent certificate of registration that is issued by the National Medical Commission(NMC) or State Medical Council.
  5. All those interested students who have completed MBBS degrees foreign medical institutes should clear the Foreign Medical Graduates Examination (FMGE) Screening test and should also have a permanent certificate to apply for the NEET-PG entrance examination.

Documents Required for Karnataka NEET PG Counseling

Following are the documents that are required to be furnished during the admission process of MD/MS in Karnataka.

  • NEET PG admit card
  • Allotment submission form
  • Secondary school certificate for date of birth proof
  • Application form copy
  • NEET PG 2025 result
  • Compulsory rotatory internship certificate
  • MBBS pass certificate form a recognized institute of MCI
  • Original copy of photo ID proof (Voter ID/PAN card/Driving License) for biometric verification
  • A set of photocopy of all the above-mentioned documents

  • MS Obstetrics & Gynecology (OBG)

  • MD Psychiatry

Karnataka has over 5,000 MD/MS seats across government, private, and deemed universities, making it one of India’s largest PG medical hubs.

These colleges provide quality education, advanced research opportunities, and excellent infrastructure to students aiming to specialize in medical fields.

This comprehensive guide will cover everything about MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh—their admission process, eligibility criteria, top colleges, fee structure, specializations offered, and much more. 

If you’re considering pursuing postgraduate medical studies in Uttar Pradesh, this guide will provide valuable insights to help you make an informed decision.

Why Choose MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh?

Uttar Pradesh (UP) has become a prime destination for medical students due to several key reasons:

  • Top-tier Medical Institutions: The state boasts several government and private medical colleges offering world-class education in MD/MS courses.
  • Affordability: Compared to other states, many MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh provide quality education at relatively lower tuition fees.
  • Excellent Faculty: The medical institutions in UP employ highly experienced and qualified faculty members who provide in-depth knowledge and clinical skills to students. 
  • Infrastructure and Facilities: The top MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh have modern infrastructure, cutting-edge laboratories, and well-furnished hostels to facilitate a conducive learning environment.
  • Research Opportunities: MD/MS programs in Uttar Pradesh also offer excellent research opportunities, enabling students to delve deeper into their areas of specialization.

Admission Process for MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

To gain admission to the MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh, candidates must go through a competitive process. The most important step is to qualify for the NEET PG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduates), which is the entrance examination conducted for admission to MD/MS courses across India. Here is an overview of the admission process:

Step 1: NEET PG Exam

  • Eligibility: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution and have completed a one-year internship before applying.
  • Exam Pattern: NEET PG consists of 300 multiple-choice questions based on the MBBS curriculum.
  • Cut-off: Candidates need to score above the cut-off marks to be eligible for counseling.

Step 2: Counseling Process

Once candidates have cleared the NEET PG exam, they must participate in the UP NEET PG counseling process, which is conducted by the Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh. The counseling process includes:

  1. Registration: Candidates need to register for the counseling process online.
  2. Choice Filling: Candidates select their preferred MD/MS specializations and colleges.
  3. Seat Allotment: Based on their rank and preferences, seats are allotted to candidates.
  4. Document Verification: Candidates need to submit the necessary documents for verification.
  5. Admission Confirmation: After document verification, candidates can secure their admission by paying the required fees.

Eligibility Criteria for MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

To secure admission into the MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh, candidates must meet the following eligibility criteria:

  • MBBS Degree: The candidate should have completed their MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI).
  • Internship: A one-year compulsory rotating internship must be completed before applying for NEET PG.
  • NEET PG Qualification: Candidates must qualify for the NEET PG exam with a valid score.
  • Domicile Requirements: For state quota seats in Uttar Pradesh, candidates must meet the domicile requirements of the state.

Fee Structure of MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

The tuition fees for MD/MS programs vary depending on whether the college is a government or private institution. Below is a general breakdown of the fee structure in MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh:

Government MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

  • Fees Range: ₹50,000 – ₹2,00,000 per annum
  • Additional Charges: Hostel fees, mess charges, and other miscellaneous expenses may apply. 

Private MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

  • Fees Range: ₹8,00,000 – ₹25,00,000 per annum
  • Additional Charges: Private medical colleges often have higher fees, along with additional charges for hostels and other facilities.

Scholarships and Financial Aid in MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh

Many MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh offer scholarships to meritorious students and those from economically weaker sections. Some common scholarships available include:

  • State Government Scholarships: Various state government schemes provide financial assistance to students from reserved categories or low-income families.
  • Institutional Scholarships: Colleges may offer merit-based scholarships to top-performing students.
  • National Scholarships: Programs such as the National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of SC/ST students are available for postgraduate medical students.

Career Opportunities After MD/MS in Uttar Pradesh

Completing an MD or MS degree from one of the MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh opens up numerous career opportunities. Postgraduates can pursue the following career paths: 

  • Specialist Doctor: MD/MS graduates can work as specialists in hospitals, clinics, and medical institutes in their chosen field.
  • Medical Researcher: Students interested in research can pursue careers in medical research organizations or pharmaceutical companies.
  • Academic Role: MD/MS graduates can work as professors or lecturers in medical colleges, training the next generation of doctors.
  • Private Practice: Many postgraduates opt to establish their own private practice or work in specialty clinics.
  • Super-specialization: Graduates can further specialize by pursuing super-specialty courses such as DM or MCh.

Conclusion

In summary, MD Colleges in Uttar Pradesh provide excellent educational opportunities for medical graduates looking to specialize in various fields of medicine and surgery. The state boasts a wide range of government and private institutions with cutting-edge facilities, experienced faculty, and affordable fee structures. 

From general medicine to super-specialty courses, students can find the right program to suit their career aspirations. The structured admission process, driven by NEET PG, ensures that only the most qualified candidates are selected for these prestigious programs.

Whether you’re looking for top-tier government institutions like KGMU or private colleges like Subharti Medical College, pursuing an MD/MS in Uttar Pradesh offers a promising future with diverse career opportunities. Visit us for more information @ argroupofeducation.

title: NEET UG Counselling
content:
If you are an aspiring medical student in India, then NEET UG Counselling 2025 is one of the most important steps after qualifying the NEET UG exam. Which is organised by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) for All India Quota and by respective state authorities for State quota. Counselling is a matter of process to secure a seat in MBBS or BDS. 

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has been designated as the authority to manage the counselling process for NEET UG 2025, which is the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) for undergraduate medical courses. The dates for the NEET counselling in 2025 will be updated on this platform once announced.

 The MCC’s NEET counselling for 2025 will be conducted for 15% of All India Quota (AIQ) seats in government colleges, as well as 100% of seats in deemed/central universities, ESIC/AFMS, AIIMS, JIPMER, and BSc Nursing programs, based on the NEET 2025 exam scores. The NEET AIQ counselling process for 2025 will be divided into four rounds: round 1, round 2, mop-up, and stray vacancy.

NEET UG counselling 2025: Overview

Here are some important details regarding the factors involved in medical admissions in India:

  • Admissions to medical courses through the All India Quota (AIQ) are conducted by the Directorate General of Health Sciences (DGHS) for the National Medical Council, while admissions through the State Quota are managed by respective state authorities.
  • The counselling website for AIQ is MCC.nic.in, and the details for State Quota are given in the table below.
  • The seat intake for AIQ includes 15% of government seats, 100% of Deemed and Central University seats, ESIC, AFMC, AIIMS, and JIPMER seats. For State Quota, it includes 85% of government seats and 100% of private seats in the state.

Be familiar with the NEET 2025 counselling scheme for 15 % AIQ

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is responsible for conducting four rounds of counselling for MBBS admissions in India, namely AIQ Round 1, AIQ Round 2, AIQ Mop-up round, and stray vacancy round. Eligibility for these rounds is based on NEET 2023 results, except for candidates from the Union Territory of J&K. Any vacant seats after AIQ Round 2 will be returned to the respective states.

The AIQ for NEET counselling in 2025 will include the following:

The following categories of medical seats fall under the All India Quota:

  • 15% of MBBS/BDS seats of states
  • 100% of MBBS/BDS seats of Banaras Hindu University (BHU)
  • 100% of MBBS seats of All India Institutes of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) across India
  • All India Quota seats of Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) in Puducherry/Karaikal

ESIC:

  • 15% of seats for Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) will be allotted through AIQ in Round 1 and Round 2 of counselling.
  • The remaining 85% of seats will be treated as state quota seats and will be available in the Mop-Up Round for all candidates.

Central University/Institute:

  • Four rounds of NEET 2025 counselling – Round 1, Round 2, Mop-Up Round, and Stray Vacancy Round – will be conducted for central university/institute seats.
  • Three rounds of counselling will be conducted online by MCC – Round 1, Round 2, and Mop-Up Round.
  • The Stray Vacancy round for central university/institute seats will be conducted by the respective institutions.

About NEET UG Counselling 2025

The MCC conducts NEET 2025 counselling to determine admissions to MBBS/BDS courses in AIQ, deemed universities, and ESIC/AFMS colleges in India based on NEET 2025 results. There are two types of NTA NEET counselling: All India and State counselling. The AIQ NEET 2025 counselling process is the only method for admission to 15% of seats in all government medical and dental colleges, deemed universities, central universities, and ESIC/AFMC including DU, BHU, AMU, and AIIMS & JIPMER. 

State NEET counselling 2025 is for admissions to 85% of seats in government colleges and all seats in private unaided/aided minority/non-minority medical/dental colleges in the state. Jammu & Kashmir candidates have also been included in the 15% All India Quota seats counselling process.

NEET UG Counselling 2025: Eligibility Criteria

  • NEET-qualified candidates are eligible to apply for NEET 2025 counselling, which includes All India and State Quota seats.
  • Jammu and Kashmir’s candidates are now included in the All India Quota seats counselling process. To participate in the counselling process, candidates must register on the MCC website.
  • Deemed Universities’ AIQ counselling is open to all NEET-qualified candidates. This process, along with State Quota counselling, will determine admissions to government, private unaided/aided minority/non-minority medical/dental colleges in the state.

Central university eligibility criteria for the NEET UG Counselling 2025

  • Delhi University (LHMC, UCMS, MAMC): 15% of seats are reserved for the All India quota, while the remaining 85% are reserved for candidates who completed their 10+2 education in Delhi.
  • Aligarh Muslim University (AMU): 50% of seats are reserved for institutional candidates who have been studying at AMU schools for the past three years. The other 50% of seats are open to candidates from across India.
  • BHU: All Indian candidates can apply for admission to BHU.
  • Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, Delhi: Out of a total of 50 seats, 3 seats are reserved for the internal quota of JMI, and the remaining 47 seats are open to All India quota candidates. Students who completed their 10+2 education from Jamia Schools can also apply for admission through the internal quota.
  • VMMC & SJH: 15% of seats are reserved for All India candidates, and the rest are reserved for candidates who completed their 10+2 education in Delhi.

NEET UG Counselling Process Step by Step

Step 1: NEET UG counselling fees and registration

To begin the NEET UG counselling process, candidates who meet the eligibility criteria must first register at mcc.nic.in. During registration, they will need to provide their NEET roll number, registration number, name, mother’s name, and date of birth. After filling out the necessary information, they must pay the counselling fee and security fee using a credit card or debit card. The amount of the counselling fee and security fee varies based on the candidate’s institution type and category. For those in the 15% All India Quota/Central Universities, the neet ug counselling fees is Rs. 1,000 for UR category candidates and Rs. 500 for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates. The security fee for these candidates is Rs. 10,000 and Rs. 5,000, respectively. For Deemed Universities, the counselling fee for all categories is Rs. 5000, and the security fee is Rs. 2,00,000.

Step 2: Filling in choice for NEET counselling 2025

As a part of the NEET counselling process, candidates are required to create a list of their preferred colleges by filling out a “dummy sheet.” They can choose their dream college choices and use the NEET college predictor tool to understand their likelihood of getting accepted based on past data. Once the candidates complete this step and move on to the NEET counselling process in 2025, they will have the opportunity to select from the list of choices they have created in their dummy sheet.

Step 3: NEET 2025 seat allotment

After the NEET counselling process, candidates should log in to the official website and download their seat allotment letters promptly when they are released. During the first round, candidates have the option to exit for free, but in the second round, they will have to forfeit a fee to withdraw their seat allotment.

Step 4: Reporting to the allotted college

After a candidate receives an allotment of seats, they are required to report to the designated college to complete the admissions process. It is not mandatory for candidates to report or join during the first round, but those who wish to take a seat or upgrade must do so. In the second round, candidates who have been allocated a seat must report and join, unless they choose to forfeit their security deposit by opting out. When reporting to the assigned college, candidates must bring original copies of specified documents.

Candidates are required to bring the following documents when reporting to the assigned college after receiving a seat allotment:

  • NEET 2025  Admit Card
  • NEET Scorecard or Rank Letter
  • Class 10 certificate and mark sheet (as proof of date of birth)
  • Class 12 certificate and mark sheet
  • ID proof (such as Aadhar/PAN Card/Driving License/Passport)
  • Eight passport size photographs
  • Provisional Allotment Letter
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)

NRI/ OCI candidates appearing for deemed universities must submit the following documents

For candidates who have been sponsored, the following documents may be required:

  • Passport copy of sponsor
  • Embassy certificate
  • Sponsorship affidavit confirming that the sponsor is ready to bear the expenses for the entire duration of study
  • Relationship affidavit stating the candidate’s relationship with the sponsor

NEET UG Counselling 2025 – what is the free exit? What is the exit with forfeiture?

The NEET counselling process offers two types of exit options for candidates.

  • Free exit (only for round 1): Candidates who are assigned a seat in round 1 but do not join or report to the college they are assigned to will not be penalized. The security deposit will not be forfeited, and candidates will still be eligible for further rounds.
  • Exit with forfeiture: If a candidate is offered a seat in round 2 but does not wish to take the seat, they can exit with forfeiture. This means they will lose the security deposit they have paid within the given period.
  • It’s important to note that candidates who join the allotted seat in the second round will not be eligible to surrender their seats and will not be permitted to participate in state counselling.

Step 1: Candidates who wish to participate in the mop-up round must register again. This step is not required for candidates who resigned from the earlier rounds.

Step 2: Fill in and lock your preferred choices for colleges in the mop-up round.

Step 3: The mop-up round seat allocation for NEET 2025 counselling will take place.

Step 4: The results of the mop-up round will be published.

Step 5: Candidates must report to their preferred medical/dental college to complete the admission process.

Step 6: The deemed/central universities will provide a list of ten times the registered candidates’ number for stray vacancies, in order of merit, to be exhausted.

Step 7: The final stray vacancy round will be conducted by the deemed/central universities. There will be no fresh registration of candidates in this round.

NEET UG 2025 – State Quota Counselling

State authorities are responsible for filling 85% of the remaining seats in government medical colleges, while 100% of seats in state-sponsored medical colleges will be filled by them. The NEET counselling process may differ from state to state, and the rules set by each state’s NEET counselling authority will determine the admission process for MBBS in government colleges and admission to private medical colleges.

title: NEET PG Counselling
content:
The NEET PG counselling 2025 is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) for admission to MD/MS courses under 50% All India Quota seats. The remaining 50% of seats will be filled by the admission committees appointed by the respective state governments. To be eligible for the counselling process, candidates must secure the minimum cutoff scores required for All India Quota seats and register for the counselling. The NEET PG counselling for 2025 will be conducted online starting from May 2025 for admissions to both All India and State quotas. 

The National Board of Examinations (NBE) is responsible for conducting the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET-PG) exam. This exam is a requirement for admission to Doctor of Medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS), and PG Diploma programs in 6,102 government, private, and deemed/central universities, with a total of 26,168 MD seats, 13,649 MS seats, and 922 PG Diploma seats available. The NBE has announced that the NEET PG 2025  exam will take place on August 3, 2025, and the NEET PG 2025 application form was released on April 17, 2025.

To stay informed about the latest updates, important dates, cutoff scores, and seat matrix, candidates are encouraged to check out the MCC NEET PG 2025 counselling process. This will provide all the necessary information about the selection process, eligibility criteria, and other important details.

With the help of this information, candidates can make an informed decision about their future and choose the best course of action for their career goals. So if you’re planning to participate in the NEET PG counselling 2025 , be sure to stay up-to-date with the latest developments and take advantage of all the resources available to you.

NEET UG counselling 2025: Overview

Here are some important details regarding the factors involved in medical admissions in India:

  • Admissions to medical courses through the All India Quota (AIQ) are conducted by the Directorate General of Health Sciences (DGHS) for the National Medical Council, while admissions through the State Quota are managed by respective state authorities.
  • The counselling website for AIQ is MCC.nic.in, and the details for State Quota are given in the table below.
  • The seat intake for AIQ includes 15% of government seats, 100% of Deemed and Central University seats, ESIC, AFMC, AIIMS, and JIPMER seats. For State Quota, it includes 85% of government seats and 100% of private seats in the state.
  • The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is responsible for conducting four rounds of counselling for MBBS admissions in India, namely AIQ Round 1, AIQ Round 2, AIQ Mop-up round, and stray vacancy round. Eligibility for these rounds is based on NEET 2023 results, except for candidates from the Union Territory of J&K. Any vacant seats after AIQ Round 2 will be returned to the respective states.
