NEET PG counselling for the year 2025 will be conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on behalf of the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The counselling will be held for admission to 50% of seats under All India Quota (AIQ) and 100% of seats in deemed and central universities and ESIC institutes.

The registration for the round-wise NEET PG counselling for all the aforementioned institutes will be done through a single window.

For the 50% AIQ seats in government institutes, four rounds of NEET PG counselling 2025 will be conducted. After the second round of counselling, MCC will conduct an additional mop-up round for the 100% seats in deemed and central universities.

Types of NEET PG 2025 counselling

Counselling for NEET PG is conducted by two different authorities, each responsible for different sets of participating institutes. The first counselling session is the MCC NEET PG counselling, which is conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services Medical Counselling Committee. This counselling session is responsible for 50% of the All India Quota (AIQ) seats in government institutions, central universities, deemed universities, ESIC and AFMS institutes.

The second counselling session is the state quota NEET PG counselling, which is conducted by the respective state government or its authorized body. This session is responsible for 50% of the state quota seats in government colleges, as well as 100% of the seats in private medical, minority institutes, and universities established by an act of state, municipal bodies trust, society or company located in the state.

NEET PG Counselling 2025

Step 1: Registration for NEET PG counselling

To register for NEET PG counselling 2025, go to the official website of the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) at MCC.nic.in and click on the “New Registration” link. You will need to provide your stream, roll number, testing ID, name, date of birth, and security pin in the registration form.In the next window, you will be required to submit your parent’s name, address, pin code, email ID, mobile number, a security question and answer, and create a password. Once you have entered all the required information, verify the details and click on the “Submit” button.
After submitting the form, a registration slip will be generated which will contain your login and registration details. Keep this slip safe as you will need it to access your account for further counselling-related activities.

Step 2: Log in for NEET PG 2025 counselling

After successfully registering for NEET PG counselling 2025, candidates can log in to their account using their testing ID or confirmation number as the login ID and the chosen password. Once logged in, candidates will be required to pay the counselling registration fee based on their category, as shown in the table below:

Category Registration Fee

  • AIQ/Central University UR candidates ₹1000
  • SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates ₹500
  • Deemed University candidates ₹5000

Category Security Deposit Fee

In addition to the registration fee, candidates must also pay a security deposit fee, which will be refunded if the candidate is not allotted a seat during the counselling process. The amount of the security deposit fee varies based on the candidate’s category and the type of institute they are applying to, as shown in the table below:

  • AIQ/Central University UR candidates ₹25,000
  • SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates ₹10,000
  • Deemed University candidates ₹2,00,000

Step 3: NEET PG filling and submission of choices

Once candidates log in to their account, they should click on the “Available Choices” link to view the list of available options based on their credentials, such as gender and category.
To fill and submit their choices, candidates should follow these steps:

  • Click on the “Choice Filling” icon on the left side of the screen.
  • Click on the “Adding” icon to add the available choices to the right side of the screen.
  • Click on the “Save and Continue” button to save the selected choices.
  • Use the upper and lower arrows to adjust the order of the selected choices or the delete button to remove any options. Swapping preferences is also an option.
  • If a candidate wishes to delete multiple choices at once, they can select the choices and click on the “Uncheck All” option to confirm the deletion.
  • Finally, click on the “Save and Go to Home” option.

Step 4: NEET PG 2025 mock counselling

The MCC conducts an online NEET PG mock counselling to provide students with a better understanding of how the actual counselling process works. During the mock counselling, seats are allotted based on the applicant’s choices and All India Rank. Aspirants are also given the opportunity to modify their choices after the mock counselling process to better align their preferences with their goals.

Step 5: Choice locking of NEET PG 2025 counselling

After selecting their preferred choices, aspirants can lock them by clicking on “Choice Lock.” Once choices are locked, they cannot be modified.
To lock their choices, aspirants should follow these steps:

  • Click on “Choice Lock” to confirm their selected options, including seat preferences.
  • Next, click on “Lock Counselling” and enter their password to secure the lock.
  • Finally, aspirants should take a printout of their filled choices for future reference.

Step 6: NEET PG counselling 2025 seat allotment

The MCC will release the NEET PG counselling result for each registered candidate, which will include their admission status and seat allotment. Candidates can check their seat allotment status by logging into their accounts.

Step 7: Reporting at allotted colleges

Once the seat allotment is completed, aspirants must download the allotment letter from the website. The letter will contain information about the allotted institute, relevant documents, and fees that need to be submitted. It is important for candidates to report to the institute on the specified date as mentioned in the allotment letter. Failure to report on time will result in disqualification. That’s all there is to it!

Documents to be carried at the time of reporting to the allotted colleges:

  • NEET PG 2025 admit card
  • NEET PG result scorecard
  • Mark sheet of MBBS/BDS 1, 2, and 3 professional examinations
  • MBBS/BDS degree certificate or provisional certificate
  • Institute completion certificate or certificate from the head of the institution stating the completion of the internship by June 30, 2025
  • MCI or SMC issued permanent/provisional registration certificate (applicable to candidates who will complete their internship on or before June 30, 2025)
  • High school or higher secondary certificate/birth certificate as proof of birth date
  • Identification proofs such as PAN card, driving license, voter ID, Passport, or Aadhaar card for admission to the allotted college’s

Candidates belonging to respective categories must also carry the following certificates:

  • SC/ST certificate with the sub-caste mentioned in English or Hindi issued by the competent authority
  • OBC certificate issued by the competent authority, and the sub-caste must be related to the central list of OBC
  • Orthopedic Physically Handicapped (OPH) certificate issued from constituted or authorized medical boards
  • No other OPH certificate issued by any other authority will be entertained.

NEET PG 2025 Cutoff

NEET PG counselling 2025 Round 2

Candidates who were not allotted seats in Round 1 of NEET PG counselling can participate in Round 2 by filling in fresh seat preferences. There is no need to register again to participate in Round 2. The seat allotment process in Round 2 will be based on aspirants’ choices and merit. It is important for candidates to select their college preferences and courses to be eligible for the second round.

Who is eligible for round 2 counselling

To be eligible for Round 2 of NEET PG 2025 counselling, a candidate must be in one of the following groups:

  • Group I: Registered candidates who were not allotted any seat in Round 1
  • Group II: Candidates whose seat was cancelled during document verification or due to a change in category
  • Group III: Aspirants who have joined a college in Round 1 but want to upgrade their seat in Round 2.

Who is not eligible for round 2 counselling

The following candidates are not eligible for Round 2 of NEET PG 2025 counselling:

  • Aspirants who were allotted a seat in Round 1 but did not report to the allotted institute
  • Candidates who reported to the allotted institute in Round 1 but later withdrew their seat
  • Applicants who became ineligible for admission due to a change in their category
  • Students who did not opt for up-gradation of seats in Round 1

NEET PG 2025 Counselling: Mop up round

The mop-up round will allocate seats in deemed, central universities, and ESIC institutes. Candidates who did not report to the college allotted to them in rounds one and two will have to register for the NEET PG mop-up counselling 2025. Those who did not receive a seat in either round one or two of NEET PG counselling 2025 are not required to register again for the mop-up round. In this round, all candidates must submit fresh choices of colleges/courses for the seat allotment process. The results of the seat allotment for the mop-up round will be published on the official website.

NEET PG counselling for state quota seats

For the 50% state quota seats, the NEET PG 2025 counselling will be conducted by the respective state admission committees. Each state will publish its own counseling schedule for admission to NEET PG medical courses. The state admission committees will use the NEET PG results to prepare state merit ranks for admission to all medical institutions established by local bodies and state governments.

NEET PG counselling 2025 for AFMS institutes

The NEET PG 2025 counselling for admission to approximately 295 PG medical seats in eight Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS) institutes will be conducted by the MCC. Aspirants who are interested in MD/MS/PG Diploma seats in AFMS institutes must indicate their preference by selecting the ‘Yes/No’ option in the NEET PG application form. After the result is announced, aspirants whose AFMS application form has been accepted will be called for the counselling process for MD/MS Admission in India.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Who conducts counseling?

MCC: For 50% All India Quota (AIQ) seats in govt colleges & 100% seats in Deemed Universities.

Your State Authority: For the other 50% State Quota seats in govt colleges & 100% seats in private colleges in that state.

You must register for both separately.

What are the rounds?

Round 1 & 2: Main allotment rounds.

Mop-Up Round: For leftover seats. Key Rule: If you join a seat from Round 1 or 2, you are NOT eligible for the Mop-Up round.

Stray Vacancy Round: The final round to fill the last few seats.

What is "Choice Filling & Locking"?

You must create and lock a list of your preferred colleges in order.

Your rank + locked choices = your allotment. Locking is mandatory.

I got a seat in Round 1. What now?

  • Accept & Freeze: Keep the seat. Exit counseling.

    Resign & Upgrade: Give up the seat to try for a better one in Round 2. Risk: You might not get any seat in Round 2.

What are the crucial documents?
  • NEET PG Admit Card & Scorecard
  • MBBS Degree & Internship Completion Certificate
  • Medical Registration Certificate
  • ID Proof & Caste Certificate (if applicable)

title: Urgench branch of Tashkent Medical Academy Uzbekistan 2026-27 | Courses, Fees, Admission
content:
The president of the Republic of Uzbekistan established the Urgench Branch of  Tashkent Medical Academy on July 19, 2005. Faculty such as General Medicine, Pedagogy, and Nursing was initially established at the academy, with a total capacity of 4662 students. The institute educates around 765 postgraduates and 205 physicians. Tashkent Medical Academy’s MBBS program is based on the production of highly trained professionals on 58 chairs through the acquisition of clinical skills. Under a grant on the environment and human health, the institute implemented the “On coordination and monitoring of research works.” There are seven separate scientific councils within the institute.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

Affiliation and Recognition of Tashkent Medical Academy

Tashkent Medical Academy have formed partnerships with several foreign departments of education and research organizations to build partnerships between prominent higher education institutions in NIS nations and outside. The University is recognized by WHO, MCI, and UNESCO.

  • Recognized by NMC (National Medical Commission )
  • NMC and WHO approved
  • Seoul University
  • Humboldt University (Berlin)
  • Russian State Medical University
  • Samara State Medical University
  • Moscow State Medical University
  • Family Medicine Residency center
  • Chkhonnam State University (Korea)

Why Study MBBS at Urgench branch of Tashkent Medical Academy

  • For those interested in pursuing MBBS at Tashkent Medical Academy, no special degree is required; the NEET scorecard would sufficient.
  • The medical academy in Tashkent is a ragging-free zone.
  • Tashkent Medical Academy offers an internationally recognized MBBS degree.
  • Tashkent Medical Academy has easy access to transportation.
  • The institution provides financial assistance to students through scholarship programs.
  • Students at the Tashkent Medical Academy can stay in a hostel.
  • First Tashkent State Medical Institute has a high level of security.

Advantages of MBBS at Urgench branch of  Tashkent Medical Academy

  • The institute provides world-class education at a reasonable cost.
  • The institute takes into account regional characteristics such as religious freedom and legal defense, both of which are vital for Asian and Latin American countries.
  • Training centers and clinical bases provide world-class instruction to young minds with well-equipped classrooms, fundamental scientific and clinical laboratories, and clinical bases.
  • Students benefit from the university’s collaboration with international scientific and educational centers, which offer them information and exposure.
  • The university’s seasoned team is continually striving to apply cutting-edge teaching methods.

Duration Of MBBS In Tashkent Medical Academy

The Tashkent Medical Academy’s MBBS program lasts five years: The Tashkent Medical Academy’s MBBS program lasts five years and includes an internship. To obtain an MBBS degree, the course must be completed in five years.

Faculties of Tashkent Medical Academy

  • Faculty of Medicine
  • Faculty of Dentistry
  • Faculty of Pharmacy
  • Faculty of neuroscience
  • Faculty of pediatrics
  • Faculty of surgery
  • Faculty of postgraduate programs

Tashkent Medical Academy ranking

Tashkent Medical Academy ranking in Uzbekistan is

7

Tashkent Medical Academy world ranking is

5882

Eligibility To Study MBBS In Tashkent Medical Academy

  • The applicant must have a cumulative score of 55 percent for open caste students and 45 percent for reserved caste students in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
  • A person’s age should not be less than 17 years old and not more than 25 years old.
  • Applicants must have completed 12th grade or an equivalent diploma from a recognized institution.
  • Enrollment in Tashkent Medical Academy’s MBBS programs requires NEET clearance.

Tashkent Medical Academy Admission Process

Tashkent Medical Academy’s management gives the following information for admission to the MBBS program at Tashkent Medical Academy:

  • Step 1: Fill out the application form on the Tashkent Medical Academy’s website.
  • Step 2: Address the application to the Tashkent Medical Academy’s rector, noting the language and type of training.
  • Step 3: The applicant must present notarized copies of documents that have been translated into Russian or Uzbek.

Document Required For Tashkent Medical Academy Admission

  • Copy of Passport
  • Mark sheets copy
  • Certified copy of your birth certificate
  • Medical certification
  • Receipt of Funds
  • Admissions statement (invitation letter)
  • Photographs (Passport size)

Syllabus of MBBS in Tashkent Medical Academy

Semester

Subjects

1 semester

Medical Chemistry, Fundamentals of Psychology, Histology, Bioorganic Chemistry

2nd semester

Cytology, Embryology, Human Anatomy, Elective Courses

3rd semester

Histology, Physiology, Human Anatomy, Biochemistry, Microbiology

4th-semester

Microbiology, Emergency Medicine, Patient Care, Embryology

5th-semester

Pharmacology, Pathomorphology, Pediatrics, Internal Medicine, General Surgery

6th semester

Ecology, Radiology, Elective Courses, Biostatistics

7th, and 8th-semester

Tuberculosis, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Urology, Neurology, Ophthalmology, Narcology, Medical Psychology, Forensic Medicine, Social Medicine

9th and 10th-semester

Infectious Diseases, Oncology, Epidemiology, Gynecology, Traumatology, Medical Genetics, Social Medicine, Obstetrics, Clinical Immunology

11th and 12th Semester

Elective Courses

Hostel And Accommodation At Tashkent Medical Academy

Foreign students can stay at First Tashkent State Medical Institute with the following amenities. There are 5 student dormitories with a total capacity of 1700 students at the institute. Tashkent Medical Academy’s hostels are managed by the TMA administration and the Directorate of the Dormitory following the academy’s regulations. A turnstile is erected at the hostel’s entrance to prohibit strangers from entering the hostel and to safeguard the safety of the students. Student dorms are assigned, to individual district guards. Each hostel offers a common area with a modern TV and furniture, as well as a kitchen, computer rooms, and a library.

Living Cost at Tashkent Medical Academy

The cost of living in Uzbekistan is comparatively low. For accommodation, it will cost around 100 to 200 USD. For food expenses, it will cost around 100 to 150 USD. Transportation costs will be around 10 to 50 USD.

Why MBBS in Uzbekistan?

There are a few key characteristics that are also Reasons to Study MBBS in Uzbekistan:

  • Many government-funded universities exist in Uzbekistan, and the NMC recognizes some of them.
  • To gain admission to a good medical university in Uzbekistan, students are not required to take any language competency examinations.
  • The medium of teaching in Uzbekistan’s medical universities is English, which makes it easier for Indian students to study there.
  • Students from India gain international experience, and it should be highlighted that Uzbekistan is a safe place for Indian students.

Benefits of Study MBBS in Uzbekistan

  • The cost of learning MBBS in Uzbekistan is one of the key benefits. Compared to some of India’s private medical institutes, you’ll find that the cost of schooling is lower.
  • Many medical universities in Uzbekistan are accredited by NMC and international organizations such as the World Health Organization.
  • In Uzbekistan’s medical universities, English is the medium of instruction. As a result, Indian students will have no difficulty enrolling in Uzbekistan’s medical universities.
  • The level of medical education in Uzbekistan is excellent, and the country’s universities have excellent infrastructure.

title: Samarkand State Medical University
content:
Established in 1930, Samarkand State Medical University (SSMU) is located in the third largest and historic city of Uzbekistan. Considered one of the best universities  in the country, SSMU is a government institution that operates under the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of Uzbekistan. Over the years, it has built a strong identity for itself due to academic excellence, modern facilities and highly qualified faculty. Currently, more than 10,000 students are enrolled for MBBS programs here, including many international students. The university’s commitment to training skilled healthcare professionals has made it a top choice for those wishing to pursue MBBS in Uzbekistan as well as MBBS Abroad. 

SSMU offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs in several medical fields, of which the MBBS program is very popular among students from India, China, Bangladesh, Egypt and other countries. The total cost for MBBS in Uzbekistan fees in Samarkand State Medical University in 2025 is around Rs 20 lakh, for 6 years which is considered an affordable option for Indian students. 

Ranked among the top three medical universities in Uzbekistan, SSMU has more than 650 faculty members and a student community of over 11,000, including 1,000+ Indians currently studying MBBS. With its focus on scientific research, innovation, and international standards, the university continues to be a leading destination for MBBS in Uzbekistan. For students aiming for an affordable and high-quality medical education, Samarkand State Medical University stands out as one of the best choices for MBBS Abroad.

About Samarkand City

The city of Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia. The city is a blend of ancient culture with modern facilities. For students wishing to pursue MBBS in Uzbekistan, Samarkand offers a safe, affordable and student-friendly environment. Along with an affordable cost of living, one can also experience the rich culture here. It is an ideal place for international students. Students pursuing MBBS Abroad at Samarkand State Medical University not only receive world-class medical education but also experience the vibrant traditions and hospitality of Uzbekistan.

Samarkand State Medical University is recognized by many prestigious global organizations, ensuring that its degrees are respected and accepted worldwide. Some of the key recognitions include:

  • National Medical Commission (NMC), India
  • UNESCO
  • Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
  • Foundation for Advancement of International Medical Education & Research (FAIMER)

Why is Samarkand State Medical University the Best to Study MBBS Abroad?

Samarkand State Medical University (SSMU) is considered the best destination for MBBS in Uzbekistan due to its affordable fees, high academic standards, and global recognition acknowledged by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the National Medical Commission (NMC). Below we share the reasons Why is Samarkand State Medical University the Best to Study MBBS Abroad?

Globally Recognized Degree

SSMU offers an MBBS degree that is acknowledged by major global organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO), the National Medical Commission (NMC) of India, and the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG).

Affordable Tuition Fees

Compared to many other countries, the cost of studying MBBS at Samarkand State Medical University is relatively low. The university offers high-quality education at an affordable price.

English Medium of Instruction

 The MBBS program at SSMU is taught in English, which is a significant advantage for international students. This eliminates the language barrier and allows students to focus solely on their medical studies. 

Experienced Faculty

SSMU boasts a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members who are dedicated to providing students with a comprehensive medical education. The faculty includes professors, associate professors, and lecturers with extensive experience in teaching and research.

State-of-the-Art Infrastructure

The university is furnished with modern facilities, including well-equipped laboratories, a comprehensive library, and advanced medical equipment. These resources provide students with the necessary tools to gain practical knowledge and hands-on experience.

Recognition of the University

Samarkand State Medical University is recognized by several prestigious global organizations, ensuring that its degrees are respected and accepted worldwide. Some of the key recognitions include:

  • World Health Organization (WHO)
  • National Medical Commission (NMC), India
  • UNESCO
  • Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
  • Foundation for Advancement of International Medical Education & Research (FAIMER)

Faculties at Samarkand State University

Uzbekistan’s best university, Samarkand State Medical University, has 10 faculties. 

  • Faculty of Medicine, founded in 1930
  • Faculty of Pediatrics, founded in 1963
  • Faculty of Medical Pedagogy, founded in 2005
  • Nursing faculty founded in 2005
  • Faculty of Dentistry, founded in 2009
  • Faculty of Pharmacy, founded in 2009
  • Faculty of Medical Prophylactics, Public Health, and Medical Biology, founded in 2020
  • International Faculty of Medical Education, founded in 2009
  • Faculty of Postgraduate Professional Training of Physicians, founded in 1981

Eligibility Criteria for SSMU Uzbekistan

If you are planning to study MBBS in Uzbekistan, take a step to secure admission to the MBBS program at Samarkand State Medical University. It’s one of the most prestigious institutions for medical aspirants. Applicants must meet the following eligibility criteria:

Academic Qualifications

Applicants must have completed their higher secondary education (10+2) or equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. For reserved category students, the minimum marks required are 40%.

Age Requirement

The applicant must be at least 17 years old on or before 31st December of the year of admission.

NEET Qualification

 For Indian students, qualifying in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) is mandatory. The NEET score is essential for securing admission and obtaining an eligibility certificate from the NMC.

Necessary Documents

Applicants are required to submit the following documents during the admission process:

  • 10th or 12th class mark sheet
  • Original Passport
  • Passport-size photograph
  • NEET scorecard
  • Medical certificate
  • ID Proof
  • Birth certificate
  • Bank Statement (3 month)
  • Offer letter provided by the university

Admission Process

MBBS in Uzbekistan, the admission process at Samarkand State Medical University is straightforward and involves the following steps:

  1. Application Submission: Interested candidates must fill out the online application form available on the university’s official website. Along with the application form, candidates must upload the required documents.
  2. Review of Application: The university’s admissions committee reviews the submitted applications and documents. Eligible candidates are issued an offer letter.
  3. Acceptance of Offer: Upon receiving the offer letter, candidates must accept the offer by paying the initial tuition fee. This fee is usually non-refundable and secures the candidate’s seat in the MBBS program.
  4. Visa Application: After securing admission, candidates must apply for a student visa at the Uzbekistan embassy or consulate in their country. The admission letter from the university is a crucial document for the visa application.
  5. Arrival and Enrollment: Once the visa is granted, students can travel to Uzbekistan. Upon arrival at the university, students must complete the enrollment process, which includes document verification and fee payment.

Facilities at Samarkand State Medical University

Samarkand State Medical University is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities to ensure that students receive a comprehensive education and a comfortable living environment. Some of the key facilities include:

  1. Modern Classrooms: The university has well-furnished classrooms equipped with audio-visual aids to enhance the learning experience.
  2. Advanced Laboratories: SSMU boasts modern laboratories that are equipped with the latest medical equipment. These labs provide students with practical training and hands-on experience.
  3. Comprehensive Library: The university’s library houses an extensive collection of medical books, journals, and research papers. It also offers access to online medical databases, providing students with the resources they need for their studies.
  4. Research Centers: SSMU has several research centers where students can engage in cutting-edge medical research under the guidance of experienced faculty members.
  5. Sports and Recreation: The university encourages physical fitness and well-being by providing sports facilities, including a gymnasium, basketball courts, and a football field.
  6. Cafeteria: The university has a cafeteria that offers a variety of healthy and hygienic food options for students.

MBBS syllabus at Samarkand State Medical University

The MBBS curriculum at the Samarkand State Medical Institute lasts 6 years. The curriculum is taught by knowledgeable and skilled instructors using study-related technical equipment and clinical labs.

Hostel & Accommodation at Samarkand State Medical University

Samarkand State Medical University offers comfortable and affordable accommodation options for international students. The university provides separate hostels for boys and girls, ensuring a safe and secure living environment. Key features of the hostel facilities include:

  1. Well-Furnished Rooms: The hostel rooms are well-furnished with essential amenities such as beds, study tables, chairs, and wardrobes. Rooms are available on a shared basis, usually accommodating 2-4 students per room.
  2. 24/7 Security: The hostels are equipped with 24/7 security systems, including CCTV cameras and security personnel, to ensure the safety of students.
  3. Wi-Fi connectivity: The hostels offer high-speed internet connectivity, allowing students to stay connected with their families and access online academic resources.
  4. Mess Facility: The university provides a mess facility within the hostels that serves nutritious and hygienic meals, catering to the dietary preferences of international students.
  5. Common Room: Each hostel has a common room where students can relax, socialize, and watch television.
  6. Laundry Services: Laundry facilities are available within the hostel premises, making it convenient for students to manage their daily chores.
  7. Proximity to Campus: The hostels are located within walking distance of the university campus, making it easy for students to attend classes and access other university facilities.

After MBBS at Samarkand State Medical University: Career Opportunities

Graduating from Samarkand State Medical University in Uzbekistan opens up a wide range of career opportunities for students. Some of the potential career paths include:

  1. Medical Practice: Graduates can practice medicine in Uzbekistan or return to their home country to pursue a medical career. In India, graduates must clear the Foreign Medical Graduates Examination (FMGE) to practice.
  2. Postgraduate Studies: Graduates can pursue further studies, including MD or MS programs, in various specializations. SSMU graduates are eligible to apply for postgraduate courses in countries like the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia.
  3. Research: Those interested in medical research can work as researchers in medical institutions or pursue a PhD in their chosen field of study.
  4. Healthcare Administration: Graduates can also explore careers in healthcare management and administration, working in hospitals, clinics, or healthcare organizations.
  5. Teaching: With an MBBS degree, graduates can pursue a career in academia, teaching medical students at universities and medical colleges.
  6. Public Health: Graduates can work in public health sectors, contributing to health policy planning, epidemiology, and community health. For more information check AR Group Of Education

Living Cost at Samarkand State Medical University

Living costs vary from Institute to Institute and from course to course. Samarkand city provides a reasonable cost of living expenses that may vary depending on the requirements of an individual. The total hostel fees cost 41.66 USD. Other expenses need to be taken care of such as cost of living, travel (4.5 USD), food (120 USD), etc. A student can work part-time or apply for scholarships to bear these expenses.

Benefits of Study MBBS in Uzbekistan

  • Low and affordable tuition fee
  • No capitalization fee
  • Globally recognized University
  • MBBS degree hold great worth

MBBS cut-off In India  will be provided by NTA on the day of the result. The cutoff will depend on various factors such as the difficulty level of the exam, and the total number of test takers, among others. The official MBBS cut-off  In India will be released by NTA after the declaration of the MBBS 2022 result which is likely to be declared in the first week of September. MBBS India

content:
Office of the Chairman, NEET UG Medical and Dental Admission/Counselling board will be releasing the cutoff of NEET 2023 Rajasthan in online mode after the completion of the final round of counseling. The cutoff of NEET 2023 is the last rank of the applicants to get Rajasthan MBBS admission in their respective categories.

Apply Now

MBBS India

The Rajasthan MBBS cutoff will be prepared category-wise separately for all participating institutes. MBBS CUTOFF IN RAJASTHAN will be released by the state authority for 85% of State Quota seats, whereas the cutoff for 85% of All India Quota seats (AIQ) will be released by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The aspirants who qualify for the entrance exam of NEET will be eligible for admission to the Rajasthan MBBS/BDS colleges.

On the basis of the Rajasthan NEET, 2023 cutoff admission will be granted to qualified aspirants. The NEET 2023 Cutoff Rajasthan for an institute depends on factors like availability of seats and the number of applicants who appeared for NEET 2022, so it would always vary for admission around 3683 MBBS and 1403 BDS seats in government and private colleges. Go through NEET 2022 cutoff Rajasthan, previous years’ admission cutoffs, and other details here.

NEET 2023 Cutoff Rajasthan

For aspirants seeking admission in the state, the cutoff of NEET 2023 Rajasthan is the last rank of the applicants to get admission in their respective category at the college is allotted to them. The provided data regarding the Rajasthan NEET 2023 cutoff is only for the guidance of applicants to set a target score for them. NEET 2023 cutoff Rajasthan includes the last score of various MBBS/ BDS colleges of the state and it will surely boost the preparation for the NEET exam. It must be noted that the cutoff of NEET Rajasthan is only for reference purposes.

Factors on which Rajasthan NEET 2023 cutoff depends

Candidates can go through the factors that affect the NEET 2022 Cutoff Rajasthan, which are mentioned below.

  • Appearing candidates in NEET 2023
  • Questions difficulty level
  • Seats available for Rajasthan MBBS admission
  • Scores obtained in NEET
  • Reservation category

Rajasthan NEET Cutoff 2023: 15% All India Quota seats

DGHS is the competent authority on behalf of MCC to publish the category-wise cutoff of NEET 2023 Rajasthan for the 15% All India Quota seats (AIQ). Rajasthan NEET 2023 Cutoff will consist of NEET All India ranks (AIR) and the scores which are equivalent to it and which are secured by the aspirants to get admission to the various colleges through the final round of counseling. Rajasthan MBBS/BDS cutoff of 15% AIQ seats only published for aspirants who have applied under the same.

The obtained NEET ranks and their equivalent scores by the last applicants to grant admission in their respective categories will be included in the NEET cutoff 2023 Rajasthan.

title: MBBS CUTOFF IN PUNJAB
content:
As students prepare themselves for the NEET exam 2023, it becomes important for them to know about the cutoff marks of Punjab of 2021. However Neet exam will be held on 7th May 2023. Meanwhile, students can go through NEET 2022 cutoff Punjab to get a fair idea of the Punjab NEET cut-off for 2023.

Apply Now

MBBS India

NEET is the only gateway to a dream career in medicine. Like most of the states of India, Punjab also holds the power for counseling 85% of seats in the medical colleges of the state. 15% of the seats are counseled by the Medical Council Committee. Yearwise the cut-off marks in the Punjab NEET exam varies. Baba Farid University of Health Sciences conducts the counseling for MBBS and BDS seats of the colleges in Punjab.

Being aware of the cut-off marks of NEET beforehand is extremely important for the aspirant to plan the steps accordingly. This is as important as appearing for the exam. The cut-off marks also make the candidate aware of the fact whether they will get a chance to join their dream college or they should start their preparation for the second time.

It is no secret that several aspirants rely on precise information related to exam dates, centers, and stipulated cutoff marks to steer their level of preparation. Therefore, it will help you beyond measure to be aware of the MBBS cutoff 2021 Punjab, allowing you to take the necessary steps towards securing a seat in prestigious medical colleges.

What can be the Cutoff of NEET 2023 – Factors

Medical colleges and universities, both public and private, require MBBS aspirants to score minimum marks in NEET to attain admission. However, students often resort to a comparative study of cut-off marks from previous years to estimate the requirements for this current year. Added to that, the NEET Punjab cutoff 2023 will depend on an array of factors that influence such conditions every year.

Thus, let’s shed some light on the factors that you should take into consideration while estimating the NEET 2022 Cutoff Punjab –

  • The volume of seats available with institutions that offer medical courses for undergraduates.
  • The total number of students taking NEET 2023.
  • The total number of applications that each institution receives from NEET aspirants.
  • The score that an aspirant secures in this national examination for MBBS and BDS.
  • Finally, the category to which the students appearing for NEET belong.

Thus, a combination of such factors determines the overall cutoff marks that you will have to secure in a bid to crack the best medical colleges in Punjab.

Cutoff Marks for NEET Punjab 2023

Every year, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) publishes the details of NEET cut-off marks based on the All India Quota. The cutoff for the year 2023 will be declared after the exams. However, you should keep an eye on the yearly cutoff marks, and NEET 2021 cut-off Punjab, along with the rank of all categories to ramp up your preparations for NEET 2023.

Secondly, have a proper timetable for your studies. Solve previous year’s question papers and sample papers to get a proper idea of the exam. Also, don’t forget to take proper breaks between the studies.

Make sure that you take adequate care of your health, besides applying the needful efforts into your studies. Also, be consistent with your daily practice of mock question papers to improve your chances of securing the marks for the NEET Punjab cut-off 2023.

title: MBBS cutoff in Karnataka
content:
MBBS cutoff in Karnataka – Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA), Bangalore will release the cutoff of Karnataka NEET admission for 85% state quota seats and 100% seats in private colleges. The NEET cutoff Karnataka 2023 will be published in an online mode at kea.kar.nic.in.

Apply Now

MBBS India

MBBS cutoff in Karnataka is the last rank and score at which admission to MBBS/BDS course will be granted. The NEET cutoff in Karnataka will be different for each category, college, and course. The cutoff of Karnataka NEET 2023 will depend on factors such as the number of candidates, the NEET-UG exam difficulty level, and the number of seats. Authority will release the cutoff after the Karnataka MBBS 2023 counseling. Check the category and course-wise MBBS cutoff in Karnataka below.

The NEET cutoff Karnataka 2023 for 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats will be released by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The cutoff for 15% AIQ seats by MCC will be released after NEET 2022 counseling. Only candidates who will qualify for the NEET exam will be eligible for counseling and seat allotment. A total of 9,345 MBBS and 3,445 BDS seats in the state will be allotted through Karnataka NEET admission 2023.

What is the MBBS cutoff in Karnataka?

MBBS cutoff in Karnatakais the last rank at which the authority will grant MBBS/BDS admission to NEET 2023 qualified candidates. The NEET cutoff Karnataka 2023 will be released individually for each course, category, and medical/dental college. With the help of the MBBS cutoff in Karnataka, candidates can get an idea about the rank and score at which admission is granted to which course and institute. Authority will release the Karnataka MBBS/BDS cutoff for each round of counseling. A total of three rounds of Karnataka NEET-UG counseling will be held.

Factors to determine MBBS cutoff in Karnataka

Check the factors on which the MBBS cutoff in Karnataka 2022 will depend below.

  • Number of applicants for the NEET exam
  • NEET question paper difficulty level
  • A score of the candidates in the NEET 2023 result
  • Karnataka MBBS/BDS seat matrix 2023

MBBS cutoff IN Karnataka for 15% AIQ quota

As aforesaid, the Karnataka NEET cutoff for 15% AIQ seats will be published by the MCC. MCC will release the cutoff for 15% AIQ seats after the NEET 2023 counseling. The NEET cutoff Karnataka will include the All India Rank and the corresponding marks scored in NEET 2022. The cutoff of Karnataka NEET 2022 will vary for each category and institute. Candidates can check the NEET-UG cutoff Karnataka for previous years below.

MBBS cutoff Karnataka for 85% state quota

KEA will release e the NEET cutoff Karnataka 2023 for 85% MBBS/BDS seats in the under-state quota. The NEET cutoff Karnataka is the last rank at which admission to the candidate in the state merit list will be granted. The cutoff of Karnataka NEET 2023 will mention the course name, institute name, category, last rank, and corresponding NEET marks. The Karnataka NEET 2022 cutoff will be released in an online mode at kea.kar.nic.in.

content:
NEET or the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test is conducted by the National Testing Agency. NTA is also the authority that releases the cut-off for the NEET examination every year. The Haryana NEET cut-off 2023 is expected to be released by the Directorate of Medical and Research, Haryana as per the previous year. NEET 2023 exam will be held on 7th may 2023.  Haryana NEET cut-off 2023 will be released soon after NEET 2023.

Apply Now

MBBS India

The NEET cut-off 2023 for Haryana will be released for the All India Quota (15%) and State Quota (85%), separately. The Medical Counselling Committee or MCC will announce the NEET cut-off 2023 for the 15% All India Quota seats in Haryana, while the DMER will reveal the NEET cut-off 2023 for the 85% state quota seats in Haryana. Mostly the admission for the 85% state quota seats starts soon after the NEET results.

MBBS Cutoff in Haryana

There are category-wise reservations for MBBS and BDS Courses in the medical colleges of India. Hence, the cut-off marks for every state vary according to the available seats in the medical colleges and dental colleges run by the State Government. There are 368 BDS seats and 581 MBBS seats in the medical colleges of Haryana. 

The official MBBS Cutoff in Haryana will provide the minimum NEET scores and ranks that the medical institutions of Haryana will accept for MBBS and BDS admissions. Therefore, going through the detailed Haryana NEET cut-off trends of the previous few years will help candidates to get some idea of the expected minimum NEET scores and ranks that they need to obtain, so as to get admission to their preferred medical college in Haryana.

NEET 2023 aspirants may refer to the Haryana NEET cut-off trends for 2020 and 2021 to check out the cut-off percentile and ranks for 85% state quota seats and 15% All India quota seats in Haryana. It may hereby be noted, that only if a candidate qualifies for NEET 2023, he or she will be eligible for the Haryana MBBS or BDS counseling and admission.

Determining Factors for MBBS NEET Cutoff in Haryana

Candidates should be aware of the factors that will be considered by the Directorate of Medical and Research for determining the NEET 2023 cut-off for Haryana. So, it will be easier for them to predict the expected NEET cut-off score and ranks and prepare accordingly. The following factors will be taken into account while determining the NEET cut-off for 2023.

  • The total number of candidates appearing in NEET 2023.
  • The difficulty level of the NEET 2023 question paper.

title: MBBS CUTOFF IN BIHAR
content:
Bihar NEET 2023 cutoff specifies the last rank and associated score that students must achieve in order to be admitted to a specific medical and dental college. The list for  Bihar MBBS/BDS seat allotment will be released by conducting authority and will include the marks and ranks of candidates who have been shortlisted for the state’s government medical seats. The NEET 2023 Bihar cutoff will be used to determine the final rank and score used in seat allocation. The cutoff for NEET fluctuates depending on a number of criteria including the number of sanctioned seats, the total number of applications received for admission along with the category of the aspirants.

Apply Now

MBBS India

A candidate must be a permanent resident of Bihar to be considered for state quota seats. To be eligible for Bihar domicile, an aspirant’s parent(s) must be permanent residents of the state. Aspirants who meet the domicile norms and fulfill the minimum percentile will be listed on the state merit list for Bihar MBBS 2022.    

Bihar NEET Cut-off 2023 – Important Factors

The cut-off for an exam is not based on the score alone. Various facts play along to determine the necessary cut-off for the various rounds. Bihar NEET 2023 Cutoff will be based on the following factors:

  • The total number of candidates appearing for the examination.
  • The overall difficulty levels of the exam.
  • The highest percentile as scored by the topper
  • A total number of seats available.
  • The previous years cut off trends.

Bihar NEET 2023 Cut-off – Important Points

Candidates applying for the upcoming NEET examination are advised to go through the following instructions related to NEET 2022 Cut off:

  1. NEET Cut-off 2022 will be considered depending on several parameters like the total number of seats, the number of appearing candidates, last year’s admission record and the difficulty level of the examination.
  2. Candidates with the highest grades will be given the highest rank, while those with the lowest marks will be given the lowest rank.
  3. NTA will release the opening as well as the closing rank differently for all medical colleges.
  4. The closing rank for a college will be decided considering the total number of seats in that college along with the total number of candidates who applied for NEET 2023 Counselling.
  5. All the candidates will be asked to fill out their preferences in counselling based on their NEET exam scores.

title: MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA
content:
The Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DMER), Maharashtra, will release the MBBS CUTOFF IN Maharashtra for 9,820 MBBS seats and 3,526 BDS seats. After completing the counseling process, the Maharashtra NEET cutoff 2023 for MBBS will be released and updated here.

Apply Now

MBBS India

NEET cutoff 2023 of Maharashtra represents the last rank and corresponding marks required for admission to a particular course in a college. MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA will be determined by a combination of factors, including the seat matrix, number of applicants, NEET score, reservation, and other factors. The NEET Maharashtra cutoff for each category will be different. After Maharashtra MBBS/BDS counseling 2023, the cutoff will be announced. Read about the NEET cutoff and other details for MBBS/BDS admissions in Maharashtra for 2023.

About Maharashtra NEET 2023 admission

Candidates who qualify for Maharashtra’s NEET 2023 will be eligible for admission to the Maharashtra MBBS/BDS admission. Candidates with Maharashtra domicile who will be declared qualified in the NEET result 2023 will be considered for admission.

MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA Factors

  • Number of candidates appearing in the NEET exam 2023
  • NEET exam difficulty level
  • Candidate’s NEET result and scores
  • MBBS and BDS seats are available

Types of MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA

Two quotas apply under Maharashtra MBBS/BDS admissions – 15% All India Quota (AIQ) and 85% state quota. The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is the authority that conducts admissions and releases the NEET Cut-off 2023 Maharashtra for 15% AIQ seats. Similarly, DMER will release the NEET 2023 Maharashtra cutoff for 85% of the state quota seats. The Maharashtra NEET cutoff for 15% AIQ and 85% state quota is listed below.

MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA – 15% AIQ quota

In keeping with what was stated previously, MCC will release the NEET cutoff Maharashtra 2023 for 15% AIQ seats. After each round of counseling and seat allocation, the NEET 2023 Maharashtra cutoff will be announced. In the NEET cutoff Maharashtra, the candidate’s All India Rank, NEET score, and last rank at which admission is granted will be provided. Each category, i.e., SC, ST, OBC, UR, PH, and EWS, will have a different NEET cutoff in 2023 Maharashtra.

MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA – 85% state quota

Under state quota, DMER will announce Maharashtra’s NEET cutoff for 85% of seats. MBBS CUT OFF IN MAHARASHTRA is the last rank at which a particular course, college, and admission category will be granted. There are a total of 9,820 MBBS seats and 3,526 BDS seats. Earlier, 70% of these seats were allocated under regional quotas, while 30% were allocated under state quotas. However, regional and state quotas have been discarded from the 2023 session forward.

Maharashtra’s NEET cutoff 2023 will include the last ranks for different categories based on constitutional reservation. Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Caste converts to Buddhism (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes (NT -1/2/3), Other Backward Classes, and Economically Weaker Sections make up these categories.

title: MBBS CUTOFF IN  UTTARAKHAND
content:
Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University (HNBUMU) will release MBBS CUTOFF IN UTTARAKHAND after the examination. Uttarakhand NEET (MBBS/BDS) 2023 Cutoff to 85% state quota seats and private Medical/dental colleges. Uttarakhand MBBS Cutoff will be released in two sets, All India Quota Cutoff and State Quota Cutoff. Uttarakhand MBBS/BDS cutoff 2023 for 15% of All India Quota seats will be going through by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).

Apply Now

MBBS India

NEET (National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test) is a national-level medical entrance test conducted by NTA (National Testing Agency) every year in India. It is mandatory to qualify for NEET if a candidate wants admission to an MBBS/ BDS course in a medical college. The Cut off Procedure is going through with Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University.

MBBS 2023 Brief Description

Before discussing the complete details of MBBS CUTOFF IN  UTTARAKHAND, let’s briefly describe MBBS 2023.

Features

Specifications

Government MBBS Seats

Private MBBS Seats

300

MBBS CUTOFF  Important Instructions

The Admission Seekers applying for NEET are advised to check these necessary Instruction Related to NEET 2023 Cut off.

  • The MBBS CUTOFF will be based on various parameters like numbers of appearing candidates, total numbers of seats, the difficulty level of the examination, and last year’s admission record.
  • The Cutoff marks will be announced to only those candidates who will qualify for the NEET 2023 examination.
  • The Admission Seekers who will secure the highest mark will get the top rank, whereas, the candidates with low marks will be allotted the lowest rank.
  • The Selection Board of NTA (National Testing Agency) will not announce the Minimum Cutoff Marks for a specified Branch or College.
  • Test-taking Agency will announce the opening/first rank and closing/last rank for different Medical Colleges.
  • The closing/last rank for a particular college will be based on the total number of seats in a college with the total number of candidates appearing in NEET UG Counselling 2023.
  • Admission Seekers are advised to fill their preferences in counseling according to their merit in the entrance examination.

WB NEET MBBS & BDS Counselling Eligibility

●    The applying seekers should have qualified for the NEET Entrance Examination.

●    Aspirants must have the domicile of West Bengal.

●    The applying seekers must have completed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/ Biotechnology, and English are the compulsory subjects with a minimum of 50% marks, 40% marks are required for SC/ST category candidates, and 45% marks are for Physically Handicap candidates.

●    Age Criteria: The candidate should have completed 17 years as of 31-12-2022.
The candidates born on or after 02-01-2005 are not eligible for admission into MBBS or BDS Courses.

How to Apply

  • Step I: The candidate must visit the official website.
  • Step 2: After opening the official website of MCC and clicking on ‘New Registration.’
  • Step 3: The dashboard page of MBBS admissions will open in a new tab, and the candidates must click on ‘Sign Up. Enter the ‘Registered Mobile Number, E-Mail, and other details to create a login account on the official website. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to complete pre-registration, and a login account will be created.
  • Step 4: Log on to the MCC website and click on ‘Candidate login.’
  • Step 5: Enter your Roll Number and Password.
  • Step 6: You will be redirected to a new page where you will have to enter details like Name, Roll No., Registration No., Mother’s Name, Contact No., etc. When you’re done, click on ‘Submit’.
  • Step 7: You will be redirected to a new page where you have to enter details like Name, Roll No; when you’re done, click on ‘Submit’.
  • Step 8: After this, you will be shown all your details per the NTA database. Verify the information and click on ‘Confirm Registration. A Registration Slip will be generated. Candidates are advised to save this page.
  • Step 9: After successful registration, candidates are asked to submit a refundable and non-refundable NEET 2022 counseling fee. The UR Category fee is Rs. 1000 and for SC/ST/OBC/PWD fee is Rs. 500.
  • Step 10: Choice Locking facility is available for a specific time
  • Step 11: Release of Seat Allotment Result It is released in the form of a list followed by a seat allotment letter to the selected candidates. Candidates must report to the allotted colleges with the allotment letter and other documents to finish the admission process.

For Management Quota

For NRI Quota

  • Documents claiming that the candidate/sponsor is NRI (valid passport, visa, recent utility bill)
  • Relationship of the NRI sponsor with the candidate as per the order of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India in case WP (C) No 689/2017- Consortium of Deemed Universities in Karnataka (CODEUNIK) and Anr vs The Union of India and Ors. Dated 22-08-2017
  • Notarized Affidavit of the sponsor that they shall sponsor the entire course fee of the candidate

title: NEET UG Counselling In UP
content:
NEET UG Counselling in UP will be held by the Directorate of Medical Education and Training (DMET), Uttar Pradesh. Dates for UP NEET counseling 2022 have yet not been released. Candidates will find the whole schedule for UP counseling for MBBS admission 2022 on the official website. Registration for counseling will most likely begin in the second week of August.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

UPDGME UG counseling is held for admission under 85% state quota seats. NEET UG Counselling in UP will take place in three rounds. The third round will be an open round or mop-up round. The seats left vacant after the first round of counseling of UP NEET 2022 will be carried forward to the second round. The third round, also known as the mop-up round, will be held to fill the seats left vacant after the second round if any.

It is important to note that admission to MBBS/ BDS courses offered by the medical colleges in Uttar Pradesh is done on the basis of the marks scored in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test only. The state will conduct no other entrance test for this purpose.

Stages of UP NEET Counselling 2022

To participate in the NEET Uttar Pradesh counseling 2021, a candidate must follow the below-mentioned steps:

Registration – All those candidates who wish to participate in the UP NEET Counselling 2022 have to register themselves on the official website – https://upneet.gov.in/

Candidates have to register only once for the counseling of UP NEET 2022. Candidates who have registered for the first round do not have to register again for the second round.

For successful registration, a fee of INR 2,000 has to be paid. This registration fee can be paid via credit card/ debit card/ net banking.

Security Money – After completing the registration process, candidates have to pay a refundable security deposit or “security money”. This security money has to be paid via a Demand Draft in favor of “Director General, Medical Education & Training, U.P”, payable at Lucknow. The security money differs for the candidates who wish to participate for private or government colleges. The amount of security money also differs for medical and dental courses. Candidates can refer to the table given below for information on the security money:

Security money payable for UP MBBS Counselling 2022

Verification of Documents – After successful registration and deposition of the security money, a candidate needs to report to the nodal centers for verification of documents. If a candidate fails to report to the respective nodal center in the stipulated time, their seat will be given to the candidate next in line. Only after the successful verification of the documents, a candidate will be able to proceed to the next stage of UP NEET counselling 2022.

Choice Filling and Locking – Post the verification of documents, candidates have to log in on the UP MBBS counselling 2021 official website and choose the desired colleges in order of preference. A step-by-step guide for the choice filling and locking process in the counseling of UP NEET 2022 is given below:

  • Login: One has to login using the NEET 2022 roll number and password. An OTP will be sent to the candidates on their registered mobile number
  • Choice Filling: A list of colleges will appear on the screen. The candidate must choose the desired colleges in the order of preference. Those applying for private and minority colleges should check all the information about the colleges and their fee structure before selecting them. After choosing the preferred colleges, a candidate must save the selection to proceed further.
  • Locking of the options: The choices must be locked and submitted before the deadline. For the candidates who fail to submit the final choices, their application will not be considered for NEET Uttar Pradesh counselling 2022.
  • Seat allotment list: Once the choices are submitted, DMET reviews all the applications and forms merit list or seat allotment list for the selected candidates.
  • Reporting to the college allotted: Those who want to continue with the seat allotted to them in the NEET UG Counselling in UP, need to report to the college allotted to them. They must report to the college before the last date and must carry the relevant documents with them.

Documents required during the verification process of NEET UG Counselling in UP

Candidates have to carry the following documents to the respective nodal centers for verification. Failure to do so will result in the forfeiture of the seat allocated.

  • NEET admit card 2022
  • NEET rank card 2022
  • Class 10 mark sheet
  • Class 12 mark sheet
  • A valid photo Id proof (Aadhaar card/ Passport/ Driving License/ Pan Card)
  • Domicile Certificate of Uttar Pradesh
  • Caste Certificate
  • Online registration slip
  • Receipt depicting the successful deposition of security money

Admission to the MBBS and BDS seats that fall under the 85% state quota will be through Punjab NEET counseling 2022. Candidates who qualify for NEET 2022 will have to register themselves on the official website of BFUHS. After completing the registration process, they will have to submit their course and college preferences online. Based on these choices, BFUHS will prepare the seat allotment list. Step 1: Registration

MP NEET 2022 Counseling: Eligibility Criteria

Candidates who wish to participate in the counseling of MP NEET 2022 need to fulfill the following eligibility requirement, set by DME:

Age: Applicant must be at least 17 years old as on December 31, 2022. There is no upper age of the applicants.

Qualification:  Applicant must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Biology, Chemistry and English as core subjects.

Domicile: Applicant must be domiciled in the state of Madhya Pradesh. Those who have completed their formal education from the state, but are not domiciled in MP, can also apply for MP NEET counseling 2022.

MP NEET 2022 Counseling Process

Registration:

Post the announcement of the NEET result 2022, all those who have qualified for the examination and wish to participate in the counseling will have to register on the official website of DME. They must note that it is mandatory to register online to fill out the application form for the counseling of MP NEET 2022.

Seat matrix and merit list:

DME will release the list of participating institutes along with the seats available in them for each category. This seat matrix will be followed by the release of the MP NEET state merit list. This merit list will include the names of all eligible candidates who had filled out the application form for MP NEET 2022 counseling.

Choice Filling and locking:

Candidates who have been included in the state merit list can proceed toward choice filling. To access the choice filling option, they will have to log in to the account created during the registration/application process. It is important to note that the candidate who fails to fill the desired choices will not be considered for the seat allotment process. They must also lock their choices before the last date to be considered for the next stages of MP NEET counseling 2022.

Seat allotment list:

Based on the merit position of the candidate and the choices filled by them, DME will prepare the result for the counseling of MP NEET 2022. The result for MP NEET counseling 2022 is better known as the seat allotment list. DME will release a separate seat allotment list for every round of MP NEET 2022 counseling.

Document verification and confirmation of admission:

Candidates who have been allocated a seat and want to continue with it will be required to report to the respective institute for document verification. They need to carry original certificates, with two attested copies, to the allocated institute for verification. They will also need to deposit the tuition fee for the current year to confirm admission.

title: NEET UG COUNSELING
content:
The Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) will release the National Eligibility cum Entrance Examination, NEET-UG  counseling schedule at mcc.nic.in.

MCC’s NEET 2022 counseling will be held for 15% of All India Quota (AIQ) seats in government colleges and 100% in deemed/central universities, ESIC/AFMS, AIIMS, JIPMER, and BSc Nursing programs on the grounds of NEET 2022. The NEET AIQ counseling process for 2022 will be divided into four rounds namely rounds 1, 2, mop up and stray vacancy.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

In the NEET UG 2022 counseling session, eligible candidates will have to register, fill out the choice of courses and colleges and pay the fee. On the ground of the choices filled by the aspirants, NEET 2022 rank, seat availability, and reservation, the seat will be allotted.

NEET is the only entrance examination for admission to 91,415 MBBS, 26,949 BDS, 52,720 AYUSH, and 525 BVSc & AH seats, respectively in 542 and 313 medical and dental colleges.

Be familiar with the NEET UG counseling scheme for 15% AQI

The MCC will conduct four rounds of counseling: AIQ Round 1, AIQ Round 2, AIQ Mop-up round, and stray vacancy round. Candidates who qualify as part of the All India Quota will be eligible based on their NEET UG results in 2022, other than the Union Territory of J&K. If seats remain vacant after round 2 of NEET 2022 counseling in AIQ, they will be sent back to the states.

The AIQ for NEET counseling in 2022 will include the following:

  • 15% MBBS/BDS Seats of States
  • 100% MBBS/BDS Seats of BHU
  • 100% MBBS Seats of AIIMS across India
  • All India Quota of JIPMER (Puducherry/ Karaikal)
  • All India Quota seats of AMU/ DU/ VMMC/ ABVIMS
  • All India Quota Seats of Faculty of Dentistry (Jamia Milia Islamia)
  • All India Quota Seats of ESIC

There will be four rounds of counseling i.e. Round 1, Round 2 of AIQ and Mop-Up Round & Stray Vacancy Round.

●     Out of the four rounds, three rounds will be conducted online by MCC i.e. Round 1, Round 2, and Mop-Up Round.

●     The Stray Vacancy round shall be conducted by the respective Deemed counselings

AIIMS and JIPMER

●    
There will be four rounds of counseling i.e. Round 1, Round 2 of AIQ, and Mop-Up Round & Stray Vacancy Round for 18 AIIMS.

●     Out of the four rounds, three rounds will be conducted online by MCC i.e. Round 1, Round 2, and Mop-Up Round.

●     The Stray Vacancy round shall be conducted by AIIMS

ESIC

●     ESIC 15% seats would be allotted through All India Quota (Round one & two).

●     The remaining 85% seats shall be treated as state quota seats and will be open to all the candidates participating in the Mop-up Round.

Central university/institute

●     There will be four rounds of NEET 2022 counseling i.e. Round 1, Round 2 of AIQ, and Mop-Up Round & Stray Vacancy Round.

●     Out of the four rounds, three rounds will be conducted online by MCC i.e. Round 1, Round 2, and Mop-Up Round.

●     Stray Vacancy round shall be conducted by the respective Central University/Institute.

AIQ seat matrix for MCC NEET UG counseling 2022

The DHGS will release the seat matrix on behalf of MCC for the NEET 2022 counseling round one. Once released, candidates can find the NEET UG counseling 2022 seat matrix from the table. Until then, candidates can check the seat matrix below for MCC NEET counseling for the previous year. Seat matrices for MBBS, BDS, and AIQ seats in Central University, Deemed University, and those offered by ESIC institutes will be published separately.

About NEET Counseling 2022

Based on NEET-UG results, admissions to MBBS/BDS courses under AIQ deemed universities, and ESIC/AFMS colleges in the country are decided by the MCC NEET 2022 counseling process. The NEET exam qualifying is a requirement for admission to these medical courses. There are two types of NTA NEET counseling: All India and State counseling. The following seats are included in NEET UG counseling

  1. MCC counseling process for All India Quota seats: The AIQ NEET 2022 counseling process is the only method of admission to 15% of seats in all government medical and dental colleges, all seats at deemed universities and central universities, and all seats at Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) and the American Funds for Medical Care (AFMC) including Delhi University (DU), BHU, AMU, and AIIMS & JIPMER. It is important to note that J & K are not involved in this process.
  1. State Quota seats for NEET UG counseling: Admissions to 85% of seats from government colleges and all seats from private unaided/aided minority/non-minority medical/dental colleges in the state will be done through state NEET counseling 2022.

NEET counseling 2022: Eligibility criteria

  • Candidates who will qualify for the NEET will be eligible to apply for NEET 2022 counseling.
  • Candidates from Jammu and Kashmir would not be eligible to participate in All India NEET counseling unless they give their consent.
  • Those who will register for NEET 2022 counseling on the MCC website.
  • The AIQ counseling for Deemed Universities will be open to all NEET-qualified candidates.

Central University Eligibility Criteria for the NEET counseling in UP2022

1) Delhi University (LHMC, UCMS, MAMC): – 15% seats for All India Quota & 85% institutional quota seats for candidates who have passed their 10+2 in Delhi.

2) Aligarh Muslim University (AMU):- 50% Institutional reservation for the AMU school candidates studying there for the last 3 years. Rest of the 50% of seats to All India candidates.

3) BHU:- Open to All India candidates

4) Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, Delhi: 3 BDS seats under the internal quota of JMI, and 47 seats are open to All India quota candidates. Students who have passed their 10+ 2 from Jamia Schools can apply for an internal quota.

5) VMMC & SJH: 15% seats for All India and rest as Institute Quota for students who have passed their 10+2 from Delhi.

NEET 2022 Counseling Process

MCC will conduct NEET-UG 2022 counseling for AIQ in four rounds, including a mop-up round and a stray vacancy round. Following the completion of Round 2, the remaining seats will be filled in a mop-up round and a stray vacancy round by the MCC. Steps to be taken include

Step 1: Complete the MCC NEET registration process, including payment.

Step 2: NEET 2022 counseling choice filling and locking

Step 3: Round 1 seat allotment and result announcement

Step 4: Reporting to the allotted Medical/Dental College (option for free entry/exit)

Step 5: Round 2 net vacant seats are published.

Step 6: NEET counseling round 2 registration (not necessary for already registered candidates) and fresh choice filling for NEET counseling round 2

Step 7: Round 2 of seat allocation (exit with forfeiture of security amount option available)

Step 8: Reporting to medical/dental colleges/institutions in preparation for round 2 (candidates once joined the allotted seat are not allowed to vacate the seat).

NEET 2022 counseling Process Step-by-Step

Step 1: NEET counseling registration

Qualified and eligible candidates need to register at mcc.nic.in. Applicants must fill out their NEET roll number, registration number, name, mother’s name, and date of birth. Next, pay the NEET counseling fee and security fee online with a credit card or debit card.

Step 2: Filling in choices for NEET 2022 counseling

How should choices be filled in for NEET counseling in 2022? Here’s how. Applicants must make a dummy sheet and enter their dream college choices. They can use the NEET college predictor if they want to know their chance of getting into college based on past data. For the NEET counseling process in 2022, they will be able to choose from this list of choices.

Step 3: NEET 2022 Seat Allotment

Candidates must log in and download their seat allotment letters as soon as they are released. A free exit is available in the first round, while a forfeiture exit is available in the second round.

Step 4: Reporting to the Allotted College

Upon receiving an allotment of seats, a candidate must report to the designated college to complete the admissions processes. Reporting or joining during the first round is not mandatory. Those wishing to take the seat or upgrade must join and report. Seat allocation must be followed by reporting and joining in the second round unless candidates are willing to forfeit their security deposit by opting out. When reporting to the assigned college, candidates must present the originals of the specified documents.

Which documents are needed for NEET counseling 2022?

  • NEET 2022 Admit Card
  • Rank Letter or NEET score card
  • Class 10 certificate and mark sheet (for date of birth)
  • Class 12 certificate and mark sheet
  • ID proof (Aadhar/PAN Card/Driving License/Passport)
  • Eight passport size photographs
  • Provisional Allotment Letter
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)

NRI/ OCI candidates appearing for Deemed Universities must submit the following documents

  • Passport copy of sponsored, embassy certificate
  • Sponsorship affidavit (stating that sponsorer is ready to bear the expenses for the whole duration of the study)
  • Relationship Affidavit (Relation of Candidate with the sponsorer)

NEET counseling in UP2022 – What is the free exit? What is the exit with forfeiture?

Free Exit (only for round 1) – A candidate assigned a seat in round 1 who does not join/report to the college to which they have been assigned would not be penalized (the security deposit would not be forfeited). Candidates will be eligible for further rounds.

Exit with forfeiture – If a candidate is offered a seat in round 2 but does not intend to take the seat, they can still exit with forfeiture (losing the security amount deposited) within the period given.

Candidates joining the allotted seat in the second round will not be eligible to resign/surrender their seats and will not be permitted to participate in state counseling either.

NEET 2022 counseling for Deemed/Central Universities/Central Institutes

Step 1: Register for the mop-up round again (not required for earlier resigned candidates)

Step 2: Filling and locking your choices

Step 3: Mop-Up Round Seat Allocation for NEET 2022 counseling.

Step 4: Publication of the Results

Step 5: Reporting to the Medical/Dental College of your choice

Step 6: A list of ten times (of the registered candidates) of several stray vacancies to be provided to Deemed / Central Universities in strict order of merit to be exhausted.

Step 7: Deemed/Central Universities will conduct the last stray vacancy round (There will be no Fresh Registration of candidates in the Final Stray Vacancy Round)

content:
The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Postgraduate) (or Haryana NEET (PG)) is a qualifying and ranking examination in India, for students who wish to study various postgraduate Doctor of Medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS), and diploma courses, in government or private medical colleges in the country. This exam replaced the All India Post Graduate Medical Entrance Examination (AIPGMEE).

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

The exam is conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE). The counseling and seat allotment are conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

 

The Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) will conduct the Counseling for Haryana NEET PG 2022 in the online mode at mcc.nic.in. According to the latest notification, NBE has released the Haryana NEET PG 2022 result cum merit list for AIQ Counseling 2022. Official sources confirmed that the Haryana NEET PG 2022 Counseling will begin on September 1. However, the Haryana NEET PG 2022 Counseling schedule is expected to be announced soon at mcc.nic.in.

 

Earlier, MCC released an office stating that as part of its effort to make the process of generating PWD certificates transparent and hassle-free, the MCC IS developing software for eligible candidates participating in the Haryana NEET PG 2022 Counseling under the PWD category. All applicants who applied under the PWD category must get their PWD certificates from the designated center through an online mode to participate in Haryana NEET PG 2022 Counseling.

The official Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling schedule will be announced soon. The Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling dates will be updated here when announced. Earlier, the Haryana  NEET PG result 2022 was announced on June 1 at nbe.edu.in. MCC will conduct 4 rounds of Haryana  NEET PG 2022 All India Quota Counseling – round 1, round 2, mop-Haryana round, and stray vacancy round. Through the MCC Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling, the AIQ fresh registrations will be allowed in the first three rounds and not in the spot round. During the Haryana  NEET PG Counseling 2022, candidates have to register, pay fees and fill out their choice of courses and colleges. Based on the choices filled by the graduates, Haryana  NEET PG 2022 rank, and seat availability, admission will be granted.

Based on Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling, 26,168 Doctor of Medicine (MD), 13,649 Master of Surgery (MS), 922 PG Diploma, and 1,338 DNB CET seats will be filled. A total of 6,102 colleges and 649 hospitals will participate in the Haryana  NEET PG Counseling 2022. Then, the shortlisted candidates in the MCC Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling will be required to report to the allotted college.

What after Haryana  NEET PG Counseling round 1?

After the release of the Haryana  NEET PG 2022 seat allotment for Counseling round one, candidates will be required to follow the steps mentioned below based on their status.

1.    Free exit: The seat allotted in the first round of MCC Haryana  NEET PG Counseling will be canceled if a candidate does not report to the allotted institute within the stipulated time. Such an option is referred to as ‘free exit.’

2.    Accepting the seat allotted in round one: If a candidate who has been allotted a seat in the first round of Haryana  NEET PG 2022 Counseling is satisfied with the allotted seat they can report to the allotted institute and secure their seat by paying the tuition fee.

3.    Haryanagradation in round 2: If a candidate is not satisfied with the seat allotted to them, they can opt for Haryanagradation and participate in the second round of Haryana NEET PG Counseling 2022.
