title: Karnataka NEET PG Counseling
content:
The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Postgraduate) (or Karnataka NEET (PG)) is a qualifying and ranking examination in India, for students who wish to study various postgraduate Doctor of Medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS), and diploma courses, in government or private medical colleges in the country. This exam replaced the All India Post Graduate Medical Entrance Examination (AIPGMEE).

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

The exam is conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE). The counseling and seat allotment are conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

 

The Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) will conduct the Counseling for Karnataka NEET PG 2022 in the online mode at mcc.nic.in. According to the latest notification, NBE has released the Karnataka NEET PG 2022 result cum merit list for AIQ Counseling 2022. Official sources confirmed that the Karnataka NEET PG 2022 Counseling will begin on September 1. However, the Karnataka NEET PG 2022 Counseling schedule is expected to be announced soon at mcc.nic.in.

 

Earlier, MCC released an office stating that as part of its effort to make the process of generating PWD certificates transparent and hassle-free, the MCC IS developing software for eligible candidates participating in the Karnataka NEET PG 2022 Counseling under the PWD category. All applicants who applied under the PWD category must get their PWD certificates from the designated center through an online mode to participate in Karnataka NEET PG 2022 Counseling.

The official Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling schedule will be announced soon. The Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling dates will be updated here when announced. Earlier, the Karnataka  NEET PG result 2022 was announced on June 1 at nbe.edu.in. MCC will conduct 4 rounds of Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 All India Quota Counseling – round 1, round 2, mop-Karnataka round, and stray vacancy round. Through the MCC Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling, the AIQ fresh registrations will be allowed in the first three rounds and not in the spot round. During the Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling 2022, candidates have to register, pay fees and fill out their choice of courses and colleges. Based on the choices filled by the graduates, Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 rank, and seat availability, admission will be granted.

Based on Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling, 26,168 Doctor of Medicine (MD), 13,649 Master of Surgery (MS), 922 PG Diploma, and 1,338 DNB CET seats will be filled. A total of 6,102 colleges and 649 hospitals will participate in the Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling 2022. Candidates can check the article below to know the MCC Karnataka NEET PG 2022 Counseling process, latest updates, iKarnatakaortant dates, cutoff, and seat matrix.

May 21, 2022: Despite all the efforts for postponement, Karnataka NEET PG 2022 was conducted on May 21.

Candidates can check the step-by-step guide for Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling 2022 below:

●      To register for the Counseling of Karnataka  NEET PG 2022, click on the registration link Counseling above

●      Enter details such as name, date of birth, roll number, Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 application form number, security code, and other relevant information

●      Verify the details and submit them carefully

●      Login credentials for Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling will be generated

●      After login Counseling with all details such as parents’ details, contact details, category, and nationality

●      Enter Karnataka  NEET PG details such as application number and roll number

Step 2: Payment of registration fee

●      Pay the category-wise registration fee for Counseling of Karnataka  NEET PG 2022. It must be noted that the registration fee for Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling is non-refundable.

●      Pay the security deposit according to the category. The security deposit is refundable, however, can be fortified in certain circumstances during Counseling of Karnataka  NEET PG 2022.

●      Payment of Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling fee can be made only via online mode.

●      To rearrange the order of any choice, drag the choice to the desired position

●      Once satisfied with the choices filled, click on ‘save and next’ to lock the choices.

●      If a candidate forgets to lock the choices filled, they will be automatically locked.

●      Aspirants need to verify the choices locked as the Karnataka  NEET PG seat allotment will be done based on choices filled.

After coKarnatakaleting the registration process for round one of Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling, DGHS will conduct the seat allotment processing. Karnataka  NEET PG seat allotment 2022 will be done based on, Karnataka  NEET PG rank, choices of colleges & courses filled, seats available, reservation criteria, and other factors. Based on these factors, the result of Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling will be released on the MCC website after seat allotment processing. The Karnataka  NEET PG seat allotment result 2022 will be released in the form of a PDF. The Karnataka  NEET PG Counseling result PDF will mention the details of the candidate, rank secured, institute allotted, course allotted, and remarks.

MCC will release the Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 seat allotment letters for shortlisted candidates on the official portal. Karnataka  NEET PG allotment letter will mention the date ails of the candidate, rank secured by the candidate, marks scored in the Karnataka  NEET PG exam, the category under which admission is granted, college allotted, and the reporting schedule for securing admission. Then, the shortlisted candidates in the MCC Karnataka  NEET PG 2022 Counseling will be required to report to the allotted college.

title: NEET PG

The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Postgraduate) or NEET PG is a qualifying and ranking examination in India, for students who wish to study various postgraduate Doctor of Medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS) and diploma courses, in government or private medical colleges in the country. This exam replaced All India Post Graduate Medical Entrance Examination (AIPGMEE).

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

The exam is conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE). The counseling and seat allotment is conducted by Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) will conduct the Counseling for the same in the online mode at mcc.nic.in. According to the latest notification, NBE has released the result cum merit list for AIQ Counseling 2022. Official sources confirmed that the Counseling will begin on September 1. However, the NEET PG Counseling schedule is expected to be announced soon at mcc.nic.in.

Earlier, MCC released an office stating that as part of its effort to make the process of generating PWD certificates transparent and hassle-free, the MCC IS developing software for eligible candidates participating in the Counseling under the PWD category. All applicants who applied under the PWD category must get their PWD certificates from the designated center through an online mode to participate the same.

The official schedule will be announced soon. The dates will be updated here when announced. Earlier, the result  was announced on June 1 at nbe.edu.in. This year MCC will conduct 4 rounds of NEET 2022, as follows: All India Quota Counseling – round 1, round 2, mop-up round, and stray vacancy round. Through the Counseling, the AIQ fresh registrations will be allowed in the first three rounds and not in the spot round. During the  Counseling, candidates have to register, pay fees and fill out their choice of courses and colleges. Based on the choices filled by the graduates and seat availability admission will be granted.

Based on Counseling, 26,168 Doctor of Medicine (MD), 13,649 Master of Surgery (MS), 922 PG Diploma, and 1,338 DNB CET seats will be filled. A total of 6,102 colleges and 649 hospitals will participate in the 2022 Counseling. The NEET PG 2022 result by the NBE is used for counseling and the seat allotment process. ● Pay the security deposit according to the category. The security deposit is refundable, however, can be fortified in certain circumstances during counseling of NEET PG 2022.

NEET PG 2022 seat allotment

After completing the registration process for round one of NEET PG counseling, DGHS will conduct the seat allotment processing. NEET PG seat allotment 2022 will be done based on, NEET PG rank, choices of colleges & courses filled, seats available, reservation criteria, and other factors. Based on these factors, the result of NEET PG 2022 counseling will be released on the MCC website after seat allotment processing. The NEET PG seat allotment result 2022 will be released in the form of a PDF. The NEET PG counseling result PDF will mention the details of the candidate, rank secured, institute allotted, course allotted, and remarks.

MCC will release the NEET PG 2022 seat allotment letters for shortlisted candidates on the official portal. NEET PG allotment letter will mention the date ails of the candidate, rank secured by the candidate, marks scored in the NEET PG exam, the category under which admission is granted, college allotted, and the reporting schedule for securing admission. Then, the shortlisted candidates in the MCC NEET PG 2022 counseling will be required to report to the allotted college.

Candidates must report to the allotted college for document verification and confirm their NEET PG 2022 admission. What after NEET PG counseling round 1?

After the release of the NEET PG 2022 seat allotment for counseling round one, candidates will be required to follow the steps mentioned below based on their status.

1.    Free exit: The seat allotted in the first round of MCC NEET PG counseling will be canceled if a candidate does not report to the allotted institute within the stipulated time. Such an option is referred to as ‘free exit.’

2.    Accepting the seat allotted in round one: If a candidate who has been allotted a seat in the first round of NEET PG 2022 counseling is satisfied with the allotted seat they can report to the allotted institute and secure their seat by paying the tuition fee.

3.    Upgradation in round 2: If a candidate is not satisfied with the seat allotted to them, they can opt for upgradation and participate in the second round of NEET PG counseling 2022. In case the seat is not upgraded during the second round, the seat allotted to the candidate in NEET PG counseling round one will be retained.

NEET PG 2022 counseling round two

The process of the second round of MCC NEET PG counseling 2022 will be the same as that of round one. During NEET PG counseling round two, new candidates will be required to register and pay the registration fee. However, filling fresh choices of courses and colleges will be mandatory for all the candidates willing to participate in round two of NEET PG 2022 admission.

Who are eligible for NEET PG 2022 counseling round two

●      Candidates not allotted any seat in NEET PG counseling 2022 round one

●      Candidates whose seat allotted in NEET PG admission round one got canceled in physical document verification

●      Candidates willing for up-gradation of the seat in the second round of NEET PG 2022 counseling

●      Candidates who opted for free exit or did not participate in the counseling of NEET PG round one.

Candidates participating in round two of MCC NEET PG 2022 counseling must note that there is no option of ‘free exit’ in the second round of counseling. If a candidate does not secure his NEET PG admission 2022 in the college/seat allotted during round two, his/her refundable security deposit will be forfeited.

●      No new registration: Candidates who did not get any seats either in round one or in round two of NEET PG counseling will not be required to register again for a mop-up round.

●      Choice filling: All candidates will have to fill fresh choices of courses and colleges.

●      Seat allotment: The NEET PG 2022 seat allotment of the mop-up round will be published on the official website.

NEET PG 2022 counseling for state quota seats

●      Respective state authorities will conduct the counseling of NEET PG 2022 for the remaining 50% state quota seats and 100% seats in private institutes.

●      State quota counseling process is being conducted after the declaration of NEET PG result 2022 by the NBE.

●      Through state quota NEET PG counseling, 50% of seats in government colleges and 100% of seats in private colleges in the state will be filled.

●      Every state will release an application form for NEET PG 2022 counseling for state admission.

●      counseling conducting authority will release the NEET PG state merit list of eligible candidates.

●      Candidates will be required to fill in their preference of colleges and courses and upload relevant documents during NEET PG counseling for state quota seats.

●      Based on choices filled, NEET PG 2022 state rank, reservation criteria, and other factors, candidates will be allotted MD, MS, and PG diploma seats in the state.

title: Direct MD MS admission
content:
Direct MD MS admission is the  MBBS degree qualifies a doctor to teach and practice applied human biology. This basic MBBS degree allows one to get sequential exposure to many specialities. When one gets admission to a medical college, one thinks that one has made a career choice for himself/herself. However, after four years into college one is again at a crossroads this time the tickling question what after MBBS? Young doctor after successful completion of MBBS needs more specialization towards a particular field of medical science. For getting specialization in the respective field of medical science like medicine and surgery one needs to have  MD/MS degree.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

MD – Doctor of medicine is a physician’s speciality degree. An MD degree holder doctor prescribes medicine while an MS degree holder doctor does the surgery. But both can prescribe drugs both wield instruments, but the MD doctor does more of the first and an MS doctor does less of the first. Further, some MD degrees are capable e even more specialization like MD pediatric sick, psychiatry, OBG, internal medicine. After MD there are some super–specialty degrees that one can go for after these MD degrees. For example, the MD in Internal medicine can be followed by DM in rheumatology, nephrology, cardiology, neurology etc. The same for an MS degree. A general surgeon can supper – specialize with an MCh in neurosurgery or cardi-thoracic surgery, etc. The Neet PG exam is going to be held on 11 September 2022. The Results will be declared within one month.

So the hierarchy of degree in medical science are:

MBBS then MD then DM Or MBBS then MS then MCh. 

For admission in MD and MS and diploma courses, in government or private medical colleges in the country, one needs to appear for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Postgraduate) ie NEET(PG). This exam replaced the All India Post Graduate Medical Entrance Examination (AIPGMEE). The NEET is conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE). The counseling and seat allotments are conducted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) India.

The NEET exam for admission in MD and MS get conducted every year by NBE. Candidates have g Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree or provisional MBBS pass certificate as per the Indian Medical Council Act and MBBS registration certificate issued by the Indian or state medical council and have completed a one-year internship or will be completing the internship are eligible to apply for the exam. The candidate who is having Indian citizenship but graduated from any foreign medical college must qualify for the Medical Council of India Screening Test (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination). They also need to be registered with the Indian or state medical council and have completed one year of internship or will be completing the internship can appear for the NEET (PG). For foreign nationals, registration is necessary from the country they have obtained basic medical qualifications. Medical council of India registration is not compulsory. A temporary registration can be given on payment of application fees.

Qualifying NEET (PG) entrance exam is mandatory to get admission to any medical college in India. With qualifying NEET(PG) one needs to register for counseling procedures in MCC(Medical Counselling committee) for Deemed universities and also for which state one wants to take MD/MS admission.

Under private and NRI quotas one can register for other states’ counseling procedures for MD/MS admission in the private colleges. If one wants to take MD/MS admission in Maharashtra then one must register for online counseling on the respective official website. Without attending online counselling one cannot take any seat in any medical college in India.

Registration for counseling is mandatory even for direct admission for MD/MS. Unregistered candidates are not eligible for taking admission to any medical college across India.

Some medical institutes take admission separately and will not be part of a centralized counseling system like All India Institute of Medical Science (AIIMS), JIPMER, PGIMER, NIMHANS, Sri Chitra Tirunal Institute of Medical. These colleges take separate counseling and generate NEET PPass-out eligible candidates list. One need to register separately for counseling to get admission to these colleges.

MCC conducts Counselling for the following Institutions/Universities:

50% All India Quota seats of all states except J&K.

100% seats (All India Quota seats + Institutional Quota seats) of Central Universities (Aligarh Muslim University/ Banaras Hindu University/ University of Delhi/ Central Institutes as per eligibility conditions as provided by the respective college/institute.

100% seats of Deemed Universities.

Branches: MD MS

After a basic medical degree MBBS one can choose post-graduation based on one’s interests and future endeavour as clinical or non-clinical. Post-graduation is a 3-years course. There are different branches for MD or MS courses. The different MD/MS branches are as follows:

PG Medical Direct MD MS admission through management quota.

All private colleges have given authority to hold 15% of their total seats reserved for MD/MS admission through the management quota. These 15% seats are allotted for students who want to take MD/MS admission through the management quota.

The process of Direct  MD MS admission through management quota.

  • Candidate must qualify for The NEET PG exam
  • Every year the NEET PG eligibility marks vary.
  • But the percentile must be 50.
  • The percentage and percentile vary. The percentile is calculated on the basis of the highest marks scored and lowest marks scored in the NEET PG exam.
  • Every year 3 rounds of counselling happen. There is a mop-up round for Direct  MD MS admission through the management quota.
  • Only in the mop-up round seat can be awarded to any NEET Eligible candidates, Depending on their preferred branch.

The following steps are for direct  MD MS admission through the management quota:

  • need to quality NEET (PG) Exam conducted by NBE – one needs to fill the examination form and appear for NEET (PG) exam.
  • Registration for centralized online counselling – Registration for centralized counselling or individual college counselling like AIIMS, JIPMER, etc. – One needs to register for the counselling. There is 50% counseling through MCC or the state counseling conducted by respective states counseling authorities across India. Registration fees could be around Rs 1000 to Rs 2000 varies from state to state.
  • Document verification as per the set rule by the respective states – one can verify his/her documents online or offline by visiting the respective counselling centres Some states ask for Rs 2 lakh to 5 lakh as a security deposit before attending the counselling. The paid security deposit will get deducted from the first-year fees. In a few states, the security deposit is not required as in Karnataka one doesn’t have to deposit any security amount but KEA registration is mandatory.
  • Round 1 online counselling – after verification of the document one has to appear for the first round of counselling. Need to log in and lock one’s choice of college and department for which he/she is interested. Wait and check results and find whether one can secure a seat. Seat allocation is done based on Marks obtained in NEET and the available number of seats.
  • Round 2 online counselling – as per the vacant seats in the colleges after the first round of counselling one again has to appear for counseling round 2 and the same procedure will get repeated as Round 1 counseling.
  • MOP-UP round – if one was not able to get a seat in both rounds of counseling then one has to attend the MOP-UP round. The MOP UP round is the process of counseling of seat allotment in the medical colleges by states against the reverted seat from all India 15% QOUTA and also includes the left vacant seats from Round 1 and 2 All India counseling. This round is only for the candidates who have not secured any seat in Rounds 1 and 2 counselling. Who has got the seat in Round 1 and 2 counseling cannot appear for the MOP UP counseling. One has to fill separate form for the MOP UP counseling and the dates will display at the time of counseling
  • Offline MOP-UP – after MOP UP counseling some seats are unfilled or seats that students could not take because of their higher fees structure or might because of any other reasons are filled by direct admission to the respective colleges. One name must come in the unallotted student’s list uploaded by the counselling authority and one has to register and attend the whole counseling procedure to get the vacant seat. Here direct admission gets done to the college.

Get an allotment letter offline/online where one gets selected for Direct  MD MS admission and submit it to the respective college for final admission.

Eligibility criteria for Direct MD/MS admission:

The candidates must qualify the following criteria to take admission in MD/MS through the management quota:

  • Qualify for The NEET-PG entrance exam
  • Must register for centralized counseling or state counselling process
  • Must complete or supposed to get completed 1-year internship.
  • Foreign students must qualify MCI Screening test
  • Foreign students can apply without registration from MCI

Documents Required for MD/MS admission through Management Quota:

  • The qualified NEET PG scorecard along with admitting card
  • All year MBBS marks Card
  • Internship completion certificate
  • Provision Registration Certificate
  • Transcript certificate
  • Attempt certificate
  • Eligibility certificate
  • State medical counselling registration certificate
  • Transfer certificate
  • Migration certificate
  • 10th marks card
  • 12th marks card
  • Aadhar card
  • Passport size photos(4 Numbers)
  • Pan Card
  • Address Proof

Duplicate copies of documents are not accepted one needs to provide original documents to complete admission procedures.

Direct MD MS admission fee structure in private colleges and Deemed Universities.

There is no constant fee structure, it varies from different courses and different colleges or deemed universities. Fees structures are also different as per the category and quota too. Fees are kept different for Govt Category seats, P quota, Q quota, and NRI/Management quota. The other state domicile applicants are not eligible for the govt seats other than the same state domicile students. The tuition fees will be available on the state authority website MCC and one can get all the details there. The tuition fees will range from Rs 10 lakhs per year to Rs 85 Laksh per year depending on colleges and departments. A hostel fee of around Rs 1.5 Lakh per annum to Rs 2.5 Lakh per annum.

Few courses and the management quota fee.

The last year’s fee structure of a few colleges is below. This is not fixed it may vary in the coming year.

KMC, Manipal

  • MD Paediatrics – 26,00,000
  • MS ENT – 24,00,000
  • MD Microbiology – 4,85,000
  • MD Immuno Haematology – 19,80,000
  • MD Radio-diagnosis – 30,00,000

Maharashtra

  • MD Radiology – 32,00,000
  • MD Orthopaedics – 32,00,000
  • MD Medicine – 38,60,000
  • MS Orthopaedics – 41,00,000
  • MD Anaesthesia – 25,00,000

Karnataka

  • MS ENT – 61,50,205
  • MS General surgery – 60,00,000
  • MD Dermatology – 85,00,000
  • MD Community medicine – 15,00,000
  • MD Pathology – 2,99,176

Smart Selection a private Medical college for MD/MS admission:

As MD and MS courses fees are rocketing high in India and of course the competition ahead for the doctor is also quite tough. So in the end selection of a college is the most important aspect for a candidate who is looking for MD/MD seat for PG specialization. Management fees are higher side than the general category seat fees. After successful completion of MD and MS, one needs a good experience so that he/she can practice from day one once he/she comes out from college. In keeping view of these challenges one needs to evaluate some important aspects before selecting a college for MD or MS.

Practical exposure: if a college is having excellent patient exposure will give the candidate more practical exposure. One needs to make sure whether the college is having an OPD facility or not. The seniors, professors, your consultant, and even direct visit to the college campus can answer your question well in advance. One needs to get this important information in advance when one is planning to invest 3 years of golden time and a huge amount to pursue MD/MS.

Department strength: Many colleges are not very good for all departments of MD and MS. So one needs to find whether HOD is there for his choice of the department in the college for his guide or mentor or not. What is the reputation of the department in the particular college for which he/she is looking to get his/her admission? Again the seniors, professors, your consultant, and even direct visit to the college campus can answer your question well in advance.

Alumni of the college: The previous year passed out doctors tell a lot about the college. Where they are practicing, what they are practicing? Much more such information will let one decide about the college to which he/she is looking to get admission.

Professor’s pool: This is medical science where experienced professors played a vital role in making a future doctor. Professors’ expertise help candidate to get good practical experience and knowledge during their learning period.

Infrastructure and facilities: Medical science needs a vastly expensive and expertise machine and tools for practice. So one needs to make sure about the availability of these facilities in the college before committing to getting admission to that college.

Knowledge Hub: A modern art medical library provides an ample opportunity for the candidate to get a depth of knowledge. Medical science is very vast and in-depth knowledge is required because finally, a doctor is a form of God so any mistake in his/her practice is not allowed morally. To achieve this wisdom the library and professor’s expertise enlighten one wisdom.

Hidden charges: Many colleges charge extra fees for materials or facilities they provide. Hostel rental charges and food cost is understandable but for extra fees, one needs to find them before taking admitted to the college. Sometimes college shows only tuition fees in the public domain and keeps hiding the extra charges from candidates. 

Location/Climate: Location is also a factor for some of the candidates for accessing it. Climate is another factor as if one keeps well can study.

NEET PG state Quota eligibilities

50 % quota in NEET PG means that 50 percent of the seats of that state are reserved for the domicile of that state it also includes a student who has done their MBBS from that particular state.

NEET PG Medical Exam Pattern

The examination is computer-based, multiple-choice questions (MCQ) with a single response. The exam is conducted only in English. It is held in 162 test centers across India. The question paper is divided into three parts; A, B, and C. Each part contains 50, 100, and 150 questions respectively. For each correct response, four marks are allotted and for each wrong response, one mark (25 percent) is deducted. No marks were awarded or deducted for an unattempted question. There is an option to mark questions for review whether attempted or unattempted, to check them until the exam ends. The time allotted is 3.5 hours (210 minutes).

Syllabus

The syllabus comprises subjects prescribed by the Graduate Medical Education Regulations issued by the Medical Council of India. It includes anatomy, physiology, and biochemistry in part A; pathology, pharmacology, microbiology, forensic medicine, social and preventive medicine in part B and general medicine, general surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, otorhinolaryngology and ophthalmology in part C.

title: MBBS ADMISSION IN INDIA
content:
Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) is one of the most preferred and prestigious courses in India. By completing an MBBS degree, candidates become qualified doctors. Pursuing MBBS is a challenging task, as students are tested at every stage of becoming a doctor. Candidates dreaming to become a doctor should know the detailed MBBS admission process in India. Every year millions of students dream of studying medicine. However, only a few manage to secure MBBS admission in India. Getting an MBBS seat is a highly competitive affair. More than 15 lakh aspirants compete for just 89,395 MBBS seats recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) every year.

Apply Now

MBBS India

The very first challenge candidates face getting MBBS admission is qualifying for the NEET. The National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts the NEET exam once a year. NEET-UG is the single national level entrance test conducted for MBBS admission in India, as recognized by the Supreme Court of India. Admission to 1,899 MBBS seats in AIIMS institutions and 249 seats in JIPMER is also granted through the NEET exam. A total of 542 medical colleges, 15 AIIMS, and 2 JIPMER institutions grant MBBS admission based on NEET results. Comparing the MBBS seats and the number of aspirants who appear in the exam, the competition for MBBS admission in India is increasing exponentially. Many students who qualify NEET exam with low marks struggle to get admission to government medical colleges. Whereas the fees of private MBBS colleges are very high. In India because of the high tuition fees many students from the middle-class struggle to get MBBS admission. The only hope of these students is to get MBBS admission in India only if they qualify for NEET exams with good marks. The screening process of NTA for MBBS admission is very strict and based entirely on merit in the NEET exam. After announcing the NEET result, the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) conducts the further MBBS admission process. MCC grants MBBS admission to 15% All India Quota, deemed/central universities/Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), and Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) institutes. MBBS admission to the remaining 85% state quota seats is granted by the counseling authorities of the respective state.

National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET)

The National Medical Commission (NMC) sets the eligibility criteria for MBBS admission in India. Only candidates fulfilling the eligibility requirements are considered for MBBS admission. Candidates found ineligible at any stage of MBBS admission will have their candidature canceled. Check the MBBS admission eligibility criteria below.

  • Academic qualifications: To secure MBBS admission in India, candidates must have passed class 12 from a recognized board.
  • Subjects studied: To pursue an MBBS course, students should have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in their classes 11 and 12.
  • Minimum marks required: For MBBS admission in India candidates must score at least 50% marks in the qualifying examination. For SC, ST, and OBC category candidates, the minimum marks required for MBBS admission are 40%.
  • Age: Aspirants should have attained the minimum age of 17 years for getting admission to MBBS in India. There is no upper age limit.

MBBS Admission Process in India 2023

Admission to the MBBS course is granted based on candidates’ performance in the national level entrance exam, NEET. Check the MBBS admission process in India below.

MBBS entrance exams

As aforementioned, for MBBS admission there is only one all-India medical entrance exam – NEET. NTA conducts the medical entrance test based on the NEET-UG syllabus which includes topics from classes 11 and 12 CBSE curriculum. As per the NEET exam pattern, MBBS admission aspirants need to answer 180 multiple choice questions out of 200 questions in 3 hours.

The NEET 2023 question paper is divided into three sections – Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Botany + Zoology). The NEET biology section carries the highest weightage with 90 questions that need to be answered, which fetch 360 marks. The remaining two sections of the NEET papers have equal weightage, that is 45 questions and 180 marks each.

To secure MBBS admission in India candidates need to qualify for the NTA NEET cutoff. For general category candidates, the cutoff of NEET for MBBS admission is the 50th percentile. While for reserved category candidates, the NEET cut-off is 40th percentile. Only candidates who secure the NEET cutoff marks and percentile are eligible for further counseling for MBBS admission. All AIIMS, JIPMER, and medical colleges grant admission to MBBS based on NEET results and cutoff.

What after qualifying NEET exam?

Once candidates have qualified for the NEET exam, they will be eligible to participate in the central and state-level AQI counseling process conducted for MBBS admission. NTA will prepare the list of NEET-UG-qualified candidates. Shortlisted students will be eligible for NEET counseling. To participate in the counseling and seat allotment process, students will have to register at the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) portal.

MCC will conduct the NEET counseling 2023 for 15% of the All India Quota, deemed/central universities/AFMS, and ESIC institutes. During counseling for MBBS admission, students will have to register using their personal and NEET-related details, pay the counseling fee, and fill in their preferences for the course and the colleges they wish to study into. Based on the choices filled by candidates, NEET All India Rank, reservation, and seat matrix, MCC will conduct the NEET UG seat allotment. Candidates who will be offered seats during seat allotment of MBBS admission will have to report to the allotted institute.

title: AMA Medical College of Medicine Philippines 2026-27 | Courses, Fees, Admission
content:
AMA Medical College of Medicine, Philippines is the medical school of the AMA Education System (AMAES). It is housed in AMA College Makati, which is strategically located at the heart of Makati City, the Philippines’ financial and business capital where the highest concentration of multinational, transnational, and local corporations and international organizations and embassies hold their offices. The AMA Medical College of Medicine, Philippines office is on the 8th floor of AMA College Makati, which is located at 5486 South Superhighway, Bangkal, Makati City.

Apply Now

MBBS Abroad

AMA Medical  College of Medicine, Philippines aims to produce competent medical practitioners who are educated on an innovative case-based curriculum that will develop students to become self-directed and lifelong learners – qualities that will prepare them for professional practice. This is a hybrid curriculum designed to synchronize the basic science concepts and utilize case-based scenarios to integrate concepts related to the basic science disciplines. The clinical disciplines are integrated vertically using a problem-based learning strategy to integrate concepts in the clinical disciplines. The AMA Medical Curriculum incorporates Information Technology-based capabilities to enhance learning and assessments, as this is a strength that is offered by AMAES.

AMA Medical college of medicine has several facilities that are used to enhance students’ clinical and practical skills including laboratories for Histology, Gross Anatomy, Microbiology, Parasitology, and Pathology. Students perform hands-on dissection of cadavers in Gross Anatomy. These facilities as well as classrooms for Medicine students are situated on the 7th floor of the AMA One Building.

The four-year curriculum equips the students with clinical reasoning, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with an emphasis on interdisciplinary and lifelong learning. The first three years provide the students with an integrated understanding of the basic and clinical sciences in the classroom and community settings. The fourth year of the curriculum is devoted to the application of the basic and clinical concepts in actual clinical and community settings.

Selected subjects which include ethical and legal aspects of the practice of medicine, epidemiologic and health research programs, and the practice of profession enhance the medical curriculum.

The medical curriculum also employs various teaching-learning and assessment strategies to achieve the educational goals. As early as the First Year, the students are exposed to cases that would allow them to relate basic science concepts to clinical practice. The First Year of the curriculum is designed as modules or blocks based on organ systems with similar or related functions. This instructional plan aims to synchronize topics in Anatomy, Biochemistry, and Physiology. The correlation of selected concepts will be achieved through case discussion in a problem-based tutorial session, team learning, and case method activities.

The Second and Third Years of the curriculum are a continuum of organ-based modules that integrate basic and clinical concepts. Problem-based learning (PBL) is a principal teaching-learning activity augmented by correlated activities such as lectures, laboratory exercises, and case method discussions. The students in a PBL small group setting (ratio of 1 tutor to at most 10 students) encounter and discuss problems common to practice.

The Fourth Year, which is the final year, allows the students to learn from clinical materials in affiliate hospitals and community settings. Evaluation of student performance is based on the curriculum design where small group learning is a predominant activity. Assessment includes written examinations, practical examinations, clinical observation tutorials or case discussion participation and attitude development.

AMA medical college of medicine, Philippines boasts a faculty from different excellent academic backgrounds and fields of specialization.

In summary, AMASOM is a student-centred Medicine school with the following features:

  • Four-year integrated curriculum with an ideal faculty-to-student ratio
  • Clinically oriented and problem-based method of teaching and learning
  • Non-traditional lecture and instructional modules
  • Hands-on anatomy dissection
  • Faculty established in their chosen fields of specialization and in the academe
  • Affordable, flexible payment schemes
  • Affiliated with government hospitals and private health institutions
  • Outstanding facilities and resources conducive to learning

The MD degree at AMASOM is recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) as equivalent to the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree similarly offered in the UK, Australia, India, and other Commonwealth countries. After their MD graduation from AMASOM, Indian students will be given a license to practice in India similar to the MBBS doctors from India after completion of licensing formalities with the NMC.

General Qualification for Local and Foreign Students

  • Four-year Bachelor’s degree in Science or the Arts
  • Eligibility for National Medical Admission Test (NMAT)

Additional Requirements for Foreign Students:

  • Copy of passport
  • Copy of tourist visa for conversion to student visa, or copy of student visa (if available)
  • Copy of Bureau of Quarantine stamp in the passport

The state is still venerated for imparting medical knowledge to students and giving birth to bright intellects from centuries. Uttar Pradesh has one of the highest number of medical colleges in India, offering a world class infrastructure and innovative technology to all those who come from the length and breadth of India to study MBBS in UP. 

All about MBBS in Uttar Pradesh

Uttar Pradesh has a total of 9153 medical seats available, out of which 4850 MBBS seats are reserved in 32 prestigious private medical colleges. This ratio of seat availability is one of the prime reasons why it comes under the list of the best states for students to make their dreams come true, for them skilled Medical Professionals and trustable doctors.

Admission Procedure for MBBS in Uttar Pradesh

Candidates must pass the NEET UG exam in order to be considered for their admissions to MBBS in India. The National Testing Agency (NTA) administers this exam, which serves as a standard entrance exam for medical Programmes at numerous institutions around the nation. 

All the candidates aspiring to pursue an MBBS in Uttar Pradesh must obtain the minimum qualifying marks as stated by the NTA to get considered for the subsequent admissions processes.

MBBS in Uttar Pradesh Admission Process

  • Qualify for the NEET UG entrance exam
  • Check NTA NEET eligibility criteria
  • Participate in Uttar Pradesh NEET Counseling
  • Complete Seat allotment process
  • Undergo document verification
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm your admission.

MD/MS In UP Admission Process

  • Qualify the NEET PG entrance exam
  • Participate in Uttar Pradesh NEET PG Counseling
  • Undergo the seat allotment process
  • Verification of the documents
  • Make the necessary fee payment to confirm your admission.

For any further queries regarding MD/MS Course in India, check this out: MD/MS in India

Eligibility Criteria for Medical courses in Uttar Pradesh

Mentioned below are the eligibility criteria for MBBS in UP and MD/MS in Uttar Pradesh. All the candidates are required to qualify the following educational requirement to get eligible for medical courses in this state.

For MBBS

  1. All candidates who seek admission in Uttar Pradesh MBBS and BDS admission must have passed class 12 exams with Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English as their core subjects with a minimum aggregate of 50% . 
  2. Physically challenged candidates who belong to the general category should have secured an aggregate of at least 45% in the above mentioned subjects. 
  3. Reserved categories such as SC, OBC, and ST should have secured a minimum aggregate of 40% in the same.
  4. Candidates who hold the domicile of Uttar Pradesh are eligible to take admission as per the 85% state quota seats. 
  5. For all those students who  want to avail the above reservation on the basis of     their domicile should fulfill any one of the following criteria to be considered as the domicile holders of UP state.
    • Candidates are eligible if their father is a resident of Uttar Pradesh and they are natives of the state.
    • Candidates qualify if their parent(s) have lived in Uttar Pradesh for three or more years.
    • Candidates are eligible if their parent(s) are employed by the Government of India.
    • Candidates residing abroad qualify if their direct ancestors/forefathers were residents of Uttar Pradesh.
    • Candidates who have passed both class 10 and 12 from Uttar Pradesh are eligible without needing to show residency proof.
    • Candidates who have passed either class 10 or 12 from Uttar Pradesh must either provide proof of their parent(s) being residents of Uttar Pradesh or meet one of the first four criteria.
  6. All Indian passport holders and OCI candidates are eligible to apply for the Uttar Pradesh MBBS and BDS admissions
  7. All candidates between the age of 17 to 25 years can apply for Uttar Pradesh MBBS and BDS admissions 2026. 
  8. Candidates with reservation will be offered a relaxation of 5 years in the required age criteria.

For M.D/MS

  • Candidates must have a valid MBBS degree or be in the final year of their MBBS from an NMC recognized medical university/college to be eligible for NEET-PG.
  • General category candidates need a minimum of 55% marks in MBBS, while SC/ST and OBC category candidates require at least 45% marks.
  • A one-year internship, completed on or before 31st May of the academic year, is mandatory for all candidates.
  • Candidates with an MBBS degree from abroad must clear the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE).
  • A permanent or provisional MBBS registration certificate issued by the NMC or State Medical Council is required for all candidates.

  • NEET UG Scorecard or Rank Letter

title: MBBS in Ukraine
content:
The medical profession is looked up as a divine career in India but the procedure for becoming the one is cumbersome from undergoing tedious coaching to clearing the tough NEET entrance exam and securing the highest marks as per the cut-off can be difficult for some students. Since opting for private medical colleges is totally out of budget. Does it mean, by not being able to qualify for NEET can shatter your dreams of becoming a doctor? No, of course not! Many countries offer the best medical education that too within student’s budgets. One of such top countries to study MBBS is Ukraine. A well-known and second-largest country in Europe with a fourth rank for having the largest number of top postgraduates in fields of medicine. There are numerous best medical colleges in Ukraine for Indian students and other international students.

APPLY NOW

MBBS Abroad

Advantages of Studying MBBS in Ukraine

1.    Along with WHO, UNESCO, and MCI,  the medical universities of Ukraine are recognized by medical councils of many other counties that provide a wide range of opportunities to the students pursuing MBBS in Ukraine to meet their ambitions & goals and pave a bright path for themselves which is globally recognized.

 

2. Indian students studying MBBS in Ukraine can adapt to the environment easily as the spoken language in Ukraine is English.

 

3. The cost of accommodation in Ukraine is extremely low as compared to other European countries, the USA, and the UK. Moreover, the transportation expenses are minimal as there are many schemes sponsored by the government to facilitate cheap and safe transportation to the students.

 

4. All the colleges of Ukraine are equipped with the best infrastructure and equipment that offers premium facilities to the students.

 

5. The students studying MBBS in the universities of Ukraine are privileged to have various opportunities to participate in international exchange programs, conferences, internships, and other scientific projects in various international universities that open doors to explore the world and gain ample life-changing experiences. 

 

6. All the Indian students who have completed their MBBS from Ukraine get flourishing job opportunities here in India.

MBBS in Ukraine

Ukraine is quite popular among Indian and other international students for pursuing MBBS because of its top medical universities and best teaching faculties.  At present, it has several top government medical universities offering MBBS, MD, and other degrees in medicine to the local students as well as international students. All the medical universities are accredited by the world’s major organizations like WHO and UNESCO. If we talk about the eligibility for doing MBBS in Ukraine, there’s no entrance examination for Indian students is a cherry on the cake; A few basic qualifications would do wonders. The Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine manages all the medical universities resulting in the development and maintenance of the existing educational standards. These offer the best value for medical education to students studying MBBS in Ukraine,  in terms of quality, infrastructure and cost.

These universities having a diverse student population provides scope for self-development and a wide range of opportunities to learn through international conferences and seminars. Indian students who complete their MBBS from a Medical University of Ukraine can easily acquire a job in India as the MBBS degree obtained from Ukraine University is recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) too.

MBBS Admission in Ukraine for Indian students

Getting admission to any medical university in Ukraine is a simple task for Indian students. Applicants must have cleared NEET with basic marks (50% for open category and 40% for reserved category), the applicants are not required to take any exam like TOEFL or IELTS (that are mandatory in other foreign countries) or any other entrance exams.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicants shall have completed the age of 17 years on or before 31st December of the year in which he/she aspires to take admission for MBBS in Ukraine.
  • All the Indian applicants must secure a minimum of 50% marks in their 12th standard from the Science stream with having physics, chemistry, and biology as the compulsory subjects in their high school (CBSE / ISC or any other equivalent board of examination.)
  • Indian students must have qualified NEET with minimum marks as explained above.

 MBBS in Ukraine FAQs

1) How many marks are required in NEET to get admission for MBBS in Ukraine?

Ans - The average marks are 40% for reserved category students and 50% for open category students.

2) Is the admission procedure for MBBS in Ukraine easy?

Ans - The admission process in any Ukrainian University has become quite easy as compared to the other countries. The students don't have to undergo any entrance exams or other exams like TOEFL & IELTS, only an average NEET score is sufficient.

3) What is the medium of instruction in Ukrainian universities?

Ans - The medium of instruction in the universities of Ukraine is English.

4) What is the average cost of MBBS in Ukraine?

Ans - The average cost of MBBS in Ukraine is approximately ₹5,50,000 in the first year and it decreases to ₹2,90,000 per year for the subsequent 6 years.

5) Are the Ukrainian medical universities recognized in India?

Ans - Yes, all the universities of Ukraine are recognized by the Medical Council of India. They are also recognized by international top bodies like UNESCO & WHO.

6) What are the documents required to be submitted during the admission procedure in Ukraine?

Ans – 10th & 12th mark sheets, NEET scorecard, Valid passport, Passport Size Photo

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Who we are

Our website address is: https://argroupofeducation.com.

What personal data we collect and why we collect it

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Contact forms

Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Analytics

Who we share your data with

How long we retain your data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where we send your data

Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Located at Science Tech City, Achrol near the Jaipur–Delhi Highway, students get strong connectivity and a focused learning environment. If you are exploring MBBS admission in India among Rajasthan’s emerging private medical colleges, this institute deserves a place on your preference list.

The college functions as per National Medical Commission (NMC) norms and is affiliated with Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS). It offers 150 MBBS seats. Modern classrooms, advanced laboratories, digital learning facilities, experienced faculty and hospital-based clinical exposure are key highlights.

This guide covers admission process, eligibility, MBBS fees, seat matrix, cutoff trends, hostel facilities, infrastructure and Rajasthan UG counselling for Dr. B. S. Tomar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research.

Why Choose Dr. B. S. Tomar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research?

For students planning MBBS in Rajasthan, Dr. B. S. Tomar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research is one of the newer private medical colleges in the state. The institute is developed on an approximately 100-acre campus and focuses on quality medical education, research and patient care.

  • Modern infrastructure: Smart classrooms, advanced laboratories, skill labs, digital library and modern teaching facilities support practical learning along with classroom teaching.
  • Clinical exposure: The attached teaching hospital provides OPD, IPD and emergency exposure so students can build clinical skills early.
  • Experienced faculty: Teaching is guided by experienced professors and medical specialists with a focus on conceptual learning, practical training and research.
  • Growing opportunities: Expanding MBBS seats in Rajasthan make this college a relevant option for the 2026 counselling process.

MBBS Admission Process

Admission requires a valid NEET UG score. All 150 MBBS seats — State Quota or Management Quota — are allotted through Rajasthan’s centralized RAJUGNEET counselling conducted by SMS Medical College, Jaipur. There is no direct or offline admission.

  1. NEET eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English. General category candidates need at least 50% marks; SC/ST/OBC need at least 40%. Candidates must be at least 17 years old at admission.
  2. Qualify NEET UG: A valid NEET UG score is mandatory.
  3. Register for Rajasthan UG Counselling: Complete registration, choice filling, seat allotment and document verification on the official RAJUGNEET portal as per the counselling schedule.

Courses Offered

CourseDuration
MBBS5.5 years (4.5 years academic + 1-year internship)

The programme follows the NMC curriculum and combines classroom learning, laboratory sessions and clinical training in the attached teaching hospital.

Fee Structure

Annual MBBS tuition fees vary by quota and should be verified from the latest official counselling notification. Approximate ranges shared for guidance:

  • MBBS course fees: about ₹18.9 lakh per year
  • State Quota / AIQ: about ₹19.25 lakh per year
  • Management Quota: about ₹32.85 lakh per year
  • Hostel fee (mandatory): about ₹3.5 lakh per year

Deposit, examination fee and miscellaneous charges are paid separately at admission. As per NMC practice, tuition is typically charged for the 4.5-year academic programme and not during the compulsory internship year — confirm from the latest official circular.

Infrastructure

The campus is designed for modern medical education standards and includes:

  • Modern lecture theatres and smart classrooms
  • Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Histology and Clinical Pathology laboratories
  • Spacious library with digital resources and medical journals
  • Skill and simulation labs for procedure practice before patient exposure

Teaching Hospital

Hospital training is central to MBBS education. Clinical departments include General Medicine, General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, ENT, Ophthalmology, Psychiatry, Dermatology and Radiology.

Hospital services typically include regular OPD, IPD, emergency care, clinical case discussions and internship training. Recent published hospital statistics cited for the institute include around 86% average bed occupancy, 56,000+ monthly OPD registrations and 5,000+ admitted patients, supporting strong clinical exposure.
